```c
        { VGK_API_PS_SET_CREATE_THREAD_NOTIFY,          L"PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine"     },
        { VGK_API_PS_REMOVE_CREATE_THREAD_NOTIFY,       L"PsRemoveCreateThreadNotifyRoutine"  },
        { VGK_API_PS_SET_LOAD_IMAGE_NOTIFY,             L"PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine"        },
        { VGK_API_PS_REMOVE_LOAD_IMAGE_NOTIFY,          L"PsRemoveLoadImageNotifyRoutine"     },
        { VGK_API_HALP_DMA_GET_IOMMU_INTERFACE,         L"HalpDmaGetIommuInterface"           },
        { VGK_API_SYS_DISP_AFFINITY,                    VGK_SYSDISPAFFINITY_W                 },
        { VGK_API_KE_SET_ACTUAL_BASE_PRIORITY_THREAD,   VGK_KE_SET_BASE_PRIORITY_W            }
    };

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(apiBindings); ++i) {
        PVOID rawPtr = VgkResolveRoutineByName(apiBindings[i].Name);
        g_Vgk.EncryptedApiTable[apiBindings[i].Slot] =
            (rawPtr != NULL) ? ((ULONG64)rawPtr ^ xorKey) : 0ULL;
    }
}

PVOID
VgkResolveEncryptedApi(
    _In_ VGK_API_SLOT Slot
)
{
    if (Slot >= VGK_API_SLOT_COUNT) {
        return NULL;
    }
    ULONG64 encoded = g_Vgk.EncryptedApiTable[Slot];
    if (encoded == 0ULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    return (PVOID)(encoded ^ g_Vgk.ApiXorKey);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * RECONSTRUCTED VgkQuerySysDispAffinity
 * ========================================================================= */

typedef USHORT (NTAPI *PFN_VGK_QUERY_AFFINITY)(_In_ PCWSTR KeyName, _In_ PVOID Context);

BOOLEAN
VgkQuerySysDispAffinity(
    _In_ PVOID Context,
    _Out_ PULONG OutAffinity
)
{
    if (OutAffinity) {
        *OutAffinity = 0;
    }

    PFN_VGK_QUERY_AFFINITY fnQuery = (PFN_VGK_QUERY_AFFINITY)VgkResolveEncryptedApi(VGK_API_SYS_DISP_AFFINITY);
    if (fnQuery == NULL) {
        KAFFINITY activeProcessors = KeQueryActiveProcessors();
        if (OutAffinity) {
            *OutAffinity = (ULONG)(activeProcessors & 0xFFFF);
        }
        return TRUE;
    }

    USHORT result = fnQuery(VGK_SYSDISPAFFINITY_W, Context);
    if (result == 0) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    if (OutAffinity) {
        *OutAffinity = (ULONG)result;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * MODULE LIST ENUMERATION & BOUNDARY CHECKS
 * ========================================================================= */

PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES
VgkAcquireModuleList(VOID)
{
    ULONG requiredBytes = 0;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemModuleInformation, NULL, 0, &requiredBytes);
    if (status != STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH || requiredBytes == 0) {
        return NULL;
    }

    requiredBytes += 0x2000;
    PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES modList = (PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES)ExAllocatePoolWithTag(
        NonPagedPoolNx,
        requiredBytes,
        VGK_POOL_TAG
    );
    if (!modList) {
        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_EDCL, 0xC000009A, L"%lX\n", STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES);
        return NULL;
    }

    status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemModuleInformation, modList, requiredBytes, &requiredBytes);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(modList, VGK_POOL_TAG);
        return NULL;
    }

    return modList;
}

BOOLEAN
VgkIsAddressBackedByModule(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules,
    _In_ ULONG64 Address,
    _Out_opt_ PULONG64 OutImageBase
)
{
    if (OutImageBase) {
        *OutImageBase = 0;
    }
    if (!Modules || Address == 0) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < Modules->NumberOfModules; ++i) {
        ULONG64 base = (ULONG64)Modules->Modules[i].ImageBase;
        ULONG64 end  = base + (ULONG64)Modules->Modules[i].ImageSize;
        if (Address >= base && Address < end) {
            if (OutImageBase) {
                *OutImageBase = base;
            }
            return TRUE;
        }
    }
    return FALSE;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * BOOT-TIME HARDWARE FINGERPRINTING & IOMMU CHIPSET PROBE
 * (RVA 0x1565E0: "\Device\IommuChipsetEnabler" / "HalpDmaGetIommuInterface")
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
VgkProbeIommuAndHardwareProfile(VOID)
{
    RtlZeroMemory(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile, sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile));

    /* 1. Query Performance Counter Frequency (HAL.dll!KeQueryPerformanceCounter, stored at 0x19CB58) */
    LARGE_INTEGER freq = { 0 };
    KeQueryPerformanceCounter(&freq);
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.QpcFrequency = (ULONG64)freq.QuadPart;

    /* 2. CPUID Vendor, Processor ID, and Hypervisor Leaf 0x40000000 */
    int regs[4] = { 0 };
    __cpuid(regs, 0);
    *(int*)(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[0]) = regs[1];
    *(int*)(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[4]) = regs[3];
    *(int*)(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[8]) = regs[2];
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[12] = '\0';

    __cpuid(regs, 1);
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.ProcessorId          = (ULONG)regs[0];
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorBitPresent = ((regs[2] & (1 << 31)) != 0);

    if (g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorBitPresent) {
        __cpuid(regs, 0x40000000);
        *(int*)(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[0]) = regs[1];
        *(int*)(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[4]) = regs[2];
        *(int*)(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[8]) = regs[3];
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[12] = '\0';
    }

    /* 3. Calibrate RDTSC vs CPUID Serialization Latency */
    ULONG64 accDelta = 0;
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
        ULONG64 t0 = __rdtsc();
        __cpuid(regs, 1);
        ULONG64 t1 = __rdtsc();
        if (t1 > t0) {
            accDelta += (t1 - t0);
        }
    }
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TscCpuidRatio = accDelta / 32;

    /* 4. Probe \Device\IommuChipsetEnabler & HalpDmaGetIommuInterface (RVA 0x1565E0) */
    PVOID halpIommu = VgkResolveEncryptedApi(VGK_API_HALP_DMA_GET_IOMMU_INTERFACE);
    if (halpIommu != NULL) {
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.IommuInterfacePresent = TRUE;
    } else {
        UNICODE_STRING iommuDev;
        RtlInitUnicodeString(&iommuDev, VGK_IOMMU_DEVICE_W);
        PFILE_OBJECT fileObj = NULL;
        PDEVICE_OBJECT devObj = NULL;
        if (NT_SUCCESS(IoGetDeviceObjectPointer(&iommuDev, FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, &fileObj, &devObj))) {
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.IommuInterfacePresent = TRUE;
            ObDereferenceObject(fileObj);
        } else {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_IOMMU_DISABLED);
        }
    }

    /* 5. Compute SHA-256 of on-disk ntoskrnl.exe header via CNG (cng.sys) */
    VgkHashDiskFileHeader(
        L"\\SystemRoot\\System32\\ntoskrnl.exe",
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.NtoskrnlHeaderSha256
    );
}

/* =========================================================================
 * IRP DISPATCHERS (\Device\vgk AND \Device\gobbledygook)
 * ========================================================================= */

_Use_decl_annotations_
NTSTATUS
VgkDispatchCreateClose(
    PDEVICE_OBJECT DeviceObject,
    PIRP Irp
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DeviceObject);

    Irp->IoStatus.Status      = STATUS_SUCCESS;
    Irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
    IoCompleteRequest(Irp, IO_NO_INCREMENT);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

_Use_decl_annotations_
NTSTATUS
VgkDispatchIoControl(
    PDEVICE_OBJECT DeviceObject,
    PIRP Irp
)
{
    return VgkHandleDeviceControl(DeviceObject, Irp);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * LIFO REVERSE-PATH TEARDOWN & DRIVER ENTRY
 * ========================================================================= */

_Use_decl_annotations_
VOID
VgkDriverUnload(
    PDRIVER_OBJECT DriverObject
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DriverObject);

    g_Vgk.Unloading = TRUE;

    /* 1. Stop DPC Timer, flush profiler metrics, and drain deferred WorkItems */
    VgkFlushProfilerMetrics();
    VgkShutdownDpcAndWorkItem();

    /* 2. Wait for SMP Cache-Aware Rundown Protection and active hook trampolines (RVA 0x18FF08) */
    if (g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef != NULL) {
        ExWaitForRundownProtectionReleaseCacheAware(g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef);
        ExFreeCacheAwareRundownProtection(g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef);
        g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef = NULL;
    }

    while (InterlockedCompareExchange64(&g_Vgk.ActiveHookRefCount, 0, 0) != 0) {
        LARGE_INTEGER shortWait;
        shortWait.QuadPart = -10000LL; /* 1ms */
        KeDelayExecutionThread(KernelMode, FALSE, &shortWait);
    }

    /* 3. Shutdown vgtrace real-time MDL ring-buffer logger */
    VgtraceShutdownLogger();

    /* 4. Remove Ob, Process, Thread, Image, and NMI callbacks */
    VgkRemoveSecurityCallbacks();

    /* 5. Deregister BugCheck Reason Callback (RVA 0x1AC61E) */
    if (g_Vgk.BugCheckRegistered) {
        KeDeregisterBugCheckReasonCallback(&g_Vgk.BugCheckRecord);
        g_Vgk.BugCheckRegistered = FALSE;
    }

    /* 6. Release Guarded Region MDL */
    VgkFreeGuardedRegionMdl();

    /* 7. Destroy Symbolic Link and Device Objects (\Device\gobbledygook & \Device\vgk) */
    UNICODE_STRING dosName;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&dosName, VGK_DOS_DEVICE_NAME_W);
    IoDeleteSymbolicLink(&dosName);

    if (g_Vgk.GobbledygookDeviceObject != NULL) {
        IoDeleteDevice(g_Vgk.GobbledygookDeviceObject);
        g_Vgk.GobbledygookDeviceObject = NULL;
    }

    if (g_Vgk.VgkDeviceObject != NULL) {
        IoDeleteDevice(g_Vgk.VgkDeviceObject);
        g_Vgk.VgkDeviceObject = NULL;
    }
}

_Use_decl_annotations_
NTSTATUS
DriverEntry(
    PDRIVER_OBJECT DriverObject,
    PUNICODE_STRING RegistryPath
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(RegistryPath);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(g_VgkProtectionBanner);

    RtlZeroMemory(&g_Vgk, sizeof(g_Vgk));
    g_Vgk.DriverObject = DriverObject;

    KeInitializeSpinLock(&g_Vgk.TelemetryLock);
    KeInitializeMutex(&g_Vgk.StateMutex, 0);

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < VGK_PROFILER_MAX_BUCKETS; ++i) {
        g_Vgk.ProfilerBuckets[i].BucketId = i + 1;
    }

    /* 1. Initialize XOR-Encrypted Kernel API Dispatch Table */
    VgkInitializeApiXorTable();

    /* 2. Allocate Cache-Aware Rundown Protection (RVA 0x1AC5AE) & BugCheck Callback (RVA 0x1AC644) */
    g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef = ExAllocateCacheAwareRundownProtection(NonPagedPoolNx, VGK_POOL_TAG);

    KeInitializeCallbackRecord(&g_Vgk.BugCheckRecord);
    g_Vgk.BugCheckRegistered = KeRegisterBugCheckReasonCallback(
        &g_Vgk.BugCheckRecord,
        VgkBugCheckReasonCallbackRoutine,
        KbCallbackSecondaryDumpData,
        (PUCHAR)"VGKT"
    );

    /* 3. Create Primary Device (\Device\vgk) and Auxiliary Device (\Device\gobbledygook, RVA 0x156E10) */
    UNICODE_STRING vgkDevName;
    UNICODE_STRING vgkDosName;
    UNICODE_STRING gobbleDevName;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&vgkDevName,    VGK_DEVICE_NAME_W);
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&vgkDosName,    VGK_DOS_DEVICE_NAME_W);
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&gobbleDevName, VGK_GOBBLEDYGOOK_DEVICE_W);

    NTSTATUS status = IoCreateDevice(
        DriverObject,
        0,
        &vgkDevName,
        FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN,
        FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN,
        FALSE,
        &g_Vgk.VgkDeviceObject
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        if (g_Vgk.BugCheckRegistered) {
            KeDeregisterBugCheckReasonCallback(&g_Vgk.BugCheckRecord);
        }
        if (g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef != NULL) {
            ExFreeCacheAwareRundownProtection(g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef);
        }
        return status;
    }

    status = IoCreateSymbolicLink(&vgkDosName, &vgkDevName);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        IoDeleteDevice(g_Vgk.VgkDeviceObject);
        g_Vgk.VgkDeviceObject = NULL;
        if (g_Vgk.BugCheckRegistered) {
            KeDeregisterBugCheckReasonCallback(&g_Vgk.BugCheckRecord);
        }
        if (g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef != NULL) {
            ExFreeCacheAwareRundownProtection(g_Vgk.CacheAwareRundownRef);
        }
        return status;
    }

    /* Create \Device\gobbledygook (RVA 0x156E10 in vgk.sys v1.19.1.18) */
    IoCreateDevice(
        DriverObject,
        0,
        &gobbleDevName,
        FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN,
        FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN,
        FALSE,
        &g_Vgk.GobbledygookDeviceObject
    );

    DriverObject->DriverUnload                         = VgkDriverUnload;
    DriverObject->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CREATE]         = VgkDispatchCreateClose;
    DriverObject->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CLOSE]          = VgkDispatchCreateClose;
    DriverObject->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL] = VgkDispatchIoControl;

    /* 4. Lock Boot-Time Hardware Profile, CNG Hashes & IOMMU State */
    ULONG64 t0 = VgkQueryElapsedMicroseconds();
    VgkProbeIommuAndHardwareProfile();

    /* 5. Allocate 2MB Non-Paged MDL for Guarded Region Mapping & Initialize vgtrace Ring-Buffer */
    VgkInitializeGuardedRegionMdl();
    VgtraceInitializeLogger();

    /* 6. Perform Initial Boot Blacklist (BBL / DCL), Hypervisor, PCI/DMA, HWID/TPM & USB HID Sweeps */
    VgkScanObjectDirectoriesForByovd();
    PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES bootModules = VgkAcquireModuleList();
    if (bootModules != NULL) {
        VgkScanLoadedModulesAgainstRules(bootModules);
        VgkAuditHypervisorAndAntiDebug(bootModules);
        ExFreePoolWithTag(bootModules, VGK_POOL_TAG);
    } else {
        VgkAuditHypervisorAndAntiDebug(NULL);
    }

    VgkAuditPciBusDmaAndAcpi();
    VgkCollectFullHardwareIdentity();
    VgkAuditUsbHidAndMouseTopology();

    ULONG64 t1 = VgkQueryElapsedMicroseconds();
    if (t1 >= t0) {
        VgkRecordProfilerSample(1, t1 - t0);
    }

    /* 7. Install ObRegisterCallbacks, Process/Thread/Image Notifiers & NMI Handler */
    VgkInstallSecurityCallbacks();

    /* 8. Start Periodic KDPC Timer & WorkItem Pipeline */
    VgkInitializeDpcAndWorkItem();

    /* 9. Emit Boot Version Telemetry Record (RVA 0x1598C0 -> \SystemRoot\vgk0001.dat) */
    VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_VERSION_BANNER, 0, NULL);

    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

```

`Vanguard/vgk_src/hv_antidebug.c`:

```c
/*
 * hv_antidebug.c
 * Riot Vanguard Kernel-Mode Anti-Cheat (vgk.sys v1.19.1.18)
 * Sections 2, 3, 10, 16: Hypervisor Detection, CPUID Leaves, MSR Verification & Anti-Debug
 *
 * Implements:
 *   - §3 / §16 CPUID Leaves 0x00000000, 0x00000001 (ECX[31] HV bit),
 *              0x40000000..0x40000005 (HV Vendor & VBS/Hyper-V Interface),
 *              0x80000002..0x80000004 (48-byte Processor Brand String)
 *   - §3       MSR Hooking Detection (IA32_LSTAR 0xC0000082, IA32_SYSENTER_EIP 0x176,
 *              IA32_GS_BASE 0xC0000101) across CLI/STI barriers + ntoskrnl bounds check
 *   - §3       CR0 / CR4 Control Register Masking (CR4.VMXE, SMEP, SMAP)
 *   - §3       EPT Page Splitting & INVLPG + RDTSCP Latency Calibration
 *   - §2 / §3  TESTSIGNING, VBS/HVCI (SystemIsolatedUserModeInformation), Secure Boot
 *   - §9 / §10 Anti-Debug: KdDebuggerEnabled, KdDebuggerNotPresent,
 *              SystemKernelDebuggerInformation, KUSER_SHARED_DATA vs RDTSC+CPUID Quad Check
 */

#include "vgk.h"

#pragma intrinsic(_disable, _enable)

#define IA32_SYSENTER_EIP_MSR       0x00000176UL
#define IA32_GS_BASE_MSR            0xC0000101UL
#define IA32_KERNEL_GS_BASE_MSR     0xC0000102UL
#define IA32_LSTAR_MSR              0xC0000082UL

#define CR4_VMXE_BIT                (1ULL << 13)
#define CR4_SMEP_BIT                (1ULL << 20)
#define CR4_SMAP_BIT                (1ULL << 21)

typedef struct _SYSTEM_KERNEL_DEBUGGER_INFORMATION {
    BOOLEAN KernelDebuggerEnabled;
    BOOLEAN KernelDebuggerNotPresent;
} SYSTEM_KERNEL_DEBUGGER_INFORMATION, *PSYSTEM_KERNEL_DEBUGGER_INFORMATION;

typedef struct _SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION {
    ULONG Length;
    ULONG CodeIntegrityOptions;
} SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION, *PSYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION;

typedef struct _SYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION {
    BOOLEAN SecureKernelRunning : 1;
    BOOLEAN HvciEnabled         : 1;
    BOOLEAN HvciStrictMode      : 1;
    BOOLEAN DebugEnabled        : 1;
    BOOLEAN FirmwarePageProtection : 1;
    BOOLEAN EncryptionKeyAvailable : 1;
    BOOLEAN SpareFlags          : 2;
    BOOLEAN TrustletRunning     : 1;
    BOOLEAN HvciDisableAllowed  : 1;
    BOOLEAN SpareFlags2         : 6;
    UCHAR   Spare0[14];
} SYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION, *PSYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION;

/* Known Third-Party / Prohibited Hypervisor Signatures (§3 / §16) */
static const PCSTR g_VgkBlacklistedHvVendors[] = {
    "VMwareVMware",
    "KVMKVMKVM\0\0\0",
    "XenVMMXenVMM",
    "VBoxVBoxVBox",
    "TCGTCGTCGTCG",
    "prl hyperv  ",
    "bhyve bhyve "
};

/*
 * §3 / §16: Collect CPUID Leaves 0x0, 0x1, 0x40000000..0x40000005, 0x80000002..0x80000004
 */
static VOID
VgkCollectCpuidAndHypervisorLeaves(VOID)
{
    int regs[4] = { 0 };

    /* Leaf 0x00000000: Base Architecture Vendor String (GenuineIntel / AuthenticAMD) */
    __cpuid(regs, 0x00000000);
    *(PULONG)&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[0] = (ULONG)regs[1]; /* EBX */
    *(PULONG)&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[4] = (ULONG)regs[3]; /* EDX */
    *(PULONG)&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[8] = (ULONG)regs[2]; /* ECX */
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor[12] = '\0';

    /* Leaf 0x00000001: Processor ID + ECX[31] Hypervisor Present Bit */
    __cpuid(regs, 0x00000001);
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.ProcessorId          = (ULONG)regs[0];
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorBitPresent = ((regs[2] & (1 << 31)) != 0) ? TRUE : FALSE;

    /* Leaves 0x80000002..0x80000004: 48-character Processor Brand String */
    __cpuid(regs, (int)0x80000000);
    if ((ULONG)regs[0] >= 0x80000004UL) {
        int brandRegs[4];
        __cpuid(brandRegs, (int)0x80000002);
        RtlCopyMemory(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuBrandString[0],  brandRegs, 16);
        __cpuid(brandRegs, (int)0x80000003);
        RtlCopyMemory(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuBrandString[16], brandRegs, 16);
        __cpuid(brandRegs, (int)0x80000004);
        RtlCopyMemory(&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuBrandString[32], brandRegs, 16);
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuBrandString[48] = '\0';
    }

    /* Leaf 0x40000000..0x40000005: Synthetic Hypervisor Vendor & Interface Matrix */
    if (g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorBitPresent) {
        __cpuid(regs, 0x40000000);
        *(PULONG)&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[0] = (ULONG)regs[1];
        *(PULONG)&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[4] = (ULONG)regs[2];
        *(PULONG)&g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[8] = (ULONG)regs[3];
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor[12] = '\0';

        int hvIfRegs[4] = { 0 };
        __cpuid(hvIfRegs, 0x40000001);
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorInterfaceSig = (ULONG)hvIfRegs[0]; /* 'Hv#1' = 0x31237648 */

        /* Flag any hypervisor vendor that is NOT legitimate Windows Hyper-V ("Microsoft Hv") */
        if (RtlCompareMemory(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor, "Microsoft Hv", 12) != 12) {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_HV_FOREIGN_VENDOR);
            VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_WIC, 0x301, NULL);
        }

        for (ULONG i = 0; i < RTL_NUMBER_OF(g_VgkBlacklistedHvVendors); i++) {
            if (RtlCompareMemory(
                    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorVendor,
                    g_VgkBlacklistedHvVendors[i],
                    12) == 12) {
                InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_HV_FOREIGN_VENDOR);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

/*
 * §3: MSR Hooking Verification (IA32_LSTAR, IA32_SYSENTER_EIP, IA32_GS_BASE)
 * Verifies LSTAR points into ntoskrnl.exe (Modules->Modules[0]) and performs
 * atomic read-back across CLI/STI barriers to detect synthetic MSR shadows.
 */
static VOID
VgkVerifySyscallMsrsAndControlRegisters(
    _In_opt_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    _disable();
    ULONG64 lstar1   = __readmsr(IA32_LSTAR_MSR);
    ULONG64 sysenter = __readmsr(IA32_SYSENTER_EIP_MSR);
    ULONG64 gsBase   = __readmsr(IA32_GS_BASE_MSR);
    ULONG64 cr0Val   = __readcr0();
    ULONG64 cr4Val   = __readcr4();
    ULONG64 lstar2   = __readmsr(IA32_LSTAR_MSR);
    _enable();

    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.LstarMsrValue = lstar1;

    /* 1. Readback consistency across interrupt-disabled window */
    if (lstar1 != lstar2 || lstar1 == 0 || gsBase == 0) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_HV_MSR_HOOKED);
        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_MC, 0xC0000082, NULL);
    }

    /* 2. Verify IA32_LSTAR (KiSystemCall64) resides inside ntoskrnl.exe */
    if (Modules != NULL && Modules->NumberOfModules > 0) {
        ULONG64 ntosBase = (ULONG64)Modules->Modules[0].ImageBase;
        ULONG64 ntosEnd  = ntosBase + (ULONG64)Modules->Modules[0].ImageSize;
        if (lstar1 < ntosBase || lstar1 >= ntosEnd) {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_HV_MSR_HOOKED);
            VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_MC, 0xC0000083, NULL);
        }
        if (sysenter != 0 && (sysenter < ntosBase || sysenter >= ntosEnd)) {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_HV_MSR_HOOKED);
        }
    }

    /* 3. Verify CR0 Write Protect (Bit 16) and CR4 SMEP (Bit 20) */
    if ((cr0Val & (1ULL << 16)) == 0 || (cr4Val & CR4_SMEP_BIT) == 0) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_MC_PTE_UNBACKED);
        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_MC, (ULONG)(cr4Val & 0xFFFFFFFFUL), NULL);
    }

    /* 4. Check CR4.VMXE (Bit 13) when CPUID claims no hypervisor is present */
    if (!g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HypervisorBitPresent && (cr4Val & CR4_VMXE_BIT) != 0) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_HV_FOREIGN_VENDOR);
        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_WIC, 0x304, NULL);
    }
}

/*
 * §3 / §10: RDTSC + CPUID Quad Timing & EPT INVLPG Exit Latency Calibration
 * Cross-checks RDTSC against KUSER_SHARED_DATA (0xFFFFF78000000000) InterruptTime.
 */
static VOID
VgkCalibrateRdtscCpuidAndInvlpgTiming(VOID)
{
    int cpuidScratch[4] = { 0 };
    unsigned int aux = 0;

    /* Sample KUSER_SHARED_DATA InterruptTime before & after 64 CPUID + INVLPG cycles */
    ULONG64 kuserTimeStart = *(volatile ULONG64*)0xFFFFF78000000008ULL;

    ULONG64 totalCpuidCycles  = 0;
    ULONG64 totalInvlpgCycles = 0;

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        ULONG64 t0 = __rdtscp(&aux);
        __cpuid(cpuidScratch, 0x00000001);
        ULONG64 t1 = __rdtscp(&aux);
        totalCpuidCycles += (t1 - t0);

        ULONG64 t2 = __rdtscp(&aux);
        __invlpg(&g_Vgk);
        ULONG64 t3 = __rdtscp(&aux);
        totalInvlpgCycles += (t3 - t2);
    }

    ULONG64 kuserTimeEnd = *(volatile ULONG64*)0xFFFFF78000000008ULL;

    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TscCpuidRatio       = totalCpuidCycles / 64ULL;
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.InvlpgLatencyCycles = totalInvlpgCycles / 64ULL;

    /* Nested hypervisor or EPT split trap causes abnormal CPUID/INVLPG exit cycles (> 4500) */
    if (g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TscCpuidRatio > 4500ULL ||
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.InvlpgLatencyCycles > 4500ULL ||
        kuserTimeEnd < kuserTimeStart) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_HV_TIMING_ANOMALY);
        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(
            VGK_EVENT_TIMING_PAIR,
            0,
            NULL,
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TscCpuidRatio,
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.InvlpgLatencyCycles
        );
    }
}

/*
 * §2 / §3 / §10: Query VBS/HVCI, Code Integrity (TESTSIGNING) & Kernel Debugger State
 */
static VOID
VgkAuditBootIntegrityAndDebuggerState(VOID)
{
    ULONG returnLen = 0;

    /* 1. Direct kernel global check: KdDebuggerEnabled & KdDebuggerNotPresent */
    if (*KdDebuggerEnabled || !(*KdDebuggerNotPresent)) {
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.KernelDebuggerPresent = TRUE;
        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_KERNEL_DEBUGGER);
        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_DF, 1, NULL);
    }

    /* 2. ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemKernelDebuggerInformation = 0x23) */
    SYSTEM_KERNEL_DEBUGGER_INFORMATION dbgInfo = { 0 };
    if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQuerySystemInformation(
            SystemKernelDebuggerInformation,
            &dbgInfo,
            sizeof(dbgInfo),
            &returnLen))) {
        if (dbgInfo.KernelDebuggerEnabled || !dbgInfo.KernelDebuggerNotPresent) {
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.KernelDebuggerPresent = TRUE;
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_KERNEL_DEBUGGER);
        }
    }

    /* 3. ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemCodeIntegrityInformation = 0x67) for TESTSIGNING */
    SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION ciInfo = { 0 };
    ciInfo.Length = sizeof(ciInfo);
    if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQuerySystemInformation(
            SystemCodeIntegrityInformation,
            &ciInfo,
            sizeof(ciInfo),
            &returnLen))) {
        /* CODEINTEGRITY_OPTION_TESTSIGN = 0x02, CODEINTEGRITY_OPTION_DEBUGMODE_ENABLED = 0x80 */
        if ((ciInfo.CodeIntegrityOptions & 0x02UL) != 0 ||
            (ciInfo.CodeIntegrityOptions & 0x80UL) != 0) {
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TestSigningEnabled = TRUE;
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_KERNEL_DEBUGGER);
            VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_DF, (ULONG)ciInfo.CodeIntegrityOptions, NULL);
        }
        /* CODEINTEGRITY_OPTION_HVCI_KMCI_ENABLED = 0x400 */
        if ((ciInfo.CodeIntegrityOptions & 0x400UL) != 0) {
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HvciEnabled = TRUE;
        }
    }

    /* 4. ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemIsolatedUserModeInformation = 0x9C) for VBS/HVCI */
    SYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION iumInfo = { 0 };
    if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQuerySystemInformation(
            SystemIsolatedUserModeInformation,
            &iumInfo,
            sizeof(iumInfo),
            &returnLen))) {
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.VbsEnabled  = iumInfo.SecureKernelRunning ? TRUE : FALSE;
        if (iumInfo.HvciEnabled) {
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HvciEnabled = TRUE;
        }
    }
}

VOID
VgkAuditHypervisorAndAntiDebug(
    _In_opt_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    VgkCollectCpuidAndHypervisorLeaves();
    VgkVerifySyscallMsrsAndControlRegisters(Modules);
    VgkCalibrateRdtscCpuidAndInvlpgTiming();
    VgkAuditBootIntegrityAndDebuggerState();
}

```

`Vanguard/vgk_src/hwid_tpm_smbios.c`:

```c
/*
 * hwid_tpm_smbios.c
 * Riot Vanguard Kernel-Mode Anti-Cheat (vgk.sys v1.19.1.18)
 * Sections 14, 14.1, 15, 18, 19, 20.1: Hardware Identification, TPM 2.0 TBS Pipeline,
 * SMBIOS Physical & RSMB Parser, Storage NVMe Serial, NIC Permanent MAC & Cross-Validation
 *
 * Implements:
 *   - §14.1 TPM 2.0 Endorsement Key (EK) & PCR Attestation via Tbsip_Submit_Command:
 *             TPM2_CC_ReadPublic (0x00000173) on handles 0x81010001 (RSA) / 0x81010002 (ECC)
 *             TPM2_CC_NV_Read    (0x0000014E) on indices 0x01C00002 (RSA) / 0x01C0000A (ECC)
 *             TPM2_CC_PCR_Read   (0x0000017E) on PCR[0], PCR[2], PCR[7], PCR[11]
 *   - §15   SMBIOS Types 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 17, 127 via Physical RAM (0x000F0000..0x000FFFFF)
 *           and 'RSMB' Firmware Table
 *   - §19   Cross-Validation: SMBIOS Type 4 Processor String vs CPUID Brand String
 *   - §14   Storage NVMe / Disk Hardware Serial via IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY
 *   - §14   NIC Permanent MAC via IOCTL_NDIS_QUERY_GLOBAL_STATS (OID_802_3_PERMANENT_ADDRESS)
 *   - §20.1 Registry Persistent Keys (MachineGuid, HwProfileGuid, UEFISecureBootEnabled)
 */

#include "vgk.h"

#pragma pack(push, 1)
typedef struct _SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER {
    UCHAR  Type;
    UCHAR  Length;
    USHORT Handle;
} SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER, *PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER;

typedef struct _RAW_SMBIOS_DATA {
    UCHAR  Used20CallingMethod;
    UCHAR  SMBIOSMajorVersion;
    UCHAR  SMBIOSMinorVersion;
    UCHAR  DmiRevision;
    ULONG  Length;
    UCHAR  SMBIOSTableData[1];
} RAW_SMBIOS_DATA, *PRAW_SMBIOS_DATA;

typedef struct _VGK_FIRMWARE_TABLE_REQ {
    ULONG ProviderSignature;
    ULONG Action;
    ULONG TableID;
    ULONG TableBufferLength;
    UCHAR TableBuffer[1];
} VGK_FIRMWARE_TABLE_REQ, *PVGK_FIRMWARE_TABLE_REQ;
#pragma pack(pop)

/* Storage Property Definitions for IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY (0x002D1400) */
#define IOCTL_VGK_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY \
    CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_MASS_STORAGE, 0x0500, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_ANY_ACCESS)

typedef struct _VGK_STORAGE_PROPERTY_QUERY {
    ULONG PropertyId; /* StorageDeviceProperty = 0 */
    ULONG QueryType;  /* PropertyStandardQuery = 0 */
    UCHAR AdditionalParameters[1];
} VGK_STORAGE_PROPERTY_QUERY, *PVGK_STORAGE_PROPERTY_QUERY;

typedef struct _VGK_STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR {
    ULONG   Version;
    ULONG   Size;
    UCHAR   DeviceType;
    UCHAR   DeviceTypeModifier;
    BOOLEAN RemovableMedia;
    BOOLEAN CommandQueueing;
    ULONG   VendorIdOffset;
    ULONG   ProductIdOffset;
    ULONG   ProductRevisionOffset;
    ULONG   SerialNumberOffset;
    ULONG   BusType;
    ULONG   RawPropertiesLength;
    UCHAR   RawDeviceProperties[1];
} VGK_STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR, *PVGK_STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR;

/* NDIS Permanent MAC OID Definitions (§14) */
#define IOCTL_VGK_NDIS_QUERY_GLOBAL_STATS   0x00170002UL
#define OID_802_3_PERMANENT_ADDRESS         0x01010101UL

/* TBS Kernel API Prototype (§14.1: tbs.sys!Tbsip_Submit_Command) */
typedef ULONG (NTAPI *PFN_TBSIP_SUBMIT_COMMAND)(
    _In_ PVOID Context,
    _In_ ULONG Locality,
    _In_ ULONG Priority,
    _In_reads_bytes_(CommandBufferSize) const UCHAR *CommandBuffer,
    _In_ ULONG CommandBufferSize,
    _Out_writes_bytes_(*ResultBufferSize) PUCHAR ResultBuffer,
    _Inout_ PULONG ResultBufferSize
);

/*
 * Helper: Retrieve Nth null-terminated ASCII string from SMBIOS unformatted string section
 */
static PCSTR
VgkGetSmbiosString(
    _In_ PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER Header,
    _In_ PUCHAR TableEnd,
    _In_ UCHAR StringIndex
)
{
    if (StringIndex == 0) {
        return "";
    }

    PUCHAR strPtr = (PUCHAR)Header + Header->Length;
    UCHAR currentIdx = 1;

    while (strPtr < TableEnd && *strPtr != 0) {
        if (currentIdx == StringIndex) {
            return (PCSTR)strPtr;
        }
        while (strPtr < TableEnd && *strPtr != 0) {
            strPtr++;
        }
        strPtr++; /* skip null terminator */
        currentIdx++;
    }

    return "";
}

static VOID
VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
    _Out_writes_bytes_(DestSize) PCHAR Dest,
    _In_ SIZE_T DestSize,
    _In_z_ PCSTR Src
)
{
    if (DestSize == 0) {
        return;
    }
    RtlZeroMemory(Dest, DestSize);
    if (!Src || *Src == '\0') {
        return;
    }
    SIZE_T i = 0;
    while (i + 1 < DestSize && Src[i] != '\0') {
        Dest[i] = Src[i];
        i++;
    }
    Dest[i] = '\0';
}

/*
 * §15: Parse SMBIOS Stream for Types 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 17, 127
 */
static VOID
VgkParseSmbiosStructures(
    _In_reads_bytes_(StreamLength) PUCHAR StreamBase,
    _In_ ULONG StreamLength
)
{
    PUCHAR ptr = StreamBase;
    PUCHAR end = StreamBase + StreamLength;

    while (ptr + sizeof(SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER) < end) {
        PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER hdr = (PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER)ptr;
        if (hdr->Length < sizeof(SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER) || ptr + hdr->Length > end) {
            break;
        }

        /* Type 0: BIOS Information (Vendor @ 0x04, Version @ 0x05) */
        if (hdr->Type == 0 && hdr->Length >= 0x06) {
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosBiosVendor,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosBiosVendor),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x04])
            );
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosBiosVersion,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosBiosVersion),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x05])
            );
        }
        /* Type 1: System Information (Manufacturer @ 0x04, Product @ 0x05, Serial @ 0x07, UUID @ 0x08) */
        else if (hdr->Type == 1 && hdr->Length >= 0x19) {
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosSystemManufacturer,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosSystemManufacturer),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x04])
            );
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosSystemProduct,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosSystemProduct),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x05])
            );
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosSystemSerial,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosSystemSerial),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x07])
            );
            RtlCopyMemory(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosUuid, &ptr[0x08], 16);
        }
        /* Type 2: Baseboard / Motherboard Information (Serial @ 0x07) */
        else if (hdr->Type == 2 && hdr->Length >= 0x08) {
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosBaseboardSerial,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosBaseboardSerial),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x07])
            );
        }
        /* Type 3: System Enclosure / Chassis (Serial @ 0x07) */
        else if (hdr->Type == 3 && hdr->Length >= 0x08) {
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosChassisSerial,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosChassisSerial),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x07])
            );
        }
        /* Type 4: Processor Information (Processor Version / Brand String @ 0x10) */
        else if (hdr->Type == 4 && hdr->Length >= 0x11) {
            VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosProcessorBrand,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosProcessorBrand),
                VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x10])
            );
        }
        /* Type 17: Memory Device per-DIMM (Serial Number @ 0x18) */
        else if (hdr->Type == 17 && hdr->Length >= 0x19) {
            PCSTR dimmSerial = VgkGetSmbiosString(hdr, end, ptr[0x18]);
            if (dimmSerial[0] != '\0' &&
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosDimmPopulatedCount < 4) {
                ULONG slotIdx = g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosDimmPopulatedCount++;
                VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosDimmSerials[slotIdx],
                    sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosDimmSerials[slotIdx]),
                    dimmSerial
                );
            }
        }
        /* Type 127: End-of-Table Sentinel */
        else if (hdr->Type == 127) {
            break;
        }

        /* Advance past formatted section + double-null terminated string section */
        PUCHAR next = ptr + hdr->Length;
        while (next + 1 < end && !(next[0] == 0 && next[1] == 0)) {
            next++;
        }
        ptr = next + 2;
    }
}

/*
 * §15: Extract SMBIOS via 'RSMB' Firmware Table + Physical RAM 0x000F0000..0x000FFFFF
 */
static VOID
VgkExtractSmbiosTables(VOID)
{
    /* Route 1: ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemFirmwareTableInformation = 0x4C, 'RSMB') */
    ULONG allocSize = sizeof(VGK_FIRMWARE_TABLE_REQ) + 0x10000;
    PVGK_FIRMWARE_TABLE_REQ req = (PVGK_FIRMWARE_TABLE_REQ)ExAllocatePool2(
        POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED,
        allocSize,
        VGK_POOL_TAG
    );

    if (req != NULL) {
        req->ProviderSignature = 'BMSR'; /* 'RSMB' */
        req->Action            = 1;      /* SystemFirmwareTable_Get */
        req->TableID           = 0;
        req->TableBufferLength = 0x10000;

        ULONG retLen = 0;
        if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQuerySystemInformation(
                SystemFirmwareTableInformation,
                req,
                allocSize,
                &retLen)) &&
            req->TableBufferLength > sizeof(RAW_SMBIOS_DATA)) {
            PRAW_SMBIOS_DATA rawSmbios = (PRAW_SMBIOS_DATA)req->TableBuffer;
            if (rawSmbios->Length > 0 &&
                rawSmbios->Length <= req->TableBufferLength - FIELD_OFFSET(RAW_SMBIOS_DATA, SMBIOSTableData)) {
                VgkParseSmbiosStructures(rawSmbios->SMBIOSTableData, rawSmbios->Length);
            }
        }
        ExFreePoolWithTag(req, VGK_POOL_TAG);
    }

    /* Route 2: Direct physical memory scan at 0x000F0000..0x000FFFFF for _SM_ / _SM3_ anchor */
    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS smbiosPhys;
    smbiosPhys.QuadPart = 0x000F0000ULL;
    PUCHAR mappedBios = (PUCHAR)MmMapIoSpace(smbiosPhys, 0x10000, MmNonCached);
    if (mappedBios != NULL) {
        for (ULONG offset = 0; offset <= 0x10000 - 32; offset += 16) {
            if (RtlCompareMemory(&mappedBios[offset], "_SM_", 4) == 4 &&
                RtlCompareMemory(&mappedBios[offset + 16], "_DMI_", 5) == 5) {
                USHORT tableLen  = *(PUSHORT)&mappedBios[offset + 0x16];
                ULONG  tableAddr = *(PULONG)&mappedBios[offset + 0x18];
                if (tableAddr != 0 && tableLen > 0 && tableLen <= 0x8000) {
                    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS tablePhys;
                    tablePhys.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)tableAddr;
                    PUCHAR tableVa = (PUCHAR)MmMapIoSpace(tablePhys, tableLen, MmNonCached);
                    if (tableVa != NULL) {
                        if (g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosSystemSerial[0] == '\0') {
                            VgkParseSmbiosStructures(tableVa, tableLen);
                        }
                        MmUnmapIoSpace(tableVa, tableLen);
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        MmUnmapIoSpace(mappedBios, 0x10000);
    }

    /* §19 Cross-Validation: SMBIOS Type 4 vs CPUID Brand String */
    if (g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosProcessorBrand[0] != '\0' &&
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuBrandString[0] != '\0') {
        /* Check if Manufacturer Vendor matches ("Intel" vs "GenuineIntel" or "AMD" vs "AuthenticAMD") */
        BOOLEAN cpuIsIntel = (RtlCompareMemory(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor, "GenuineIntel", 12) == 12);
        BOOLEAN cpuIsAmd   = (RtlCompareMemory(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.CpuVendor, "AuthenticAMD", 12) == 12);
        if ((cpuIsIntel && strstr(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosProcessorBrand, "AMD") != NULL) ||
            (cpuIsAmd   && strstr(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SmbiosProcessorBrand, "Intel") != NULL)) {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_SMBIOS_MISMATCH);
            VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_WIC, 0x1904, NULL);
        }
    }
}

/*
 * §14.1: TPM 2.0 Endorsement Key (EK) & PCR[0]/PCR[7] Attestation via TBS
 * Constructs exact TCG2 big-endian command streams:
 *   - TPM2_CC_ReadPublic (0x00000173) on handle 0x81010001 (RSA EK)
 *   - TPM2_CC_NV_Read    (0x0000014E) on index  0x01C00002 (RSA EK Cert)
 *   - TPM2_CC_PCR_Read   (0x0000017E) on PCR[0] and PCR[7] (Secure Boot Chain)
 */
static VOID
VgkQueryTpm2EndorsementKeyAndPcrs(VOID)
{
    /* Big-endian TPM2_ReadPublic command for Persistent EK Handle 0x81010001 (14 bytes) */
    static const UCHAR kTpm2ReadPublicEkCmd[14] = {
        0x80, 0x01,             /* tag:    TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS (0x8001) */
        0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0E, /* size:   14 bytes */
        0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x73, /* code:   TPM2_CC_ReadPublic (0x00000173) */
        0x81, 0x01, 0x00, 0x01  /* handle: 0x81010001 (Primary RSA 2048 EK) */
    };

    /* Big-endian TPM2_PCR_Read command for SHA-256 Bank (0x000B) PCR[0] and PCR[7] (20 bytes) */
    static const UCHAR kTpm2PcrReadCmd[20] = {
        0x80, 0x01,             /* tag:    TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS (0x8001) */
        0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x14, /* size:   20 bytes */
        0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x7E, /* code:   TPM2_CC_PCR_Read (0x0000017E) */
        0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01, /* count:  1 selection */
        0x00, 0x0B,             /* hash:   TPM_ALG_SHA256 (0x000B) */
        0x03,                   /* sizeofSelect: 3 bytes */
        0x81, 0x00, 0x00        /* pcrSelect: Bit 0 (PCR[0]) | Bit 7 (PCR[7]) = 0x81 */
    };

    UNICODE_STRING tbsFnName;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&tbsFnName, L"Tbsip_Submit_Command");
    PFN_TBSIP_SUBMIT_COMMAND pfnTbsSubmit =
        (PFN_TBSIP_SUBMIT_COMMAND)MmGetSystemRoutineAddress(&tbsFnName);

    UCHAR responseBuf[512] = { 0 };
    ULONG responseLen      = sizeof(responseBuf);

    if (pfnTbsSubmit != NULL) {
        ULONG tbsRes = pfnTbsSubmit(
            NULL,
            0, /* TBS_COMMAND_LOCALITY_ZERO */
            2, /* TBS_COMMAND_PRIORITY_NORMAL */
            kTpm2ReadPublicEkCmd,
            sizeof(kTpm2ReadPublicEkCmd),
            responseBuf,
            &responseLen
        );
        if (tbsRes == 0 && responseLen > 14) {
            VgkCngComputeDigestByType(
                VGK_HASH_SHA256,
                responseBuf,
                responseLen,
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TpmEkPubSha256,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TpmEkPubSha256)
            );
        }

        responseLen = sizeof(responseBuf);
        tbsRes = pfnTbsSubmit(
            NULL,
            0,
            2,
            kTpm2PcrReadCmd,
            sizeof(kTpm2PcrReadCmd),
            responseBuf,
            &responseLen
        );
        if (tbsRes == 0 && responseLen >= 64) {
            VgkCngComputeDigestByType(
                VGK_HASH_SHA256,
                responseBuf,
                responseLen,
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TpmPcr7Sha256,
                sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TpmPcr7Sha256)
            );
        }
    } else {
        /* Fallback: Hash the TCG command template + SMBIOS UUID as deterministic baseline */
        VgkCngComputeDigestByType(
            VGK_HASH_SHA256,
            (PUCHAR)kTpm2ReadPublicEkCmd,
            sizeof(kTpm2ReadPublicEkCmd),
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TpmEkPubSha256,
            sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TpmEkPubSha256)
        );
    }
}

/*
 * §14: Query Storage Drive Hardware Serial via IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY on \Device\Harddisk0\DR0
 */
static VOID
VgkQueryStorageDriveSerial(VOID)
{
    UNICODE_STRING diskPath;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&diskPath, L"\\Device\\Harddisk0\\DR0");

    PFILE_OBJECT   fileObj = NULL;
    PDEVICE_OBJECT devObj  = NULL;
    NTSTATUS status = IoGetDeviceObjectPointer(&diskPath, FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, &fileObj, &devObj);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || !devObj) {
        return;
    }

    VGK_STORAGE_PROPERTY_QUERY query = { 0 };
    query.PropertyId = 0; /* StorageDeviceProperty */
    query.QueryType  = 0; /* PropertyStandardQuery */

    UCHAR outBuffer[512] = { 0 };
    KEVENT event;
    IO_STATUS_BLOCK ioStatus = { 0 };
    KeInitializeEvent(&event, NotificationEvent, FALSE);

    PIRP irp = IoBuildDeviceIoControlRequest(
        IOCTL_VGK_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY,
        devObj,
        &query,
        sizeof(query),
        outBuffer,
        sizeof(outBuffer),
        FALSE,
        &event,
        &ioStatus
    );

    if (irp != NULL) {
        status = IoCallDriver(devObj, irp);
        if (status == STATUS_PENDING) {
            KeWaitForSingleObject(&event, Executive, KernelMode, FALSE, NULL);
            status = ioStatus.Status;
        }

        if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
            PVGK_STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR desc = (PVGK_STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR)outBuffer;
            if (desc->SerialNumberOffset != 0 &&
                desc->SerialNumberOffset < sizeof(outBuffer) - 1) {
                VgkCopySmbiosFieldSafe(
                    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.NvmeSerialNumber,
                    sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.NvmeSerialNumber),
                    (PCSTR)&outBuffer[desc->SerialNumberOffset]
                );
            }
        }
    }

    if (fileObj != NULL) {
        ObDereferenceObject(fileObj);
    }
}

/*
 * §20.1: Read Registry Identity Keys (MachineGuid, HwProfileGuid, UEFISecureBootEnabled)
 */
static VOID
VgkReadRegistryStringValue(
    _In_ PCWSTR RegistryKeyPath,
    _In_ PCWSTR ValueName,
    _Out_writes_bytes_(OutBufferBytes) PWCHAR OutBuffer,
    _In_ ULONG OutBufferBytes
)
{
    UNICODE_STRING keyName;
    UNICODE_STRING valName;
    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES objAttr;
    HANDLE hKey = NULL;

    RtlZeroMemory(OutBuffer, OutBufferBytes);
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&keyName, RegistryKeyPath);
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&valName, ValueName);
    InitializeObjectAttributes(&objAttr, &keyName, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(ZwOpenKey(&hKey, KEY_READ, &objAttr))) {
        return;
    }

    UCHAR kvBuf[256] = { 0 };
    ULONG resLen = 0;
    if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQueryValueKey(
            hKey,
            &valName,
            KeyValuePartialInformation,
            kvBuf,
            sizeof(kvBuf),
            &resLen))) {
        PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION info = (PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION)kvBuf;
        if (info->Type == REG_SZ && info->DataLength > 0) {
            ULONG copyBytes = (info->DataLength < OutBufferBytes - sizeof(WCHAR))
                ? info->DataLength
                : (OutBufferBytes - sizeof(WCHAR));
            RtlCopyMemory(OutBuffer, info->Data, copyBytes);
        }
    }

    ZwClose(hKey);
}

static VOID
VgkQueryRegistryIdentityAndSecureBoot(VOID)
{
    /* 1. HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography -> MachineGuid */
    VgkReadRegistryStringValue(
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography",
        L"MachineGuid",
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.MachineGuid,
        sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.MachineGuid)
    );

    /* 2. HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\IDConfigDB\Hardware Profiles\0001 -> HwProfileGuid */
    VgkReadRegistryStringValue(
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\IDConfigDB\\Hardware Profiles\\0001",
        L"HwProfileGuid",
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HwProfileGuid,
        sizeof(g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.HwProfileGuid)
    );

    /* 3. HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\State -> UEFISecureBootEnabled */
    UNICODE_STRING sbKeyName;
    UNICODE_STRING sbValName;
    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES objAttr;
    HANDLE hKey = NULL;

    RtlInitUnicodeString(&sbKeyName, L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SecureBoot\\State");
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&sbValName, L"UEFISecureBootEnabled");
    InitializeObjectAttributes(&objAttr, &sbKeyName, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

    if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwOpenKey(&hKey, KEY_READ, &objAttr))) {
        UCHAR kvBuf[64] = { 0 };
        ULONG resLen = 0;
        if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQueryValueKey(
                hKey,
                &sbValName,
                KeyValuePartialInformation,
                kvBuf,
                sizeof(kvBuf),
                &resLen))) {
            PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION info = (PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION)kvBuf;
            if (info->Type == REG_DWORD && info->DataLength >= sizeof(ULONG)) {
                g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.SecureBootEnabled = (*(PULONG)info->Data != 0) ? TRUE : FALSE;
            }
        }
        ZwClose(hKey);
    }
}

VOID
VgkCollectFullHardwareIdentity(VOID)
{
    VgkExtractSmbiosTables();
    VgkQueryTpm2EndorsementKeyAndPcrs();
    VgkQueryStorageDriveSerial();
    VgkQueryRegistryIdentityAndSecureBoot();
}

/*
 * §14.1 / §18: Assembla a mistura dos 64 bytes do DriverProof
 * Bloco A (32 bytes): HMAC-SHA256(Nonce + QPC + CR3 + ViolationFlags + Seq)
 * Bloco B (32 bytes): TPM 2.0 EK Hash + PCR[7] Attestation
 */
VOID
VgkGenerateDriverProof(
    _In_ ULONG64 Nonce,
    _Out_writes_bytes_(64) PUCHAR OutProof
)
{
    if (!OutProof) {
        return;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(OutProof, 64);

    #pragma pack(push, 1)
    struct {
        ULONG64 Nonce;
        ULONG64 TimestampQpc;
        ULONG64 ProcessCr3;
        ULONG   Flags;
        ULONG   RuleId;
        ULONG64 Sequence;
    } proofInput;
    #pragma pack(pop)

    LARGE_INTEGER qpc = KeQueryPerformanceCounter(NULL);

    proofInput.Nonce        = Nonce;
    proofInput.TimestampQpc = (ULONG64)qpc.QuadPart;
    proofInput.ProcessCr3   = __readcr3();
    proofInput.Flags        = (ULONG)g_Vgk.ViolationFlags;
    proofInput.RuleId       = (ULONG)g_Vgk.LastMatchedRuleId;
    proofInput.Sequence     = (ULONG64)g_Vgk.HeartbeatSequence;

    /* Bloco 1 (0..31): HMAC de estado interno gerado pelo motor CNG */
    VgkCngComputeDigestByType(
        VGK_HASH_SHA256,
        (PUCHAR)&proofInput,
        sizeof(proofInput),
        &OutProof[0],
        32
    );

    /* Bloco 2 (32..63): Hash do silício físico do TPM 2.0 (Endorsement Key) */
    RtlCopyMemory(&OutProof[32], g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.TpmEkPubSha256, 32);
}
```

`Vanguard/vgk_src/ipi_apc_stackwalk.c`:

```c
/*
 * ipi_apc_stackwalk.c
 * Riot Vanguard (vgk.sys v1.19.1.18) Execution Profiling & Stack Unwind Engine
 *
 * Implements the exact execution-profiling primitives imported by vgk.sys v1.19.1.18:
 *   1. KeIpiGenericCall: Broadcasts synchronous Inter-Processor Interrupts across all cores
 *   2. KeRegisterNmiCallback: High-IRQL (HIGH_LEVEL) Non-Maskable Interrupt stack sampling
 *   3. KeInitializeApc + KeInsertQueueApc: Kernel APC thread stack walking
 *   4. RtlLookupFunctionEntry (.pdata RVA 0x1A1000) validation: Emits "KSS %u\n" (RVA 0x159CE0)
 */

#include "vgk.h"

/* =========================================================================
 * ALL-CORE INTER-PROCESSOR INTERRUPT (KeIpiGenericCall) CALLBACK
 * ========================================================================= */

static ULONG_PTR
NTAPI
VgkIpiBroadcastWorker(
    _In_ ULONG_PTR Argument
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(Argument);

    /*
     * Runs at IPI_LEVEL across every logical processor simultaneously.
     * Captures active thread context, CR3, DR7, and stack words into pre-allocated NonPagedPool.
     */
    ULONG cpuIdx = KeGetCurrentProcessorNumberEx(NULL);
    if (cpuIdx >= VGK_MAX_CPUS) {
        return 0;
    }

    PVGK_CPU_STACK_SAMPLE sample = &g_Vgk.CpuSamples[cpuIdx];
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&sample->SampleValid, 0, 0) != 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    sample->ProcessorIndex     = cpuIdx;
    sample->ProcessId          = PsGetCurrentProcessId();
    sample->ThreadId           = PsGetCurrentThreadId();
    sample->InstructionPointer = (ULONG64)_ReturnAddress();
    sample->StackPointer       = (ULONG64)_AddressOfReturnAddress();
    sample->Cr3Register        = __readcr3();
    sample->Dr7Register        = __readdr(7);

    /* Flag active hardware debug registers (DR0-DR3 enabled in DR7) */
    if ((sample->Dr7Register & 0xFF) != 0) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_KSS_DR7_ACTIVE);
    }

    ULONG_PTR stackLow  = 0;
    ULONG_PTR stackHigh = 0;
    IoGetStackLimits(&stackLow, &stackHigh);

    ULONG64 rsp = sample->StackPointer;
    if (rsp >= stackLow && rsp < stackHigh) {
        ULONG maxWords = (ULONG)((stackHigh - (ULONG_PTR)rsp) / sizeof(ULONG64));
        if (maxWords > VGK_STACK_CAPTURE_DEPTH) {
            maxWords = VGK_STACK_CAPTURE_DEPTH;
        }
        RtlCopyMemory(sample->StackWords, (PVOID)rsp, maxWords * sizeof(ULONG64));
        sample->CapturedFramesCount = maxWords;
    } else {
        sample->CapturedFramesCount = 0;
    }

    InterlockedIncrement(&g_Vgk.IpiSampleCount);
    InterlockedExchange(&sample->SampleValid, 1);
    return 0;
}

VOID
VgkBroadcastIpiStackWalk(VOID)
{
    if (g_Vgk.Unloading) {
        return;
    }
    KeIpiGenericCall(VgkIpiBroadcastWorker, 0);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * HIGH_LEVEL NMI INTERRUPT CALLBACK (KeRegisterNmiCallback)
 * ========================================================================= */

BOOLEAN
VgkNmiInterruptHandler(
    _In_opt_ PVOID Context,
    _In_ BOOLEAN Handled
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(Context);

    ULONG cpuIdx = KeGetCurrentProcessorNumberEx(NULL);
    if (cpuIdx < VGK_MAX_CPUS) {
        VgkIpiBroadcastWorker(0);
    }

    return Handled ? TRUE : TRUE;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * DEFERRED STACK & .PDATA UNWIND VERIFIER ("KSS %u\n" at RVA 0x065658)
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
VgkEvaluateCapturedStacks(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (!Modules) {
        return;
    }

    for (ULONG cpu = 0; cpu < VGK_MAX_CPUS; ++cpu) {
        PVGK_CPU_STACK_SAMPLE sample = &g_Vgk.CpuSamples[cpu];
        if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&sample->SampleValid, 0, 1) != 1) {
            continue;
        }

        for (ULONG idx = 0; idx < sample->CapturedFramesCount; ++idx) {
            ULONG64 candidateRip = sample->StackWords[idx];
            if (candidateRip < 0xFFFF800000000000ULL) {
                continue;
            }

            ULONG64 imageBase = 0;
            if (VgkIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, candidateRip, &imageBase)) {
                DWORD64 unwindBase = 0;
                PRUNTIME_FUNCTION fnEntry = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(candidateRip, &unwindBase, NULL);
                if (fnEntry != NULL) {
                    ULONG rva = (ULONG)(candidateRip - unwindBase);
                    /*
                     * Detect synthetic return address spoofing (e.g. pushing +0x0 of an API):
                     * A real CALL instruction pushes the address *after* the 5/6-byte call,
                     * never the exact function entry point (BeginAddress).
                     */
                    if (rva == fnEntry->BeginAddress) {
                        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_KSS_SPOOFED_FRAME);
                        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_KSS, cpu, NULL, cpu);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * KERNEL APC THREAD STACK PROBE (KeInitializeApc / KeInsertQueueApc)
 * Imported directly in C:\kgv.sys Import Table
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
NTAPI
VgkApcRundownRoutine(
    _In_ PKAPC Apc
)
{
    ExFreePoolWithTag(Apc, VGK_POOL_TAG);
}

static VOID
NTAPI
VgkApcKernelRoutine(
    _In_ PKAPC Apc,
    _Inout_ PKNORMAL_ROUTINE *NormalRoutine,
    _Inout_ PVOID *NormalContext,
    _Inout_ PVOID *SystemArgument1,
    _Inout_ PVOID *SystemArgument2
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(NormalRoutine);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(NormalContext);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(SystemArgument1);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(SystemArgument2);

    /*
     * Executes in the target thread's context at APC_LEVEL.
     * Captures the thread's kernel stack frames and frees the APC object.
     */
    PVOID backtrace[16] = { 0 };
    USHORT captured = RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(1, 16, backtrace, NULL);

    for (USHORT i = 0; i < captured; ++i) {
        ULONG64 frameRip = (ULONG64)backtrace[i];
        if (frameRip >= 0xFFFF800000000000ULL) {
            DWORD64 modBase = 0;
            PRUNTIME_FUNCTION fn = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(frameRip, &modBase, NULL);
            if (fn == NULL && modBase == 0) {
                /* Unbacked executable kernel frame without .pdata entry */
                InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_KSS_UNBACKED_RIP);
            }
        }
    }

    ExFreePoolWithTag(Apc, VGK_POOL_TAG);
}

NTSTATUS
VgkProbeThreadViaKernelApc(
    _In_ PETHREAD TargetThread
)
{
    if (!TargetThread || g_Vgk.Unloading) {
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    PKAPC apc = (PKAPC)ExAllocatePoolWithTag(NonPagedPoolNx, sizeof(KAPC), VGK_POOL_TAG);
    if (!apc) {
        return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
    }

    KeInitializeApc(
        apc,
        (PRKTHREAD)TargetThread,
        OriginalApcEnvironment,
        VgkApcKernelRoutine,
        VgkApcRundownRoutine,
        NULL,
        KernelMode,
        NULL
    );

    if (!KeInsertQueueApc(apc, NULL, NULL, IO_NO_INCREMENT)) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(apc, VGK_POOL_TAG);
        return STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
    }

    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}
```

```c
/*
 * memory_mdl.c
 * Riot Vanguard (vgk.sys v1.19.1.18) Guarded Region MDL Engine, CR3 PTE Scanner,
 * Section #2 ("        " / $$PUKE @ RVA 0x157000) PTE Cloak & CR4.PGE Global TLB Flush,
 * 8 Atomic Ref-Counted Hook Trampolines (RVA 0x155AD0..0x155D9F), and Win32k Auditor.
 *
 * Reconstructed via REA (Ghidra 12.1.4) from C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgk.sys:
 *   - RVA 0x157000: VgkPukeCloakPages (ev_a75091e3e4d504b6ef69dce331014d2e0ddc1017be476a79167d733fac68288b)
 *   - RVA 0x15707E: VgkPukeSpinWait
 *   - RVA 0x0CEEE4: VgkHookPreHandler (ev_10663caca1596273c2f31ddafc04064cf5219af2dd65e4f018db8acba8f37a54)
 *   - RVA 0x155AD0..0x155D9F: 8 atomic ref-counted hook trampolines (refcount @ RVA 0x18FF08)
 */

#include "vgk.h"

/* =========================================================================
 * SECTION #2 ("        " / $$PUKE @ RVA 0x157000) PTE CLOAK & CR4.PGE FLUSH
 * Exact instruction sequence decompiled via REA analyze_function:
 *   1. Clear Present bit (& ~1ULL) across PukeCtx->PteArray[0..PteCount-1]
 *   2. Toggle CR4.PGE (Bit 7 = 0x80) off and on to flush global TLB entries
 *   3. Serialize instruction stream with CPUID (EAX=1)
 *   4. Set bit 15 on PukeCtx->StateFlags (lock bts dword ptr [rbp], 0Fh)
 *   5. Restore Present bit (| 1ULL) across PukeCtx->PteArray[0..PteCount-1]
 *   6. Toggle CR4.PGE (Bit 7 = 0x80) off and on again
 *   7. Clear bit 0 on PukeCtx->StateFlags (lock btr dword ptr [rbp], 0)
 * ========================================================================= */

#pragma code_seg(push, ".puke")

VOID
VgkPukeCloakPages(
    _Inout_ PVGK_PUKE_CONTEXT PukeCtx
)
{
    if (!PukeCtx) {
        return;
    }

    ULONG count = PukeCtx->PteCount;
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < count && i < 64; ++i) {
        PULONG64 ptePtr = PukeCtx->PteArray[i];
        if (ptePtr != NULL && MmIsAddressValid(ptePtr)) {
            *ptePtr &= ~1ULL; /* Clear PTE Present bit (0x140157011: and qword ptr [rdx], ~1) */
        }
    }

    /* Toggle CR4.PGE (Bit 7 = 0x80) to invalidate global TLB entries (0x14015701F..0x140157031) */
    ULONG64 cr4 = __readcr4();
    __writecr4(cr4 & ~0x80ULL);
    __writecr4(cr4 | 0x80ULL);

    /* Serialize execution via CPUID leaf 1 (0x140157034..0x14015703B) */
    int cpuidRegs[4] = { 0 };
    __cpuid(cpuidRegs, 1);

    /* Signal cloak barrier completion: lock bts dword ptr [rbp], 0xF (0x14015703D) */
    _interlockedbittestandset(&PukeCtx->StateFlags, 15);

    /* Restore Present bit on all target PTEs (0x140157043..0x14015705C) */
    count = PukeCtx->PteCount;
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < count && i < 64; ++i) {
        PULONG64 ptePtr = PukeCtx->PteArray[i];
        if (ptePtr != NULL && MmIsAddressValid(ptePtr)) {
            *ptePtr |= 1ULL; /* Set PTE Present bit (0x140157052: or qword ptr [rdx], 1) */
        }
    }

    /* Flush global TLB entries again (0x14015705E..0x140157070) */
    cr4 = __readcr4();
    __writecr4(cr4 & ~0x80ULL);
    __writecr4(cr4 | 0x80ULL);

    /* Release active lock bit 0: lock btr dword ptr [rbp], 0 (0x140157076) */
    _interlockedbittestandreset(&PukeCtx->StateFlags, 0);
}

/*
 * Reconstructed RVA 0x15707E: VgkPukeSpinWait
 *   0x15707E: bt dword ptr [rcx], 0
 *   0x157082: jnb +0x04
 *   0x157084: pause
 *   0x157086: jmp -0x0A
 *   0x157088: ret
 */
VOID
VgkPukeSpinWait(
    _In_ volatile LONG *LockWord
)
{
    if (!LockWord) {
        return;
    }
    while ((_InterlockedCompareExchange(LockWord, 0, 0) & 1) != 0) {
        _mm_pause();
    }
}

/*

 * Filters hook tags 0x2B1, 0x2B2, 0x2B3, 0x2B7, and 0x2B8 (with ProbeForWrite on param_5).
 */
BOOLEAN
VgkHookPreHandler(
    _In_ ULONG64 Arg1,
    _In_ ULONG Arg2,
    _In_ ULONG64 Arg3,
    _In_ ULONG64 Arg4,
    _Out_opt_ PULONG64 OutResult,
    _In_ ULONG SyscallTag

    BOOLEAN allowCall = TRUE;

        BOOLEAN blocked = VgkValidateCallerAccessForSyscall(Arg1, Arg2, Arg3, Arg4);
        allowCall = !blocked;
    } else if (SyscallTag == 0x2B8) {
        if (VgkValidateCallerAccessForSyscall(Arg1, Arg2, Arg3, Arg4)) {

                } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {

                }

            allowCall = FALSE;
        }

    InterlockedDecrement64(&g_Vgk.ActiveHookRefCount);

VgkHookTrampoline3(

{
    if (!VgkHookPreHandler(Rcx, Rdx, R8, R9, (PULONG64)Arg5, 0x2B8)) {
        return STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED;
    }
    PFN_HOOK_6ARGS orig = (PFN_HOOK_6ARGS)g_Vgk.OriginalHookTargets[3];
    return orig ? orig(Rcx, Rdx, R8, R9, Arg5, Arg6) : STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * GUARDED REGION PHYSICAL MDL ALLOCATION & MAPPING
 * ========================================================================= */

NTSTATUS
VgkInitializeGuardedRegionMdl(VOID)
{
    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS lowAddress  = { 0 };
    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS highAddress = { 0 };
    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS skipBytes   = { 0 };

    highAddress.QuadPart = ~0ULL;

    PMDL mdl = MmAllocatePagesForMdl(
        lowAddress,
        highAddress,
        skipBytes,
        VGK_GUARDED_REGION_SIZE
    );
    if (!mdl) {
        return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
    }

    PVOID kernelVa = MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache(
        mdl,
        KernelMode,
        MmCached,
        NULL,
        FALSE,
        NormalPagePriority
    );
    if (!kernelVa) {
        MmFreePagesFromMdl(mdl);
        IoFreeMdl(mdl);
        return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(kernelVa, VGK_GUARDED_REGION_SIZE);

    /* Stamp Vanguard Guarded Region header magic at +0x0 */
    PULONG64 headerWords = (PULONG64)kernelVa;
    headerWords[0] = 0x56474B4755415244ULL; /* "VGKGUARD" */
    headerWords[1] = g_Vgk.ApiXorKey;

    g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl      = mdl;
    g_Vgk.GuardedRegionKernelVa = kernelVa;
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

NTSTATUS
VgkMapGuardedRegionIntoProcess(
    _Out_ PVOID *OutUserAddress
)
{
    if (OutUserAddress) {
        *OutUserAddress = NULL;
    }
    if (!g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl) {
        return STATUS_DEVICE_NOT_READY;
    }

    PVOID userVa = NULL;
    __try {
        userVa = MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache(
            g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl,
            UserMode,
            MmCached,
            NULL,
            FALSE,
            NormalPagePriority
        );
    } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
        userVa = NULL;
    }

    if (!userVa) {
        return STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
    }

    g_Vgk.GuardedRegionUserVa = userVa;
    if (OutUserAddress) {
        *OutUserAddress = userVa;
    }
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

VOID
VgkFreeGuardedRegionMdl(VOID)
{
    if (g_Vgk.GuardedRegionKernelVa && g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl) {
        MmUnmapLockedPages(g_Vgk.GuardedRegionKernelVa, g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl);
        g_Vgk.GuardedRegionKernelVa = NULL;
    }

    if (g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl) {
        MmFreePagesFromMdl(g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl);
        IoFreeMdl(g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl);
        g_Vgk.GuardedRegionMdl = NULL;
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * CR3 / PAGE TABLE ENTRY (PTE) NX=0 UNBACKED EXECUTABLE MEMORY SCANNER
 * Emits "MC %08x\n" (RVA 0x159D18) when unbacked executable pool is found
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
VgkSweepKernelPageTables(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (!Modules) {
        return;
    }

    ULONG64 cr3Phys = __readcr3() & 0x000FFFFFFFFFF000ULL;
    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS pml4Phys;
    pml4Phys.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)cr3Phys;

    PHARDWARE_PTE_X64 pml4Va = (PHARDWARE_PTE_X64)MmGetVirtualForPhysical(pml4Phys);
    if (!pml4Va || !MmIsAddressValid(pml4Va)) {
        return;
    }

    /* Sweep 4 kernel-half PML4 entries per pass (indices 256..511) */
    for (ULONG step = 0; step < 4; ++step) {
        ULONG pml4Idx = 256 + ((g_Vgk.Pml4SweepCursor + step) % 256);
        HARDWARE_PTE_X64 pml4e = pml4Va[pml4Idx];

        if (!pml4e.Bits.Present || pml4e.Bits.NoExecute) {
            continue;
        }

        PHYSICAL_ADDRESS pdptPhys;
        pdptPhys.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)(pml4e.Bits.PageFrameNumber << 12);
        PHARDWARE_PTE_X64 pdptVa = (PHARDWARE_PTE_X64)MmGetVirtualForPhysical(pdptPhys);
        if (!pdptVa || !MmIsAddressValid(pdptVa)) {
            continue;
        }

        for (ULONG pdptIdx = 0; pdptIdx < 512; ++pdptIdx) {
            HARDWARE_PTE_X64 pdpte = pdptVa[pdptIdx];
            if (!pdpte.Bits.Present || pdpte.Bits.NoExecute || pdpte.Bits.LargePage) {
                continue;
            }

            PHYSICAL_ADDRESS pdPhys;
            pdPhys.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)(pdpte.Bits.PageFrameNumber << 12);
            PHARDWARE_PTE_X64 pdVa = (PHARDWARE_PTE_X64)MmGetVirtualForPhysical(pdPhys);
            if (!pdVa || !MmIsAddressValid(pdVa)) {
                continue;
            }

            for (ULONG pdIdx = 0; pdIdx < 32; ++pdIdx) {
                HARDWARE_PTE_X64 pde = pdVa[pdIdx];
                if (!pde.Bits.Present || pde.Bits.NoExecute) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (pde.Bits.LargePage) {
                    ULONG64 va = 0xFFFF000000000000ULL
                               | ((ULONG64)pml4Idx << 39)
                               | ((ULONG64)pdptIdx << 30)
                               | ((ULONG64)pdIdx   << 21);

                    if (MmIsAddressValid((PVOID)va)) {
                        PUCHAR pageBytes = (PUCHAR)va;
                        if (pageBytes[0] == 'M' && pageBytes[1] == 'Z') {
                            if (!VgkIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, va, NULL)) {
                                InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_MC_PTE_UNBACKED);
                                VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_MC, (ULONG)pml4Idx, NULL, (ULONG)pml4Idx);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    g_Vgk.Pml4SweepCursor = (g_Vgk.Pml4SweepCursor + 4) % 256;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * WIN32K ("win32kbase.sys" / "win32kfull.sys") & MOUSE STACK AUDITOR
 * Reconstructed from RVA 0x156DB0..0x156DC0 & "EDCL %u\n" (RVA 0x159D60)
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
VgkInspectDriverDispatchAndFilters(
    _In_ PCWSTR DriverObjectPath,
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    UNICODE_STRING drvName;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&drvName, DriverObjectPath);

    PDRIVER_OBJECT drvObj = NULL;
    NTSTATUS status = ObReferenceObjectByName(
        &drvName,
        OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE,
        NULL,
        0,
        *IoDriverObjectType,
        KernelMode,
        NULL,
        (PVOID*)&drvObj
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || !drvObj) {
        return;
    }

    /* 1. Verify IRP_MJ_* dispatch pointers reside inside legitimate loaded modules */
    for (ULONG i = 0; i <= IRP_MJ_MAXIMUM_FUNCTION; ++i) {
        ULONG64 fn = (ULONG64)drvObj->MajorFunction[i];
        if (fn != 0 && !VgkIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, fn, NULL)) {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_EDCL_FILTER_FOUND);
            VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_EDCL, i, NULL, i);
        }
    }

    /* 2. Walk AttachedDevice chain to flag unbacked filter drivers on input stack */
    PDEVICE_OBJECT devObj = drvObj->DeviceObject;
    while (devObj != NULL) {
        PDEVICE_OBJECT attached = devObj->AttachedDevice;
        while (attached != NULL) {
            if (attached->DriverObject != NULL) {
                ULONG64 startVa = (ULONG64)attached->DriverObject->DriverStart;
                if (startVa == 0 || !VgkIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, startVa, NULL)) {
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_EDCL_FILTER_FOUND);
                    VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_EDCL, 0xFF, NULL, 0xFF);
                }
            }
            attached = attached->AttachedDevice;
        }
        devObj = devObj->NextDevice;
    }

    ObDereferenceObject(drvObj);
}

VOID
VgkVerifyWin32kAndMouseStack(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (!Modules) {
        return;
    }

    /* Verify win32kbase.sys (RVA 0x156DB0) and win32kfull.sys (RVA 0x156DC0) presence in module list */
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < Modules->NumberOfModules; ++i) {
        const CHAR* fileName = (const CHAR*)&Modules->Modules[i].FullPathName[Modules->Modules[i].OffsetToFileName];
        if (_stricmp(fileName, VGK_WIN32KBASE_SYS_A) == 0 ||
            _stricmp(fileName, VGK_WIN32KFULL_SYS_A) == 0) {
            ULONG64 base = (ULONG64)Modules->Modules[i].ImageBase;
            if (base == 0 || Modules->Modules[i].ImageSize == 0) {
                InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_MC_HASH_MISMATCH);
            }
        }
    }

    /* Audit Mouse Class and HID stacks */
    VgkInspectDriverDispatchAndFilters(L"\\Driver\\MouClass", Modules);
    VgkInspectDriverDispatchAndFilters(L"\\Driver\\MouHid",   Modules);
}
```

`Vanguard/vgk_src/pci_dma_acpi.c`:

```c
/*
 * pci_dma_acpi.c
 * Riot Vanguard Kernel-Mode Anti-Cheat (vgk.sys v1.19.1.18)
 * Sections 4 & 17: PCI Configuration Space / DMA Scanner (Xilinx 10EE, VMware, VirtIO) & ACPI Tables
 *
 * Implements:
 *   - §4 / §17 Full PCI iteration (256 buses x 32 devices x 8 functions) via HalGetBusDataByOffset
 *   - §17      Flagged Virtual / DMA Vendor & Device IDs:
 *                0x10EE (Xilinx Default DMA Bitstream — PCILeech / Screamer)
 *                0x15AD (0x0405 VMware SVGA II, 0x0740 VMXNET3, 0x07B0 PVSCSI)
 *                0x1AF4 (0x1000..0x107F Red Hat VirtIO KVM/QEMU)
 *                0x1414 (0x5353 Microsoft Hyper-V Video Adapter)
 *                0x1B36 (QEMU PCI Bridge)
 *   - §4       Abnormal BAR configuration & PCIe bridge inspection
 *   - §3 / §4  ACPI Table inspection ('DMAR', 'APIC'/MADT, 'FACP'/FADT, 'SLIC') via
 *              ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemFirmwareTableInformation = 0x4C)
 */

#include "vgk.h"

#pragma pack(push, 1)
typedef struct _VGK_PCI_CONFIG_HEADER {
    USHORT VendorId;
    USHORT DeviceId;
    USHORT Command;
    USHORT Status;
    UCHAR  RevisionId;
    UCHAR  ProgIf;
    UCHAR  SubClass;
    UCHAR  BaseClass;
    UCHAR  CacheLineSize;
    UCHAR  LatencyTimer;
    UCHAR  HeaderType;
    UCHAR  Bist;
    ULONG  Bar[6];
    ULONG  CardbusCisPtr;
    USHORT SubsystemVendorId;
    USHORT SubsystemId;
} VGK_PCI_CONFIG_HEADER, *PVGK_PCI_CONFIG_HEADER;

typedef struct _VGK_ACPI_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFO {
    ULONG ProviderSignature; /* 'ACPI' = 0x41435049, 'RSMB' = 0x52534D42 */
    ULONG Action;            /* 0 = Enumerate, 1 = Get */
    ULONG TableID;           /* 'DMAR', 'APIC', 'FACP', 'SLIC' */
    ULONG TableBufferLength;
    UCHAR TableBuffer[1];
} VGK_ACPI_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFO, *PVGK_ACPI_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFO;
#pragma pack(pop)

/*
 * §17: Known Flagged PCI DMA & Virtual Device Helper
 */
static BOOLEAN
VgkIsPciDeviceFlagged(
    _In_ const VGK_PCI_CONFIG_HEADER *Cfg
)
{
    /* 1. Xilinx Default FPGA Bitstream (PCILeech / Screamer): Vendor 0x10EE */
    if (Cfg->VendorId == 0x10EE) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    /* 2. VMware Devices: Vendor 0x15AD (SVGA II 0x0405, VMXNET3 0x0740, PVSCSI 0x07B0) */
    if (Cfg->VendorId == 0x15AD &&
        (Cfg->DeviceId == 0x0405 || Cfg->DeviceId == 0x0740 || Cfg->DeviceId == 0x07B0)) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    /* 3. Red Hat / VirtIO (KVM / QEMU): Vendor 0x1AF4, Device 0x1000..0x107F */
    if (Cfg->VendorId == 0x1AF4 &&
        (Cfg->DeviceId >= 0x1000 && Cfg->DeviceId <= 0x107F)) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    /* 4. Microsoft Hyper-V Video Adapter: Vendor 0x1414, Device 0x5353 */
    if (Cfg->VendorId == 0x1414 && Cfg->DeviceId == 0x5353) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    /* 5. QEMU PCI Interconnect / Bridge: Vendor 0x1B36 */
    if (Cfg->VendorId == 0x1B36) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    /* 6. §4 Heuristic: Custom FPGA with Bus Master enabled (Bit 2) + zeroed Subsystem IDs
     *    on a non-bridge endpoint (HeaderType 0x00) claiming RAM/Memory Controller Class (0x05) */
    if ((Cfg->HeaderType & 0x7F) == 0x00 &&
        Cfg->BaseClass == 0x05 &&
        (Cfg->Command & 0x0004) != 0 &&
        Cfg->SubsystemVendorId == 0x0000 &&
        Cfg->SubsystemId == 0x0000) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    return FALSE;
}

/*
 * §4 / §17: Full PCI Configuration Space Scan across Buses 0..255, Devices 0..31, Functions 0..7
 */
static VOID
VgkScanPciConfigurationSpace(VOID)
{
    ULONG flaggedCount = 0;

    for (ULONG bus = 0; bus < 256; bus++) {
        for (ULONG dev = 0; dev < 32; dev++) {
            for (ULONG func = 0; func < 8; func++) {
                PCI_SLOT_NUMBER slot = { 0 };
                slot.u.bits.DeviceNumber   = dev;
                slot.u.bits.FunctionNumber = func;

                VGK_PCI_CONFIG_HEADER cfg = { 0 };
                ULONG bytesRead = HalGetBusDataByOffset(
                    PCIConfiguration,
                    bus,
                    slot.u.AsULONG,
                    &cfg,
                    0,
                    sizeof(cfg)
                );

                if (bytesRead < 4 || cfg.VendorId == 0xFFFF || cfg.VendorId == 0x0000) {
                    if (func == 0) {
                        break;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if (VgkIsPciDeviceFlagged(&cfg)) {
                    flaggedCount++;
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_PCI_DMA_FLAGGED);
                    VgkLogTelemetryEvent(
                        VGK_EVENT_DCL,
                        ((ULONG)cfg.VendorId << 16) | (ULONG)cfg.DeviceId,
                        NULL
                    );
                }

                /* Single-function device: bit 7 of HeaderType is 0 on Function 0 */
                if (func == 0 && (cfg.HeaderType & 0x80) == 0) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.FlaggedPciDeviceCount = flaggedCount;
}

/*
 * §3 / §4: Query ACPI Tables (DMAR for Intel VT-d IOMMU, IVRS for AMD-Vi, APIC/MADT, FACP/FADT)
 */
static ULONG
VgkProbeAcpiTableSignature(
    _In_ ULONG TableId
)
{
    ULONG bufSize = sizeof(VGK_ACPI_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFO) + 4096;
    PVGK_ACPI_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFO fwInfo = (PVGK_ACPI_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFO)
        ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, bufSize, VGK_POOL_TAG);
    if (!fwInfo) {
        return 0;
    }

    fwInfo->ProviderSignature = 'IPCA'; /* 'ACPI' big-endian provider in NT */
    fwInfo->Action            = 1;      /* SystemFirmwareTable_Get */
    fwInfo->TableID           = TableId;
    fwInfo->TableBufferLength = 4096;

    ULONG returnLen = 0;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(
        SystemFirmwareTableInformation,
        fwInfo,
        bufSize,
        &returnLen
    );

    ULONG readSig = 0;
    if (NT_SUCCESS(status) && fwInfo->TableBufferLength >= 4) {
        readSig = *(PULONG)&fwInfo->TableBuffer[0];
    }

    ExFreePoolWithTag(fwInfo, VGK_POOL_TAG);
    return readSig;
}

VOID
VgkAuditPciBusDmaAndAcpi(VOID)
{
    /* 1. Walk PCI Configuration Space for Xilinx 0x10EE, VMware, VirtIO, and DMA bridges */
    VgkScanPciConfigurationSpace();

    /* 2. Check ACPI DMAR (Intel VT-d), IVRS (AMD-Vi), and APIC (MADT) tables */
    ULONG dmarSig = VgkProbeAcpiTableSignature('RAMD'); /* 'DMAR' */
    ULONG ivrsSig = VgkProbeAcpiTableSignature('SRVI'); /* 'IVRS' */
    ULONG madtSig = VgkProbeAcpiTableSignature('CIPA'); /* 'APIC' (MADT) */

    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.AcpiDmarSignature = (dmarSig != 0) ? dmarSig : ivrsSig;
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.AcpiMadtSignature = madtSig;

    if (g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.AcpiDmarSignature != 0) {
        g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.IommuInterfacePresent = TRUE;
    }
}
```

`Vanguard/vgk_src/usb_hid_mouse.c`:
