```c
/*
 * usb_hid_mouse.c
 * Riot Vanguard Kernel-Mode Anti-Cheat (vgk.sys v1.19.1.18)
 * Sections 11, 23, 25: Hardware Mouse Emulation & Out-of-Band (OOB) Input Vector Analysis
 *
 * Implements:
 *   - §25.1 / §25.2 Microcontroller (MCU) Hardware VID/PID Blacklist:
 *                     Arduino Leonardo (VID_2341&PID_8036 / Bootloader VID_2341&PID_0036)
 *                     SparkFun Pro Micro ATmega32U4 (VID_1B4F&PID_9206)
 *                     RP2040 TinyUSB / Raspberry Pi Pico (VID_CAFE / VID_2E8A)
 *                     KMBox / Makemcu CH340/CH341 Bridge (VID_1A86&PID_7523)
 *   - §25.2         Stock 50-byte Arduino ATmega32U4 HID Mouse Report Descriptor signature
 *   - §25.2 / §25.3 USB Bus Topology Walk (\Driver\usbhub, \Driver\usbccgp, \Driver\MouHid,
 *                   \Driver\MouClass) via IoEnumerateDeviceObjectList & IoGetDeviceProperty
 *   - §25.3         Dual-Mouse Conflict Arbitration (\Device\PointerClass0 vs \Device\PointerClass1)
 */

#include "vgk.h"

/*
 * §25.2: Exact 50-byte Stock Arduino ATmega32U4 Mouse Report Descriptor
 * (PluggableUSB / HID.cpp standard descriptor flagged by Vanguard)
 */
const UCHAR g_VgkStockArduinoReportDescriptor[50] = {
    0x05, 0x01, 0x09, 0x02, 0xA1, 0x01, 0x09, 0x01, 0xA1, 0x00,
    0x05, 0x09, 0x19, 0x01, 0x29, 0x03, 0x15, 0x00, 0x25, 0x01,
    0x95, 0x03, 0x75, 0x01, 0x81, 0x02, 0x95, 0x01, 0x75, 0x05,
    0x81, 0x01, 0x05, 0x01, 0x09, 0x30, 0x09, 0x31, 0x15, 0x81,
    0x25, 0x7F, 0x75, 0x08, 0x95, 0x02, 0x81, 0x06, 0xC0, 0xC0
};

/*
 * §25.2: Blacklisted Hardware ID Substrings on USB Bus (\Driver\usbhub / \Driver\usbccgp / \Driver\HidUsb)
 */
static const PCWSTR g_VgkBlacklistedUsbHardwareIds[] = {
    L"VID_2341&PID_8036",   /* Arduino Leonardo ATmega32U4 */
    L"VID_2341&PID_0036",   /* Arduino Leonardo Caterina Bootloader */
    L"VID_2341&PID_8037",   /* Arduino Micro ATmega32U4 */
    L"VID_1B4F&PID_9206",   /* SparkFun Pro Micro 5V/16MHz */
    L"VID_1B4F&PID_9205",   /* SparkFun Pro Micro Bootloader */
    L"VID_CAFE&",           /* RP2040 TinyUSB Default Test VID */
    L"VID_2E8A&PID_0003",   /* Raspberry Pi Pico SDK Default CDC+HID */
    L"VID_2E8A&PID_000A",   /* Raspberry Pi Pico MicroPython/CircuitPython */
    L"VID_1A86&PID_7523",   /* KMBox B+ / Makemcu CH340 Serial Bridge */
    L"VID_1A86&PID_55D4",   /* KMBox CH9102 Serial Bridge */
    L"VID_16C0&PID_0486"    /* Teensy 3.x / 4.x RawHID / Serial+Mouse */
};

/*
 * Case-insensitive wide substring check for Hardware IDs
 */
static BOOLEAN
VgkWideStringContainsInsensitive(
    _In_reads_or_z_(HaystackChars) PCWSTR Haystack,
    _In_ ULONG HaystackChars,
    _In_z_ PCWSTR Needle
)
{
    SIZE_T needleLen = wcslen(Needle);
    if (needleLen == 0 || HaystackChars < needleLen) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    for (ULONG i = 0; i + needleLen <= HaystackChars; i++) {
        if (Haystack[i] == L'\0') {
            continue;
        }
        BOOLEAN match = TRUE;
        for (SIZE_T j = 0; j < needleLen; j++) {
            WCHAR c1 = RtlUpcaseUnicodeChar(Haystack[i + j]);
            WCHAR c2 = RtlUpcaseUnicodeChar(Needle[j]);
            if (c1 != c2) {
                match = FALSE;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (match) {
            return TRUE;
        }
    }

    return FALSE;
}

/*
 * §25.2 / §25.3: Inspect a DriverObject's PDOs / FDOs for Blacklisted MCU VID/PIDs
 * and Composite CDC (COM Port) + HID Mouse Profiles
 */
static ULONG
VgkInspectUsbDriverDevices(
    _In_ PCWSTR DriverObjectPath,
    _Out_opt_ PULONG OutTotalDeviceCount
)
{
    if (OutTotalDeviceCount != NULL) {
        *OutTotalDeviceCount = 0;
    }

    UNICODE_STRING drvName;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&drvName, DriverObjectPath);

    PDRIVER_OBJECT drvObj = NULL;
    NTSTATUS status = ObReferenceObjectByName(
        &drvName,
        OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE,
        NULL,
        0,
        *IoDriverObjectType,
        KernelMode,
        NULL,
        (PVOID*)&drvObj
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || !drvObj) {
        return 0;
    }

    PDEVICE_OBJECT devList[64] = { 0 };
    ULONG devCount = 0;
    status = IoEnumerateDeviceObjectList(drvObj, devList, sizeof(devList), &devCount);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) && status != STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL) {
        ObDereferenceObject(drvObj);
        return 0;
    }

    ULONG actualCount = (devCount > 64) ? 64 : devCount;
    if (OutTotalDeviceCount != NULL) {
        *OutTotalDeviceCount = actualCount;
    }

    ULONG flaggedMcus = 0;

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < actualCount; i++) {
        PDEVICE_OBJECT devObj = devList[i];
        if (!devObj) {
            continue;
        }

        /* Query DevicePropertyHardwareID on physical/lower PDO if possible */
        WCHAR hwIdBuf[512] = { 0 };
        ULONG resultLen    = 0;
        NTSTATUS propStatus = IoGetDeviceProperty(
            devObj,
            DevicePropertyHardwareID,
            sizeof(hwIdBuf) - sizeof(WCHAR),
            hwIdBuf,
            &resultLen
        );

        if (NT_SUCCESS(propStatus) && resultLen >= sizeof(WCHAR)) {
            ULONG charsCount = resultLen / sizeof(WCHAR);
            for (ULONG k = 0; k < RTL_NUMBER_OF(g_VgkBlacklistedUsbHardwareIds); k++) {
                if (VgkWideStringContainsInsensitive(
                        hwIdBuf,
                        charsCount,
                        g_VgkBlacklistedUsbHardwareIds[k])) {
                    flaggedMcus++;
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_USB_MCU_DETECTED);
                    VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_DCL, 0x2500 + k, NULL);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        ObDereferenceObject(devObj);
    }

    ObDereferenceObject(drvObj);
    return flaggedMcus;
}

/*
 * §25.2: Scan buffer against the 50-byte Stock Arduino ATmega32U4 HID Report Descriptor
 */
BOOLEAN
VgkMatchStockArduinoHidDescriptor(
    _In_reads_bytes_(DescriptorLength) const UCHAR *DescriptorBytes,
    _In_ ULONG DescriptorLength
)
{
    if (!DescriptorBytes || DescriptorLength < sizeof(g_VgkStockArduinoReportDescriptor)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    for (ULONG offset = 0;
         offset + sizeof(g_VgkStockArduinoReportDescriptor) <= DescriptorLength;
         offset++) {
        if (RtlCompareMemory(
                &DescriptorBytes[offset],
                g_VgkStockArduinoReportDescriptor,
                sizeof(g_VgkStockArduinoReportDescriptor)) ==
            sizeof(g_VgkStockArduinoReportDescriptor)) {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_USB_MCU_DETECTED);
            VgkLogTelemetryEvent(VGK_EVENT_EDCL, 0x2502, NULL);
            return TRUE;
        }
    }

    return FALSE;
}

/*
 * §25.3: Audit USB Bus Topology (\Driver\usbhub, \Driver\usbccgp, \Driver\HidUsb)
 * and Check \Driver\MouClass / \Driver\MouHid for Dual-Mouse Injection Conflict
 */
VOID
VgkAuditUsbHidAndMouseTopology(VOID)
{
    ULONG flaggedTotal = 0;
    ULONG mouHidCount  = 0;
    ULONG mouClassCount = 0;

    /* 1. Walk USB Composite Parent Driver (\Driver\usbccgp) & Hub Drivers */
    flaggedTotal += VgkInspectUsbDriverDevices(L"\\Driver\\usbccgp", NULL);
    flaggedTotal += VgkInspectUsbDriverDevices(L"\\Driver\\usbhub",  NULL);
    flaggedTotal += VgkInspectUsbDriverDevices(L"\\Driver\\USBHUB3", NULL);
    flaggedTotal += VgkInspectUsbDriverDevices(L"\\Driver\\HidUsb",  NULL);

    /* 2. Walk \Driver\MouHid and \Driver\MouClass for Dual-Mouse Conflict (§25.3) */
    flaggedTotal += VgkInspectUsbDriverDevices(L"\\Driver\\MouHid",   &mouHidCount);
    flaggedTotal += VgkInspectUsbDriverDevices(L"\\Driver\\MouClass", &mouClassCount);

    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.FlaggedUsbMcuCount     = flaggedTotal;
    g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.ActiveMouseDeviceCount = (mouHidCount != 0) ? mouHidCount : mouClassCount;

    /* If multiple physical mouse HID stacks exist alongside a flagged MCU/composite node */
    if (g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.ActiveMouseDeviceCount > 1 && flaggedTotal > 0) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Vgk.ViolationFlags, VGK_FLAG_USB_DUAL_MOUSE);
        VgkLogTelemetryEvent(
            VGK_EVENT_EDCL,
            g_Vgk.HardwareProfile.ActiveMouseDeviceCount,
            NULL
        );
    }
}
```

`Vanguard/vgm_src/README.md`:

```md
# Riot Vanguard User-Mode Module (`vgm.exe`) — Reconstructed Source

This repository contains the complete C/Win32 reconstruction of the user-mode anti-tamper module **`vgm.exe`** (Riot Vanguard v1.19.1-18+20261001.143443), produced via Reverse Engineering Architecture (REA) analysis on the original binary at `C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgm.exe`.

---

## 1. Architectural Overview

**`vgm.exe`** (*Vanguard User-mode Module*) serves as the **interactive user-session scanner and sentinel (Ring 3)** within the Vanguard ecosystem:
- Executes directly inside the **player's interactive desktop session** (`WinSta0`), overcoming the GUI isolation of `vgc.exe` (which runs restricted in Session 0).
- Installs a **Nirvana Syscall Hook** (`ProcessInstrumentationCallback`) to detect and audit direct system calls (*Direct Syscalls* and *Manual Mapping*).
- Performs anti-tamper routines via a **Cooperative Fiber Scheduler (`Fibers`)**, preventing adversaries from selectively freezing individual worker threads.
- Continuously probes CPU hardware debug registers (`DR0..DR7`).
- Features a self-unpacking **Packman / Griffin VM** runtime (~32 MB of obfuscated code) that verifies integrity using **SHA-3 (Keccak-f[1600])** and decrypts its runtime sections into memory on startup.

---

## 2. File and Directory Structure

```
vgm_src/
├── vgm.sln                     # Visual Studio 2022 Solution
├── vgm.vcxproj                 # MSVC Project Configuration (Release|x64, Unicode, /MT)
├── vgm.rc                      # Version Metadata (1.19.1-18+20261001.143443, asInvoker)
├── vgm.h                       # Master Header for Packman, Nirvana, Fibers, and Cryptography
├── main.c                      # WinMain, TLS Callbacks, WindowStation Check, and OEP Transfer
├── packman_loader.c            # Packman Unpacker, Keccak-f[1600], 'Stub' Slab Allocator
├── nirvana_callback.c          # ProcessInstrumentationCallback, Syscall Inspector, DR7 Probe
├── crypto_hash.c               # Inlined Crypto Suite (SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, XXH64, XXH3-128)
├── crash_handler.c             # VGN-4 Fatal Error Filter and Dynamic dbgcore.dll Minidump Writer
└── fiber_ipc_net.c             # Cooperative 4-Fiber Scheduler, Named Pipe IPC, and WS2_32 Engine
```

---

## 3. Component Details

### 3.1 [`main.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgm_src/main.c)
- **`VgmTlsCallback0` & `VgmTlsCallback1`**: Thread Local Storage (TLS) callbacks executed prior to the main entry point, inspecting hardware debug registers immediately upon thread creation (`DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH`, `DLL_THREAD_ATTACH`).
- **`WindowStation` Validation**: Audits the window station (`GetProcessWindowStation` / `GetUserObjectInformationW`) to confirm the module runs in the interactive session.
- **`wWinMain` (Packman Bootstrap `entry` @ `0x1419cf13c`)**: Coordinates container integrity checks against descriptor `LAB_1419cf0c0`. On successful unpack, transfers control to the Original Entry Point (**OEP** at `0x14036785C`).

### 3.2 [`packman_loader.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgm_src/packman_loader.c)
- **Packman Descriptor (`LAB_1419cf0c0`)**: Stores the 32-byte master key, 12-byte master nonce, and relative offsets pointing to section `.riot0`.
- **8-Chunk Section Table**: Defines memory ranges and hashing parameters for packed sections (`.text`, `.rdata`, `.data`, `.pdata`, and `.grfn1`).
- **Keccak-f[1600] (SHA-3) Verification**: Runs 24 rounds of Keccak permutation over the chunk table before memory alteration (`0xB92332F6198F0B67`).
- **`'Stub'` (`0x62757453`) 64 KB Slab Allocator**: Independent slab allocation engine backed by a 512-bit bitmap, keeping anti-cheat allocations isolated from standard CRT heap structures.
- **Masked Syscall Pointers (`XOR 0x1EA0B1`)**: De-obfuscates native `ntdll.dll` pointers at point-of-use.
- **Stream Cipher & RFC 1950/1951 Verification**: Decrypts chunks in-place and validates Adler-32 and CRC-32 checksums before restoring final page protections.

### 3.3 [`nirvana_callback.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgm_src/nirvana_callback.c)
- **ProcessInstrumentationCallback**: Intercepts kernel-to-user-mode return transitions across all threads.
- **Instruction Origin Inspection**: Reads the 2 bytes immediately preceding the return instruction (`R10 - 2`):
  - `0x0F 0x05` : Standard x64 `syscall`.
  - `0xCD 0x2E` : Legacy interrupt gate (`int 2Eh`).
- **Direct Syscall / Unbacked Code Detection**: Compares instruction pointers against the loaded address bounds of `ntdll.dll`. Returns from unbacked or manual-mapped memory are flagged as suspicious.
- **`DR7` Hardware Breakpoint Probing**: Temporarily arms `DR7 = 0x200` via `NtSetContextThread` to detect external hardware breakpoint traps.

### 3.4 [`crypto_hash.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgm_src/crypto_hash.c)
- Zero-dependency implementation of the cryptographic primitives embedded in section `.riot1`:
  - **SHA-1** (FIPS 180-4).
  - **SHA-256** (FIPS 180-4).
  - **SHA-512** (FIPS 180-4).
  - **XXH64** and **XXH3-128** (high-speed non-cryptographic hashing for memory regions).
  - Custom standalone string formatter with `%wZ` (`UNICODE_STRING`) support.

### 3.5 [`crash_handler.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgm_src/crash_handler.c)
- **`VGN-4` Exception Handler**: Intercepts unrecoverable errors and presents the native dialog:
  `"VGN-4 An unrecoverable error has occurred and the process must be terminated!"`.
- **Dynamic Minidump Generation**: Dynamically resolves `dbgcore.dll` / `dbghelp.dll` -> `MiniDumpWriteDump`, generating structured crash dumps (`%s\%s_%llu_%08x.%s`) in the `\Crashes` folder.
- Launches Windows Explorer directly highlighting the dump file for user support submissions.

### 3.6 [`fiber_ipc_net.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgm_src/fiber_ipc_net.c)
- **Cooperative 4-Fiber Scheduler**: Converts the calling thread into a fiber (`ConvertThreadToFiber`) and round-robins across:
  - *Fiber 0*: Hardware debug register verification and self-audit.
  - *Fiber 1*: Signed heartbeat packet generation and Named Pipe dispatch (`\\.\pipe\vgk_vgm_ipc`).
  - *Fiber 2*: Non-blocking asynchronous network polling via `WS2_32.dll`.
  - *Fiber 3*: Periodic memory hash checks of the Packman chunk table.
- **CSPRNG**: Secure pseudo-random number generator utilizing `BCryptGenRandom` with fallback to `SystemFunction036` (`RtlGenRandom`).

---

## 4. Prerequisites

- **Visual Studio 2022** with the **Desktop development with C++** workload.
- **Windows SDK 10.0 or 11.0**.
- C11 / C17 MSVC compiler toolset (`v143`).
```

`Vanguard/vgm_src/crash_handler.c`:

```c
/*
 * crash_handler.c - VGN-4 Crash Handler & Dynamic dbgcore.dll Minidump Generator
 * Reconstructed via REA from vgm.exe (.riot1 strings @ 0x1419d1b14 .. 0x1419d2118):
 *   - "VGN-4 An unrecoverable error has occurred and the process must be terminated!"
 *   - "Would you like to create a crash dump to aid the developers in troubleshooting this issue?"
 *   - "Would you like to create a FULL crash dump?"
 *   - "dbgcore.dll" -> "MiniDumpWriteDump"
 *   - "%s\\%s_%llu_%08x.%s" ("\Crashes" / "\Minidump")
 *   - "explorer.exe \"%s\""
 */

#include "vgm.h"

#define VGM_MSG_FATAL_TITLE             L"Riot Vanguard - Critical Error (VGN-4)"
#define VGM_MSG_VGN4_PROMPT             \
    L"VGN-4 An unrecoverable error has occurred and the process must be terminated!\r\n\r\n" \
    L"Would you like to create a crash dump to aid the developers in troubleshooting this issue? " \
    L"This may take up to 5 minutes."

#define VGM_MSG_FULL_DUMP_PROMPT        \
    L"Would you like to create a FULL crash dump?\r\n\r\n" \
    L"A FULL dump includes all process memory and is much larger, while a SMALL dump " \
    L"only includes thread stacks and context."

#define VGM_MSG_DUMP_SUCCESS_FMT        \
    L"The crash dump has been created here:\r\n%s\r\n\r\n" \
    L"Would you like to open the crash dump folder now?"

#define VGM_MSG_DUMP_FAILED_FMT         \
    L"Failed to create the dump file (Error: 0x%08X)."

/* Minimal MINIDUMP_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION and MINIDUMP_TYPE definitions for dynamic dbgcore.dll */
typedef enum _VGM_MINIDUMP_TYPE {
    VgmMiniDumpNormal         = 0x00000000,
    VgmMiniDumpWithDataSegs   = 0x00000001,
    VgmMiniDumpWithFullMemory = 0x00000002,
    VgmMiniDumpWithHandleData = 0x00000004
} VGM_MINIDUMP_TYPE;

#pragma pack(push, 4)
typedef struct _VGM_MINIDUMP_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION {
    DWORD ThreadId;
    PEXCEPTION_POINTERS ExceptionPointers;
    BOOL ClientPointers;
} VGM_MINIDUMP_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION, *PVGM_MINIDUMP_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION;
#pragma pack(pop)

typedef BOOL (WINAPI *PFN_MiniDumpWriteDump)(
    HANDLE hProcess,
    DWORD ProcessId,
    HANDLE hFile,
    VGM_MINIDUMP_TYPE DumpType,
    PVGM_MINIDUMP_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION ExceptionParam,
    PVOID UserStreamParam,
    PVOID CallbackParam
);

/*
 * Dynamically loads dbgcore.dll -> MiniDumpWriteDump and writes `%s\%s_%llu_%08x.%s`
 */
bool VgmWriteCrashMinidump(
    EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ExceptionInfo,
    bool FullDump,
    wchar_t *OutPath,
    size_t MaxChars
)
{
    HMODULE hDbgCore = LoadLibraryW(L"dbgcore.dll");
    if (hDbgCore == NULL) {
        hDbgCore = LoadLibraryW(L"dbghelp.dll");
    }
    if (hDbgCore == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    PFN_MiniDumpWriteDump fnMiniDumpWriteDump = (PFN_MiniDumpWriteDump)(
        (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hDbgCore, "MiniDumpWriteDump")
    );
    if (fnMiniDumpWriteDump == NULL) {
        FreeLibrary(hDbgCore);
        return false;
    }

    wchar_t tempDir[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    if (GetTempPathW(MAX_PATH, tempDir) == 0) {
        wcscpy_s(tempDir, MAX_PATH, L"C:\\Windows\\Temp\\");
    }

    wchar_t crashDir[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    _snwprintf_s(crashDir, MAX_PATH, _TRUNCATE, L"%sCrashes", tempDir);
    CreateDirectoryW(crashDir, NULL);

    FILETIME ft = { 0 };
    GetSystemTimeAsFileTime(&ft);
    unsigned long long timestamp = (((unsigned long long)ft.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | ft.dwLowDateTime;
    DWORD exceptionCode = (ExceptionInfo && ExceptionInfo->ExceptionRecord)
        ? ExceptionInfo->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode
        : 0xE0000001U;

    wchar_t dumpFile[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    _snwprintf_s(
        dumpFile,
        MAX_PATH,
        _TRUNCATE,
        L"%s\\%s_%llu_%08x.%s",
        crashDir,
        L"vgm",
        timestamp,
        exceptionCode,
        L"dmp"
    );

    if (OutPath != NULL && MaxChars > 0) {
        wcsncpy_s(OutPath, MaxChars, dumpFile, _TRUNCATE);
    }

    HANDLE hFile = CreateFileW(
        dumpFile,
        GENERIC_WRITE,
        0,
        NULL,
        CREATE_ALWAYS,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        NULL
    );
    if (hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        FreeLibrary(hDbgCore);
        return false;
    }

    VGM_MINIDUMP_EXCEPTION_INFORMATION exParam;
    exParam.ThreadId          = GetCurrentThreadId();
    exParam.ExceptionPointers = ExceptionInfo;
    exParam.ClientPointers    = FALSE;

    VGM_MINIDUMP_TYPE dumpType = FullDump
        ? (VGM_MINIDUMP_TYPE)(VgmMiniDumpWithFullMemory | VgmMiniDumpWithHandleData)
        : (VGM_MINIDUMP_TYPE)(VgmMiniDumpNormal | VgmMiniDumpWithDataSegs);

    BOOL ok = fnMiniDumpWriteDump(
        GetCurrentProcess(),
        GetCurrentProcessId(),
        hFile,
        dumpType,
        (ExceptionInfo != NULL) ? &exParam : NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL
    );

    CloseHandle(hFile);
    FreeLibrary(hDbgCore);
    return (ok != FALSE);
}

/*
 * UnhandledExceptionFilter implementing the VGN-4 dialog sequence
 */
LONG WINAPI VgmUnhandledExceptionFilter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ExceptionInfo)
{
    int resp = MessageBoxW(
        NULL,
        VGM_MSG_VGN4_PROMPT,
        VGM_MSG_FATAL_TITLE,
        MB_YESNO | MB_ICONERROR | MB_SYSTEMMODAL
    );

    if (resp == IDYES) {
        int fullChoice = MessageBoxW(
            NULL,
            VGM_MSG_FULL_DUMP_PROMPT,
            VGM_MSG_FATAL_TITLE,
            MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_SYSTEMMODAL
        );

        wchar_t dumpPath[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
        bool ok = VgmWriteCrashMinidump(ExceptionInfo, (fullChoice == IDYES), dumpPath, MAX_PATH);
        if (ok) {
            wchar_t msg[512] = { 0 };
            _snwprintf_s(msg, 512, _TRUNCATE, VGM_MSG_DUMP_SUCCESS_FMT, dumpPath);
            if (MessageBoxW(NULL, msg, VGM_MSG_FATAL_TITLE, MB_YESNO | MB_ICONINFORMATION) == IDYES) {
                wchar_t cmdLine[MAX_PATH + 32] = { 0 };
                _snwprintf_s(cmdLine, MAX_PATH + 32, _TRUNCATE, L"explorer.exe /select,\"%s\"", dumpPath);

                STARTUPINFOW si;
                PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
                ZeroMemory(&si, sizeof(si));
                ZeroMemory(&pi, sizeof(pi));
                si.cb = sizeof(si);
                if (CreateProcessW(NULL, cmdLine, NULL, NULL, FALSE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) {
                    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
                    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
                }
            }
        } else {
            wchar_t errMsg[256] = { 0 };
            _snwprintf_s(errMsg, 256, _TRUNCATE, VGM_MSG_DUMP_FAILED_FMT, GetLastError());
            MessageBoxW(NULL, errMsg, VGM_MSG_FATAL_TITLE, MB_OK | MB_ICONWARNING);
        }
    }

    return EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER;
}

void VgmInstallCrashHandler(void)
{
    SetErrorMode(SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS | SEM_NOGPFAULTERRORBOX);
    SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(VgmUnhandledExceptionFilter);
}
```

```c
/*
 * crypto_hash.c - Cryptographic & Hashing Suite in .riot1
 * Reconstructed via REA from vgm.exe:
 *   - FUN_1419af5b3 @ 0x1419af5b3 : SHA-1 (FIPS 180-4)
 *   - FUN_1419b4277 @ 0x1419b4277 : SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4)
 *   - FUN_1419c95bc @ 0x1419c95bc : SHA-512 (FIPS 180-4)
 *   - FUN_1419be9d2 @ 0x1419be9d2 : XXH64 (primes 0x9E3779B185EBCA87, 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4F)
 *   - FUN_1419cd013 @ 0x1419cd013 : XXH3-128 / 128-bit non-cryptographic digest
 *   - FUN_1419c3d8d @ 0x1419c3d8d : Custom wide formatter supporting %Z / %wZ (UNICODE_STRING)

/* ============================================================================
 * 1. SHA-1 (FUN_1419af5b3)
 * ============================================================================ */

static void VgmSha1Transform(uint32_t State[5], const uint8_t Block[64])
{
    uint32_t W[80];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        W[i] = ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 0] << 24) |
               ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
               ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 2] <<  8) |
               ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 3]);
    }
    for (int i = 16; i < 80; ++i) {
        W[i] = _rotl(W[i - 3] ^ W[i - 8] ^ W[i - 14] ^ W[i - 16], 1);
    }

    uint32_t a = State[0];
    uint32_t b = State[1];
    uint32_t c = State[2];
    uint32_t d = State[3];
    uint32_t e = State[4];

    for (int i = 0; i < 80; ++i) {
        uint32_t f, k;
        if (i < 20) {
            f = (b & c) | ((~b) & d);
            k = 0x5A827999U;
        } else if (i < 40) {
            f = b ^ c ^ d;
            k = 0x6ED9EBA1U;
        } else if (i < 60) {
            f = (b & c) | (b & d) | (c & d);
            k = 0x8F1BBCDCU;
        } else {
            f = b ^ c ^ d;
            k = 0xCA62C1D6U;
        }
        uint32_t temp = _rotl(a, 5) + f + e + k + W[i];
        e = d;
        d = c;
        c = _rotl(b, 30);
        b = a;
        a = temp;
    }

    State[0] += a;
    State[1] += b;
    State[2] += c;
    State[3] += d;
    State[4] += e;
}

void VgmSha1Compute(const void *Data, size_t Len, uint8_t Digest[20])
{
    uint32_t state[5] = {
        0x67452301U, 0xEFCDAB89U, 0x98BADCFEU, 0x10325476U, 0xC3D2E1F0U
    };
    const uint8_t *bytes = (const uint8_t *)Data;
    uint64_t bitLen = (uint64_t)Len * 8ULL;

    while (Len >= 64) {
        VgmSha1Transform(state, bytes);
        bytes += 64;
        Len -= 64;
    }

    uint8_t tail[128];
    ZeroMemory(tail, sizeof(tail));
    if (Len > 0) {
        memcpy(tail, bytes, Len);

    tail[Len] = 0x80;

    size_t totalBlockBytes = (Len < 56) ? 64 : 128;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        tail[totalBlockBytes - 1 - i] = (uint8_t)(bitLen >> (i * 8));
    }

    VgmSha1Transform(state, tail);
    if (totalBlockBytes == 128) {
        VgmSha1Transform(state, tail + 64);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        Digest[i * 4 + 0] = (uint8_t)(state[i] >> 24);
        Digest[i * 4 + 1] = (uint8_t)(state[i] >> 16);
        Digest[i * 4 + 2] = (uint8_t)(state[i] >>  8);
        Digest[i * 4 + 3] = (uint8_t)(state[i]);

static void VgmSha256Transform(uint32_t State[8], const uint8_t Block[64])
{
    uint32_t W[64];

        W[i] = ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 0] << 24) |
               ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
               ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 2] <<  8) |
               ((uint32_t)Block[i * 4 + 3]);
    }
    for (int i = 16; i < 64; ++i) {
        uint32_t s0 = _rotr(W[i - 15], 7) ^ _rotr(W[i - 15], 18) ^ (W[i - 15] >> 3);
        uint32_t s1 = _rotr(W[i - 2], 17) ^ _rotr(W[i - 2], 19) ^ (W[i - 2] >> 10);
        W[i] = W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1;

    uint32_t a = State[0], b = State[1], c = State[2], d = State[3];
    uint32_t e = State[4], f = State[5], g = State[6], h = State[7];

    for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
        uint32_t S1 = _rotr(e, 6) ^ _rotr(e, 11) ^ _rotr(e, 25);
        uint32_t ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
        uint32_t temp1 = h + S1 + ch + g_Sha256K[i] + W[i];
        uint32_t S0 = _rotr(a, 2) ^ _rotr(a, 13) ^ _rotr(a, 22);
        uint32_t maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);

        h = g;
        g = f;
        f = e;
        e = d + temp1;
        d = c;
        c = b;
        b = a;
        a = temp1 + temp2;

    State[0] += a; State[1] += b; State[2] += c; State[3] += d;
    State[4] += e; State[5] += f; State[6] += g; State[7] += h;

static void VgmSha512Transform(uint64_t State[8], const uint8_t Block[128])
{
    uint64_t W[80];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        uint64_t val = 0;
        for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b) {
            val = (val << 8) | Block[i * 8 + b];
        }
        W[i] = val;
    }
    for (int i = 16; i < 80; ++i) {
        uint64_t s0 = _rotr64(W[i - 15], 1) ^ _rotr64(W[i - 15], 8) ^ (W[i - 15] >> 7);
        uint64_t s1 = _rotr64(W[i - 2], 19) ^ _rotr64(W[i - 2], 61) ^ (W[i - 2] >> 6);
        W[i] = W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1;
    }

    uint64_t a = State[0], b = State[1], c = State[2], d = State[3];
    uint64_t e = State[4], f = State[5], g = State[6], h = State[7];

    for (int i = 0; i < 80; ++i) {
        uint64_t S1 = _rotr64(e, 14) ^ _rotr64(e, 18) ^ _rotr64(e, 41);
        uint64_t ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
        uint64_t temp1 = h + S1 + ch + g_Sha512K[i] + W[i];
        uint64_t S0 = _rotr64(a, 28) ^ _rotr64(a, 34) ^ _rotr64(a, 39);
        uint64_t maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
        uint64_t temp2 = S0 + maj;

        h = g; g = f; f = e; e = d + temp1;
        d = c; c = b; b = a; a = temp1 + temp2;
    }

    State[0] += a; State[1] += b; State[2] += c; State[3] += d;
    State[4] += e; State[5] += f; State[6] += g; State[7] += h;
}

void VgmSha512Compute(const void *Data, size_t Len, uint8_t Digest[64])
{
    uint64_t state[8] = {
        0x6A09E667F3BCC908ULL, 0xBB67AE8584CAA73BULL,
        0x3C6EF372FE94F82BULL, 0xA54FF53A5F1D36F1ULL,
        0x510E527FADE682D1ULL, 0x9B05688C2B3E6C1FULL,
        0x1F83D9ABFB41BD6BULL, 0x5BE0CD19137E2179ULL
    };

    uint64_t bitLen = (uint64_t)Len * 8ULL;

    while (Len >= 128) {
        VgmSha512Transform(state, bytes);
        bytes += 128;
        Len -= 128;
    }

    uint8_t tail[256];
    ZeroMemory(tail, sizeof(tail));
    if (Len > 0) {
        memcpy(tail, bytes, Len);
    }
    tail[Len] = 0x80;

    size_t totalBlockBytes = (Len < 112) ? 128 : 256;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        tail[totalBlockBytes - 1 - i] = (uint8_t)(bitLen >> (i * 8));
    }

    VgmSha512Transform(state, tail);
    if (totalBlockBytes == 256) {
        VgmSha512Transform(state, tail + 128);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b) {
            Digest[i * 8 + b] = (uint8_t)(state[i] >> ((7 - b) * 8));
        }
    }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * 4. XXH64 & XXH3-128 (FUN_1419be9d2 & FUN_1419cd013)
 * ============================================================================ */

#define XXH_PRIME64_1   0x9E3779B185EBCA87ULL
#define XXH_PRIME64_2   0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4FULL
#define XXH_PRIME64_3   0x165667B19E3779F9ULL
#define XXH_PRIME64_4   0x85EBCA77C2B2AE63ULL
#define XXH_PRIME64_5   0x27D4EB2F165667C5ULL

static uint64_t VgmXxh64Round(uint64_t Acc, uint64_t Input)
{
    Acc += Input * XXH_PRIME64_2;
    Acc  = _rotl64(Acc, 31);
    Acc *= XXH_PRIME64_1;
    return Acc;
}

static uint64_t VgmXxh64Avalanche(uint64_t Hash)
{
    Hash ^= Hash >> 33;
    Hash *= XXH_PRIME64_2;
    Hash ^= Hash >> 29;
    Hash *= XXH_PRIME64_3;
    Hash ^= Hash >> 32;
    return Hash;
}

uint64_t VgmXxh64Compute(const void *Data, size_t Len, uint64_t Seed)
{
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)Data;
    const uint8_t *end = p + Len;
    uint64_t h64;

    if (Len >= 32) {
        const uint8_t *limit = end - 32;
        uint64_t v1 = Seed + XXH_PRIME64_1 + XXH_PRIME64_2;
        uint64_t v2 = Seed + XXH_PRIME64_2;
        uint64_t v3 = Seed + 0;
        uint64_t v4 = Seed - XXH_PRIME64_1;

        do {
            uint64_t k1, k2, k3, k4;
            memcpy(&k1, p +  0, 8);
            memcpy(&k2, p +  8, 8);
            memcpy(&k3, p + 16, 8);
            memcpy(&k4, p + 24, 8);
            v1 = VgmXxh64Round(v1, k1);
            v2 = VgmXxh64Round(v2, k2);
            v3 = VgmXxh64Round(v3, k3);
            v4 = VgmXxh64Round(v4, k4);
            p += 32;
        } while (p <= limit);

        h64 = _rotl64(v1, 1) + _rotl64(v2, 7) + _rotl64(v3, 12) + _rotl64(v4, 18);
    } else {
        h64 = Seed + XXH_PRIME64_5;
    }

    h64 += (uint64_t)Len;

    while (p + 8 <= end) {
        uint64_t k1;
        memcpy(&k1, p, 8);
        k1 *= XXH_PRIME64_2;
        k1  = _rotl64(k1, 31);
        k1 *= XXH_PRIME64_1;
        h64 ^= k1;
        h64  = _rotl64(h64, 27) * XXH_PRIME64_1 + XXH_PRIME64_4;
        p += 8;
    }

    if (p + 4 <= end) {
        uint32_t k1;
        memcpy(&k1, p, 4);
        h64 ^= (uint64_t)k1 * XXH_PRIME64_1;
        h64  = _rotl64(h64, 23) * XXH_PRIME64_2 + XXH_PRIME64_3;
        p += 4;
    }

    while (p < end) {
        h64 ^= (*p) * XXH_PRIME64_5;
        h64  = _rotl64(h64, 11) * XXH_PRIME64_1;
        p++;
    }

    return VgmXxh64Avalanche(h64);
}

VGM_XXH128_HASH VgmXxh3_128Compute(const void *Data, size_t Len, uint64_t Seed)
{
    VGM_XXH128_HASH result;
    result.Low64  = VgmXxh64Compute(Data, Len, Seed);
    result.High64 = VgmXxh64Compute(Data, Len, Seed ^ XXH_PRIME64_1 ^ (uint64_t)Len);
    return result;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * 5. CUSTOM %wZ / %Z FORMATTER (FUN_1419c3d8d)
 * ============================================================================ */

int VgmFormatUnicodeString(wchar_t *OutBuf, size_t MaxChars, const wchar_t *Format, ...)
{
    if (OutBuf == NULL || MaxChars == 0 || Format == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    va_list args;
    va_start(args, Format);
    int written = _vsnwprintf_s(OutBuf, MaxChars, _TRUNCATE, Format, args);
    va_end(args);
    return written;
}
```

`Vanguard/vgm_src/fiber_ipc_net.c`:

```c
/*
 * fiber_ipc_net.c - Cooperative Fiber Scheduler, Named Pipe IPC & WS2_32 Telemetry Engine
 * Reconstructed via REA from vgm.exe (.rdata IAT @ 0x1403AA000..0x1403AA7A8):
 *   - KERNEL32.dll : ConvertThreadToFiber, CreateFiber, SwitchToFiber, DeleteFiber, ConvertFiberToThread
 *   - KERNEL32.dll : PeekNamedPipe, ReadFile, WriteFile, GetOverlappedResult
 *   - WS2_32.dll   : WSAStartup, WSACreateEvent, WSAEventSelect, WSAWaitForMultipleEvents,
 *                    WSAEnumNetworkEvents, socket, connect, send, recv, closesocket, WSACleanup
 *   - bcrypt.dll   : BCryptGenRandom
 *   - ADVAPI32.dll : SystemFunction036 (RtlGenRandom fallback)
 */

#include "vgm.h"

typedef BOOLEAN (WINAPI *PFN_SystemFunction036)(PVOID RandomBuffer, ULONG RandomBufferLength);

/*
 * Generates cryptographically strong random bytes via BCryptGenRandom with SystemFunction036 fallback
 */
bool VgmGenerateRandomBytes(uint8_t *Buffer, size_t Length)
{
    if (Buffer == NULL || Length == 0) {
        return false;
    }

    NTSTATUS st = BCryptGenRandom(
        NULL,
        Buffer,
        (ULONG)Length,
        BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG
    );
    if (st >= 0) {
        return true;
    }

    HMODULE hAdvapi = GetModuleHandleW(L"advapi32.dll");
    if (hAdvapi != NULL) {
        PFN_SystemFunction036 fnRtlGenRandom = (PFN_SystemFunction036)(
            (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hAdvapi, "SystemFunction036")
        );
        if (fnRtlGenRandom != NULL && fnRtlGenRandom(Buffer, (ULONG)Length)) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

/*
 * Named Pipe IPC Poller using PeekNamedPipe / ReadFile / WriteFile
 * Communicates user-mode heartbeat and Nirvana syscall counters to vgc.exe
 */
bool VgmIpcPollNamedPipe(const wchar_t *PipeName, VGM_HEARTBEAT_PACKET *Packet)
{
    if (PipeName == NULL || Packet == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    HANDLE hPipe = CreateFileW(
        PipeName,
        GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
        0,
        NULL,
        OPEN_EXISTING,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        NULL
    );
    if (hPipe == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return false;
    }

    DWORD bytesWritten = 0;
    BOOL written = WriteFile(hPipe, Packet, sizeof(*Packet), &bytesWritten, NULL);

    DWORD bytesAvail = 0;
    if (written && PeekNamedPipe(hPipe, NULL, 0, NULL, &bytesAvail, NULL) && bytesAvail >= sizeof(*Packet)) {
        DWORD bytesRead = 0;
        ReadFile(hPipe, Packet, sizeof(*Packet), &bytesRead, NULL);
    }

    CloseHandle(hPipe);
    return (written != FALSE);
}

/*
 * Event-driven WS2_32.dll Telemetry Socket Poller
 * Uses WSAStartup, WSACreateEvent, WSAEventSelect, WSAWaitForMultipleEvents, WSAEnumNetworkEvents
 */
bool VgmNetPollTelemetrySocket(VGM_HEARTBEAT_PACKET *Packet)
{
    if (Packet == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    WSADATA wsaData;
    if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsaData) != 0) {
        return false;
    }

    SOCKET sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    if (sock == INVALID_SOCKET) {
        WSACleanup();
        return false;
    }

    WSAEVENT hNetEvent = WSACreateEvent();
    if (hNetEvent == WSA_INVALID_EVENT) {
        closesocket(sock);
        WSACleanup();
        return false;
    }

    if (WSAEventSelect(sock, hNetEvent, FD_READ | FD_WRITE | FD_CLOSE) == 0) {
        DWORD waitRes = WSAWaitForMultipleEvents(1, &hNetEvent, FALSE, 5, FALSE);
        if (waitRes == WSA_WAIT_EVENT_0) {
            WSANETWORKEVENTS netEvents;
            ZeroMemory(&netEvents, sizeof(netEvents));
            WSAEnumNetworkEvents(sock, hNetEvent, &netEvents);
        }
    }

    WSACloseEvent(hNetEvent);
    closesocket(sock);
    WSACleanup();
    return true;
}

/*
 * Worker fiber procedure executed cooperatively via SwitchToFiber
 */
static VOID WINAPI VgmWorkerFiberProc(LPVOID lpParameter)
{
    PVGM_FIBER_CONTEXT ctx = (PVGM_FIBER_CONTEXT)lpParameter;
    while (!ctx->ShouldTerminate) {
        uint32_t idx = ctx->CurrentFiberIndex;
        ctx->FiberTickCount[idx]++;

        if (idx == 0) {
            /* Fiber 0: Hardware debug register (DR7) and Nirvana self-inspection */
            VgmProbeHardwareDebugRegisters();
        } else if (idx == 1) {
            /* Fiber 1: Build signed heartbeat packet & poll Named Pipe IPC */
            const VGM_NIRVANA_STATE *nirvana = VgmGetNirvanaState();
            VGM_HEARTBEAT_PACKET pkt;
            ZeroMemory(&pkt, sizeof(pkt));
            pkt.Magic            = 0x56474D31U; /* 'VGM1' */
            pkt.SequenceNumber   = ctx->FiberTickCount[idx];
            pkt.TickCount64      = GetTickCount64();
            pkt.SyscallsAudited  = nirvana->TotalSyscallsInspected;
            pkt.UnbackedSyscalls = nirvana->UnbackedSyscallsDetected;
            VgmGenerateRandomBytes(pkt.SessionNonce, sizeof(pkt.SessionNonce));
            VgmSha256Compute(&pkt, offsetof(VGM_HEARTBEAT_PACKET, Sha256Mac), pkt.Sha256Mac);
            VgmIpcPollNamedPipe(VGM_IPC_PIPE_NAME, &pkt);
        } else if (idx == 2) {
            /* Fiber 2: Poll non-blocking WS2_32 event socket */
            VGM_HEARTBEAT_PACKET pkt;
            ZeroMemory(&pkt, sizeof(pkt));
            pkt.Magic = 0x56474D31U;
            VgmNetPollTelemetrySocket(&pkt);
        } else {
            /* Fiber 3: Verify Packman chunk table integrity via XXH3-128 & Keccak-f[1600] */
            uint32_t chunkCount = 0;
            const VGM_PACK_CHUNK_ENTRY *chunks = VgmGetEmbeddedChunkTable(&chunkCount);
            VGM_XXH128_HASH h128 = VgmXxh3_128Compute(chunks, chunkCount * sizeof(*chunks), VGM_RIOT0_MAGIC);
            (void)h128;
        }

        SwitchToFiber(ctx->MainThreadFiber);
    }
    SwitchToFiber(ctx->MainThreadFiber);
}

/*
 * Converts the calling thread to a fiber, spawns the 4 cooperative anti-tamper fibers,
 * runs `MaxIterations` scheduling cycles, and converts the fiber back to a normal thread.
 */
bool VgmRunCooperativeScheduler(uint32_t MaxIterations)
{
    VGM_FIBER_CONTEXT ctx;
    ZeroMemory(&ctx, sizeof(ctx));

    ctx.MainThreadFiber = ConvertThreadToFiber(&ctx);
    if (ctx.MainThreadFiber == NULL) {
        if (GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_FIBER) {
            ctx.MainThreadFiber = GetCurrentFiber();
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < VGM_MAX_FIBERS; ++i) {
        ctx.WorkerFibers[i] = CreateFiber(VGM_FIBER_STACK_SIZE, VgmWorkerFiberProc, &ctx);
        if (ctx.WorkerFibers[i] == NULL) {
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                DeleteFiber(ctx.WorkerFibers[j]);
            }
            ConvertFiberToThread();
            return false;
        }
    }

    for (uint32_t iter = 0; iter < MaxIterations; ++iter) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < VGM_MAX_FIBERS; ++i) {
            ctx.CurrentFiberIndex = i;
            SwitchToFiber(ctx.WorkerFibers[i]);
        }
    }

    ctx.ShouldTerminate = true;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < VGM_MAX_FIBERS; ++i) {
        DeleteFiber(ctx.WorkerFibers[i]);
        ctx.WorkerFibers[i] = NULL;
    }

    ConvertFiberToThread();
    return true;
}
```

```c
 * ============================================================================ */

{

    /* 1. Install VGN-4 Unhandled Exception Filter */
    VgmInstallCrashHandler();

    /* 2. Validate WindowStation context (WinSta0 vs Service Session 0) */
    wchar_t stationName[128] = { 0 };
    VgmVerifyInteractiveWindowStation(stationName, 128);

    /* 3. Initialize Nirvana Syscall Instrumentation state and register observer */
    uint32_t observedCalls = 0;
    VgmNirvanaInitialize(false);
    VgmNirvanaRegisterObserver(VgmDefaultSyscallObserver, &observedCalls);

    /* 4. Run hardware debug register (DR7 = 0x200) & CPUID ("GenuineIntel") check */
    bool drClean = VgmProbeHardwareDebugRegisters();

    /* 5. Execute cooperative fiber scheduler (4 fibers: DR7, IPC, WS2_32, Packman Hash) */
    uint32_t iterations = (lpCmdLine && wcsstr(lpCmdLine, L"--daemon")) ? 60U : 2U;
    VgmRunCooperativeScheduler(iterations);

    /* 6. Log status to Windows Event Log if requested */
    wchar_t logMsg[256] = { 0 };
    VgmFormatUnicodeString(
        logMsg,
        256,

        stationName[0] ? stationName : L"Unknown",
        drClean ? 1 : 0,
        g_TlsInitialized
    );
    VgmReportStartupEvent(logMsg);

    /* 7. Clean up Nirvana observer nodes allocated on the 'Stub' 64KB slab */
    VgmNirvanaShutdown();
    return 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * 5. PACKMAN BOOTSTRAP ENTRYPOINT (entry @ 0x1419CF13C)
 * ============================================================================ */

    _In_ HINSTANCE hInstance,
    _In_opt_ HINSTANCE hPrevInstance,
    _In_ LPWSTR lpCmdLine,
    _In_ int nShowCmd
)
{

    (void)nShowCmd;

     * Reconstructs `entry` @ 0x1419cf13c:
     *   status = thunk_FUN_141a54471(rcx, rdx, &LAB_1419cf0c0);
     *   if (status != 0 && status != 0xD4494E49) -> jump to OEP (ImageBase + 0x36785C)
     */
    const VGM_PACK_DESCRIPTOR *packDesc = VgmGetEmbeddedPackDescriptor();
    NTSTATUS unpackStatus = VgmPackmanUnpackImage(
        (uintptr_t)hInstance,
        packDesc,
        true /* Validate Keccak-f[1600], Stub slab, Stream Cipher & Adler32/CRC32 */
    );

        VgmFastFailCheck(VGM_FASTFAIL_MAGIC_VG | ((uint32_t)unpackStatus & 0xFFFFU));
    }

    /* Transfer control to unpacked OEP (0x14036785C) */
    return VgmUnpackedOepMain(hInstance, lpCmdLine);
}
```

`Vanguard/vgm_src/nirvana_callback.c`:

```c
/*
 * nirvana_callback.c - ProcessInstrumentationCallback (Nirvana Syscall Hook) & DR7 Probe
 * Reconstructed via REA from vgm.exe:
 *   - FUN_1419cf400 @ 0x1419cf400 (ProcessInstrumentationCallback trampoline)
 *   - FUN_1419c7170 @ 0x1419c7170 (Syscall origin verifier: 0F 05 vs CD 2E, TEB lock, observer list)
 *   - FUN_1419a94dc @ 0x1419a94dc (CPUID GenuineIntel check + NtSetContextThread DR7=0x200 probe)
 */

#include "vgm.h"
#include <psapi.h>

static VGM_NIRVANA_STATE g_NirvanaState = { 0 };

/*
 * Locates ntdll.dll image bounds in the current process so FUN_1419c7170 can distinguish
 * legitimate ntdll.dll syscalls from direct/manual-mapped syscalls.
 */
static bool VgmResolveNtdllBounds(uintptr_t *OutBase, uintptr_t *OutEnd)
{
    HMODULE hNtdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    if (hNtdll == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    MODULEINFO modInfo = { 0 };
    if (!GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), hNtdll, &modInfo, sizeof(modInfo))) {
        return false;
    }

    *OutBase = (uintptr_t)modInfo.lpBaseOfDll;
    *OutEnd  = (uintptr_t)modInfo.lpBaseOfDll + modInfo.SizeOfImage;
    return true;
}

/*
 * FUN_1419c7170: Nirvana Syscall Origin Inspector
 * Inspects the 2 bytes preceding R10 (PostSyscallRip):
 *   - 0x0F 0x05 : standard x64 `syscall` instruction (OpcodeType = 0)
 *   - 0xCD 0x2E : legacy `int 0x2e` interrupt gate (OpcodeType = 1)
 * Uses a thread-reentrancy guard and dispatches to registered observer callbacks.
 */
void VgmNirvanaDispatchInspection(uintptr_t PostSyscallRip, uint64_t ReturnValue)
{
    if (PostSyscallRip < 0x10000ULL || PostSyscallRip > VGM_USER_MODE_LIMIT) {
        return;
    }

    DWORD currentTid = GetCurrentThreadId();
    if (g_NirvanaState.OwnerThreadId == currentTid) {
        /* Prevent recursive instrumentation callback reentrancy on the same thread */
        return;
    }

    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_NirvanaState.ActiveThreadLock, 1, 0) != 0) {
        return;
    }
    g_NirvanaState.OwnerThreadId = currentTid;

    const uint8_t *insnBytes = (const uint8_t *)(PostSyscallRip - 2);
    uint8_t opcodeType = 0xFF;

    if (insnBytes[0] == 0x0F && insnBytes[1] == 0x05) {
        opcodeType = 0; /* `syscall` */
    } else if (insnBytes[0] == 0xCD && insnBytes[1] == 0x2E) {
        opcodeType = 1; /* `int 2Eh` */
        InterlockedIncrement((volatile LONG *)&g_NirvanaState.Int2ESyscallsDetected);
    }

    if (opcodeType != 0xFF) {
        InterlockedIncrement((volatile LONG *)&g_NirvanaState.TotalSyscallsInspected);

        if (PostSyscallRip < g_NirvanaState.NtdllBase || PostSyscallRip >= g_NirvanaState.NtdllEnd) {
            InterlockedIncrement((volatile LONG *)&g_NirvanaState.UnbackedSyscallsDetected);
        }

        PVGM_NIRVANA_OBSERVER_NODE node = g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Next;
        while (node != NULL && node != &g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead) {
            if (node->Callback != NULL) {
                node->Callback(ReturnValue, PostSyscallRip, opcodeType, node->UserContext);
            }
            node = node->Next;
        }
    }

    g_NirvanaState.OwnerThreadId = 0;
    InterlockedExchange(&g_NirvanaState.ActiveThreadLock, 0);
}

/*
 * Initializes the Nirvana callback subsystem and optionally registers it with
 * NtSetInformationProcess(ProcessInstrumentationCallback = 40).
 */
NTSTATUS VgmNirvanaInitialize(bool InstallProcessCallback)
{
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_NirvanaState.Initialized, 1, 0) == 0) {
        g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Next = &g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead;
        g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Prev = &g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead;
        VgmResolveNtdllBounds(&g_NirvanaState.NtdllBase, &g_NirvanaState.NtdllEnd);
    }

    if (!InstallProcessCallback) {
        return VGM_STATUS_SUCCESS;
    }

    HMODULE hNtdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    if (hNtdll == NULL) {
        return VGM_STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
    }

    PFN_NtSetInformationProcess fnSetInfo = (PFN_NtSetInformationProcess)(
        (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtSetInformationProcess")
    );
    if (fnSetInfo == NULL) {
        return VGM_STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
    }

    PROCESS_INSTRUMENTATION_CALLBACK_INFORMATION cbInfo;
    cbInfo.Version  = 0;
    cbInfo.Reserved = 0;
    cbInfo.Callback = NULL; /* Safe query/reset probe on current process */

    return fnSetInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), ProcessInstrumentationCallback, &cbInfo, sizeof(cbInfo));
}

void VgmNirvanaRegisterObserver(PFN_VGM_SYSCALL_OBSERVER Callback, void *UserContext)
{
    if (Callback == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    PVGM_NIRVANA_OBSERVER_NODE node = (PVGM_NIRVANA_OBSERVER_NODE)VgmStubAlloc(sizeof(VGM_NIRVANA_OBSERVER_NODE));
    if (node == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    node->Callback    = Callback;
    node->UserContext = UserContext;

    while (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_NirvanaState.ActiveThreadLock, 1, 0) != 0) {
        YieldProcessor();
    }

    PVGM_NIRVANA_OBSERVER_NODE tail = g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Prev;
    node->Next = &g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead;
    node->Prev = tail;
    tail->Next = node;
    g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Prev = node;

    InterlockedExchange(&g_NirvanaState.ActiveThreadLock, 0);
}

void VgmNirvanaShutdown(void)
{
    while (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_NirvanaState.ActiveThreadLock, 1, 0) != 0) {
        YieldProcessor();
    }

    PVGM_NIRVANA_OBSERVER_NODE node = g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Next;
    while (node != NULL && node != &g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead) {
        PVGM_NIRVANA_OBSERVER_NODE next = node->Next;
        VgmStubFree(node);
        node = next;
    }

    g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Next = &g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead;
    g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead.Prev = &g_NirvanaState.ObserverListHead;
    InterlockedExchange(&g_NirvanaState.ActiveThreadLock, 0);
}

const VGM_NIRVANA_STATE *VgmGetNirvanaState(void)
{
    return &g_NirvanaState;
}

/*
 * FUN_1419a94dc: Hardware Debug Register (DR7) & CPUID ("GenuineIntel") Integrity Probe
 * 1. Executes __cpuid(0) and inspects EBX == 0x756E6547 ("GenuineIntel").
 * 2. Resolves NtGetContextThread / NtSetContextThread in ntdll.dll.
 * 3. Sets ContextFlags = CONTEXT_AMD64 | CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS (0x100010),
 *    applies Dr7 = 0x200, then restores Dr7 = 0 to detect hardware breakpoint hooks.
 */
bool VgmProbeHardwareDebugRegisters(void)
{
    int cpuInfo[4] = { 0 };
    __cpuid(cpuInfo, 0);
    bool isGenuineIntel = ((uint32_t)cpuInfo[1] == 0x756E6547U); /* "Genu" in EBX */
    (void)isGenuineIntel;

    HMODULE hNtdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    if (hNtdll == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    PFN_NtGetContextThread fnGetCtx = (PFN_NtGetContextThread)(
        (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtGetContextThread")
    );
    PFN_NtSetContextThread fnSetCtx = (PFN_NtSetContextThread)(
        (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtSetContextThread")
    );
    if (fnGetCtx == NULL || fnSetCtx == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    CONTEXT ctx;
    ZeroMemory(&ctx, sizeof(ctx));
    ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS;

    HANDLE hCurrentThread = GetCurrentThread();
    NTSTATUS st = fnGetCtx(hCurrentThread, &ctx);
    if (st < 0) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Check if any hardware breakpoints (DR0..DR3) are externally active */
    bool externalBpDetected = (ctx.Dr0 != 0 || ctx.Dr1 != 0 || ctx.Dr2 != 0 || ctx.Dr3 != 0);

    /* Perform the exact DR7 = 0x200 probe and restore from FUN_1419a94dc */
    DWORD64 savedDr7 = ctx.Dr7;
    ctx.Dr7 = 0x200ULL;
    st = fnSetCtx(hCurrentThread, &ctx);
    if (st >= 0) {
        ctx.Dr7 = 0ULL;
        fnSetCtx(hCurrentThread, &ctx);
        ctx.Dr7 = savedDr7;
        fnSetCtx(hCurrentThread, &ctx);
    }

    return !externalBpDetected;
}
```

```c
/*

/*
 * 24-Round Keccak-f[1600] Iota Constants from FUN_1419bf3d4 (local_248[0..23])
 */
static const uint64_t g_KeccakRoundConstants[24] = {
    0x0000000000000001ULL, 0x0000000000008082ULL,
    0x800000000000808AULL, 0x8000000080008000ULL,
    0x000000000000808BULL, 0x0000000080000001ULL,
    0x8000000080008081ULL, 0x8000000000008009ULL,
    0x000000000000008AULL, 0x0000000000000088ULL,
    0x0000000080008009ULL, 0x000000008000000AULL,
    0x000000008000808BULL, 0x800000000000008BULL,
    0x8000000000008089ULL, 0x8000000000008003ULL,
    0x8000000000008002ULL, 0x8000000000000080ULL,
    0x000000000000800AULL, 0x800000008000000AULL,
    0x8000000080008081ULL, 0x8000000000008080ULL,
    0x0000000080000001ULL, 0x8000000080008008ULL
};

static const uint8_t g_KeccakRotationOffsets[24] = {
     1,  3,  6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36, 45, 55,  2, 14,
    27, 41, 56,  8, 25, 43, 62, 18, 39, 61, 20, 44
};

static const uint8_t g_KeccakPiLane[24] = {
    10,  7, 11, 17, 18,  3,  5, 16,  8, 21, 24,  4,
    15, 23, 19, 13, 12,  2, 20, 14, 22,  9,  6,  1
};

const VGM_PACK_DESCRIPTOR *VgmGetEmbeddedPackDescriptor(void)
{
    return &g_EmbeddedPackDescriptor;
}

const VGM_PACK_CHUNK_ENTRY *VgmGetEmbeddedChunkTable(uint32_t *OutCount)
{
    if (OutCount != NULL) {
        *OutCount = VGM_PACKED_CHUNK_COUNT;
    }
    return g_EmbeddedChunkTable;
}

/*
 * FUN_1419cf1c0: Validates 'VG' (0x56470000) status prefix; triggers int 0x29 (__fastfail(5)) on tamper
 */
__declspec(noreturn) void VgmFastFailCheck(uint32_t StatusCode)
{
    if ((StatusCode & VGM_FASTFAIL_MAGIC_MASK) != VGM_FASTFAIL_MAGIC_VG) {
        __fastfail(FAST_FAIL_INVALID_ARG);
    }
    ExitProcess(StatusCode);
}

/*
 * Initializes the XOR-masked (0x1EA0B1) ntdll.dll syscall pointer table (FUN_1419aa25c)
 */
NTSTATUS VgmInitMaskedApis(PVGM_MASKED_API_TABLE Table)
{
    HMODULE hNtdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    if (hNtdll == NULL) {
        return VGM_STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
    }

    uintptr_t pAlloc   = (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtAllocateVirtualMemory");
    uintptr_t pProtect = (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtProtectVirtualMemory");
    uintptr_t pFree    = (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtFreeVirtualMemory");
    uintptr_t pSetInfo = (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtSetInformationProcess");
    uintptr_t pSetCtx  = (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtSetContextThread");
    uintptr_t pGetCtx  = (uintptr_t)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtGetContextThread");

    if (!pAlloc || !pProtect || !pFree || !pSetInfo || !pSetCtx || !pGetCtx) {
        return VGM_STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
    }

    g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtAllocateVirtualMemory = (uint64_t)pAlloc   ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY;
    g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtProtectVirtualMemory  = (uint64_t)pProtect ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY;
    g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtFreeVirtualMemory     = (uint64_t)pFree    ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY;
    g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtSetInformationProcess = (uint64_t)pSetInfo ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY;
    g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtSetContextThread      = (uint64_t)pSetCtx  ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY;
    g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtGetContextThread      = (uint64_t)pGetCtx  ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY;
    InitializeSRWLock(&g_MaskedApis.SlabLock);
    g_MaskedApis.SlabHead = NULL;

    if (Table != NULL) {
        *Table = g_MaskedApis;
    }
    return VGM_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

/*
 * FUN_1419ad5bf: 'Stub' (0x62757453) 64 KB Bitmap Slab Allocator
 * Allocates 128-byte aligned blocks out of 64 KB NtAllocateVirtualMemory slabs
 */
void *VgmStubAlloc(size_t Size)
{
    if (Size == 0 || Size > 64896) {
        return NULL;
    }

    if (g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtAllocateVirtualMemory == 0) {
        if (VgmInitMaskedApis(NULL) != VGM_STATUS_SUCCESS) {
            return NULL;
        }
    }

    size_t blocksNeeded = (Size + 127) >> 7;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_MaskedApis.SlabLock);

    PVGM_STUB_SLAB_NODE node = g_MaskedApis.SlabHead;
    while (node != NULL) {
        size_t consecutive = 0;
        size_t startBit = 0;
        for (size_t bit = 0; bit < 507; ++bit) {
            uint64_t word = node->Bitmap[bit >> 6];
            uint64_t mask = 1ULL << (bit & 63);
            if ((word & mask) == 0) {
                if (consecutive == 0) {
                    startBit = bit;
                }
                consecutive++;
                if (consecutive == blocksNeeded) {
                    for (size_t b = startBit; b < startBit + blocksNeeded; ++b) {
                        node->Bitmap[b >> 6] |= (1ULL << (b & 63));
                    }
                    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_MaskedApis.SlabLock);
                    return &node->DataBlocks[startBit * 128];
                }
            } else {
                consecutive = 0;
            }
        }
        node = node->Next;
    }

    /* Allocate a new 64 KB slab via unmasked NtAllocateVirtualMemory */
    PFN_NtAllocateVirtualMemory fnAlloc = (PFN_NtAllocateVirtualMemory)(
        (uintptr_t)(g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtAllocateVirtualMemory ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY)
    );

    PVOID baseAddr = NULL;
    SIZE_T regionSize = sizeof(VGM_STUB_SLAB_NODE);
    NTSTATUS st = fnAlloc(GetCurrentProcess(), &baseAddr, 0, &regionSize, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (st < 0 || baseAddr == NULL) {
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_MaskedApis.SlabLock);
        return NULL;
    }

    PVGM_STUB_SLAB_NODE newSlab = (PVGM_STUB_SLAB_NODE)baseAddr;
    ZeroMemory(newSlab, sizeof(*newSlab));
    newSlab->AllocationSize = regionSize;
    newSlab->Next = g_MaskedApis.SlabHead;
    g_MaskedApis.SlabHead = newSlab;

    for (size_t b = 0; b < blocksNeeded; ++b) {
        newSlab->Bitmap[b >> 6] |= (1ULL << (b & 63));
    }

    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_MaskedApis.SlabLock);
    return &newSlab->DataBlocks[0];
}

/*
 * FUN_1419ad6b3: 'Stub' Slab Deallocator
 */
void VgmStubFree(void *Ptr)
{
    if (Ptr == NULL || g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtFreeVirtualMemory == 0) {
        return;
    }

    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_MaskedApis.SlabLock);
    PVGM_STUB_SLAB_NODE *prevLink = &g_MaskedApis.SlabHead;
    PVGM_STUB_SLAB_NODE node = g_MaskedApis.SlabHead;

    while (node != NULL) {
        uintptr_t start = (uintptr_t)&node->DataBlocks[0];
        uintptr_t end   = start + sizeof(node->DataBlocks);
        uintptr_t addr  = (uintptr_t)Ptr;

        if (addr >= start && addr < end) {
            size_t bitIndex = (addr - start) >> 7;
            node->Bitmap[bitIndex >> 6] &= ~(1ULL << (bitIndex & 63));

            bool allFree = true;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
                if (node->Bitmap[i] != 0) {
                    allFree = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (allFree) {
                *prevLink = node->Next;
                PFN_NtFreeVirtualMemory fnFree = (PFN_NtFreeVirtualMemory)(
                    (uintptr_t)(g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtFreeVirtualMemory ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY)
                );
                PVOID baseAddr = (PVOID)node;
                SIZE_T regionSize = 0;
                fnFree(GetCurrentProcess(), &baseAddr, &regionSize, MEM_RELEASE);
            }
            break;
        }
        prevLink = &node->Next;
        node = node->Next;
    }

    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_MaskedApis.SlabLock);
}

/*
 * 24-Round Keccak-f[1600] Permutation from FUN_1419bf3d4
 */
void VgmKeccakF1600Permute(uint64_t State[25])
{
    for (int round = 0; round < 24; ++round) {
        uint64_t C[5];
        for (int x = 0; x < 5; ++x) {
            C[x] = State[x] ^ State[x + 5] ^ State[x + 10] ^ State[x + 15] ^ State[x + 20];
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < 5; ++x) {
            uint64_t D = C[(x + 4) % 5] ^ _rotl64(C[(x + 1) % 5], 1);
            for (int y = 0; y < 25; y += 5) {
                State[y + x] ^= D;
            }
        }

        uint64_t current = State[1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 24; ++i) {
            uint8_t piIndex = g_KeccakPiLane[i];
            uint64_t temp = State[piIndex];
            State[piIndex] = _rotl64(current, g_KeccakRotationOffsets[i]);
            current = temp;
        }

        for (int y = 0; y < 25; y += 5) {
            uint64_t row[5];
            for (int x = 0; x < 5; ++x) {
                row[x] = State[y + x];
            }
            for (int x = 0; x < 5; ++x) {
                State[y + x] = row[x] ^ ((~row[(x + 1) % 5]) & row[(x + 2) % 5]);
            }
        }

        State[0] ^= g_KeccakRoundConstants[round];
    }
}

/*
 * Computes the 8-byte Keccak-f[1600] integrity tag over the chunk descriptor table (FUN_1419bf3d4)
 */
uint64_t VgmKeccakChunkTableTag(const void *Data, size_t ByteLen, uint64_t Seed)
{
    uint64_t state[25];
    ZeroMemory(state, sizeof(state));
    state[0] = Seed;

    const uint8_t *bytes = (const uint8_t *)Data;
    size_t rateBytes = 136; /* SHA3-256 rate (1088 bits = 136 bytes) */

    while (ByteLen >= rateBytes) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < rateBytes / 8; ++i) {
            uint64_t lane = 0;
            memcpy(&lane, bytes + i * 8, sizeof(uint64_t));
            state[i] ^= lane;
        }
        VgmKeccakF1600Permute(state);
        bytes += rateBytes;
        ByteLen -= rateBytes;
    }

    uint8_t padded[136];
    ZeroMemory(padded, sizeof(padded));
    if (ByteLen > 0) {
        memcpy(padded, bytes, ByteLen);
    }
    padded[ByteLen] ^= 0x06;
    padded[rateBytes - 1] ^= 0x80;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < rateBytes / 8; ++i) {
        uint64_t lane = 0;
        memcpy(&lane, padded + i * 8, sizeof(uint64_t));
        state[i] ^= lane;
    }
    VgmKeccakF1600Permute(state);
    return state[0];
}

/*
 * RFC 1950 Adler-32 Checksum (Modulo 0xFFF1 = 65521) from FUN_1419bf3d4
 */
uint32_t VgmComputeAdler32(const uint8_t *Data, size_t Len)
{
    uint32_t s1 = 1;
    uint32_t s2 = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < Len; ++i) {
        s1 = (s1 + Data[i]) % 0xFFF1U;
        s2 = (s2 + s1) % 0xFFF1U;
    }
    return (s2 << 16) | s1;
}

/*
 * IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 Checksum (Polynomial 0xEDB88320) from FUN_1419bf3d4
 */
uint32_t VgmComputeCrc32(const uint8_t *Data, size_t Len)
{
    uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFFU;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Len; ++i) {
        crc ^= Data[i];
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 8; ++bit) {
            uint32_t mask = (uint32_t)(-(int32_t)(crc & 1U));
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320U & mask);
        }
    }
    return ~crc;
}

/*
 * Packman Stream Cipher (thunk_FUN_141a30898) used to decrypt section table & chunks
 */
void VgmStreamCipherXor(uint8_t *Buffer, size_t Length, const uint8_t Key[32], const uint8_t Nonce[12])
{
    uint32_t state[16];
    state[0] = 0x61707865U;
    state[1] = 0x3320646EU;
    state[2] = 0x79622D32U;
    state[3] = 0x6B206574U;

    memcpy(&state[4], Key, 32);
    state[12] = 0;
    memcpy(&state[13], Nonce, 12);

    size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < Length) {
        uint32_t work[16];
        memcpy(work, state, sizeof(work));

        for (int r = 0; r < 10; ++r) {
            work[0] += work[4]; work[12] = _rotl(work[12] ^ work[0], 16);
            work[8] += work[12]; work[4] = _rotl(work[4] ^ work[8], 12);
            work[1] += work[5]; work[13] = _rotl(work[13] ^ work[1], 16);
            work[9] += work[13]; work[5] = _rotl(work[5] ^ work[9], 12);
            work[2] += work[6]; work[14] = _rotl(work[14] ^ work[2], 16);
            work[10] += work[14]; work[6] = _rotl(work[6] ^ work[10], 12);
            work[3] += work[7]; work[15] = _rotl(work[15] ^ work[3], 16);
            work[11] += work[15]; work[7] = _rotl(work[7] ^ work[11], 12);
        }

        uint8_t keystream[64];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
            uint32_t val = work[i] + state[i];
            memcpy(&keystream[i * 4], &val, 4);
        }

        size_t chunk = (Length - offset < 64) ? (Length - offset) : 64;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < chunk; ++i) {
            Buffer[offset + i] ^= keystream[i];
        }

        state[12]++;
        offset += chunk;
    }
}

/*
 * FUN_1419bf3d4: Packman Self-Unpacker & Section Verifier
 * Validates LAB_1419cf0c0, verifies Keccak-f[1600] chunk tag, and processes the 8 chunks.
 */
NTSTATUS VgmPackmanUnpackImage(
    uintptr_t ImageBase,
    const VGM_PACK_DESCRIPTOR *Descriptor,
    bool SimulateOnly
)
{
    if (Descriptor == NULL || Descriptor->SectionCount != VGM_PACKED_SECTION_COUNT ||
        Descriptor->ChunkCount != VGM_PACKED_CHUNK_COUNT) {
        return VGM_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    if (g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtProtectVirtualMemory == 0) {
        NTSTATUS initSt = VgmInitMaskedApis(NULL);
        if (initSt != VGM_STATUS_SUCCESS) {
            return initSt;
        }
    }

    /* Compute Keccak-f[1600] verification over the 8 * 0x78 chunk table */
    uint64_t computedTag = VgmKeccakChunkTableTag(
        g_EmbeddedChunkTable,
        sizeof(g_EmbeddedChunkTable),
        Descriptor->SectionTableSeed
    );

    if (computedTag == 0) {
        return VGM_STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
    }

    if (SimulateOnly) {
        /* Allocate a scratch buffer from the 'Stub' slab allocator and test stream cipher + Adler32/CRC32 */
        uint8_t *scratch = (uint8_t *)VgmStubAlloc(512);
        if (scratch == NULL) {
            return VGM_STATUS_NO_MEMORY;
        }

        uint8_t key[32];
        memcpy(key, Descriptor->MasterKey, 8);
        memcpy(key + 8, Descriptor->MasterNonce, 12);
        memcpy(key + 20, Descriptor->MasterKeyTail, 12);

        for (size_t i = 0; i < 512; ++i) {
            scratch[i] = (uint8_t)(i ^ 0x5AU);
        }

        uint32_t origCrc   = VgmComputeCrc32(scratch, 512);
        uint32_t origAdler = VgmComputeAdler32(scratch, 512);

        /* Encrypt and decrypt round-trip using Chunk[0] nonce */
        VgmStreamCipherXor(scratch, 512, key, g_EmbeddedChunkTable[0].ChunkNonce);
        VgmStreamCipherXor(scratch, 512, key, g_EmbeddedChunkTable[0].ChunkNonce);

        uint32_t postCrc   = VgmComputeCrc32(scratch, 512);
        uint32_t postAdler = VgmComputeAdler32(scratch, 512);
        VgmStubFree(scratch);

        if (origCrc != postCrc || origAdler != postAdler) {
            return VGM_STATUS_BAD_COMPRESSION_DATA;
        }
        return VGM_STATUS_SUCCESS;
    }

    /* Live unpacking path: unprotect target sections via unmasked NtProtectVirtualMemory */
    PFN_NtProtectVirtualMemory fnProtect = (PFN_NtProtectVirtualMemory)(
        (uintptr_t)(g_MaskedApis.MaskedNtProtectVirtualMemory ^ VGM_PTR_XOR_KEY)
    );

    uint8_t masterKey[32];
    memcpy(masterKey, Descriptor->MasterKey, 8);
    memcpy(masterKey + 8, Descriptor->MasterNonce, 12);
    memcpy(masterKey + 20, Descriptor->MasterKeyTail, 12);

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < Descriptor->ChunkCount; ++i) {
        const VGM_PACK_CHUNK_ENTRY *chunk = &g_EmbeddedChunkTable[i];
        PVOID targetAddr = (PVOID)(ImageBase + chunk->TargetRva);
        SIZE_T regionSize = chunk->UnpackedSize;
        ULONG oldProtect = 0;

        NTSTATUS st = fnProtect(GetCurrentProcess(), &targetAddr, &regionSize, PAGE_READWRITE, &oldProtect);
        if (st < 0) {
            return st;
        }

        if (chunk->CipherMode == 1U) {
            VgmStreamCipherXor(
                (uint8_t *)(ImageBase + chunk->TargetRva),
                chunk->UnpackedSize,
                masterKey,
                chunk->ChunkNonce
            );
        }

        ULONG dummyProtect = 0;
        fnProtect(GetCurrentProcess(), &targetAddr, &regionSize, oldProtect, &dummyProtect);
    }

    return VGM_STATUS_SUCCESS;
}
```

`Vanguard/vgtray_src/README.md`:

```md
# Riot Vanguard Tray Application (`vgtray.exe`) — Reconstructed Source

This repository contains the complete C/Win32 reconstruction of the notification tray utility **`vgtray.exe`** (Riot Vanguard v1.19.1-18), produced via Reverse Engineering Architecture (REA) analysis on the original executable at `C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgtray.exe`.

---

## 1. Architectural Overview

**`vgtray.exe`** is the graphical user interface (GUI) component of Riot Vanguard running in the interactive user session:
- Executes as an unprivileged user-mode application (`asInvoker`, requiring no direct UAC elevation).
- Creates and maintains the official Vanguard icon in the Windows Notification Area (*System Tray*).
- Serves as a passive status monitor for the central service `vgc.exe` and kernel driver `vgk.sys`.
- Provides an interactive context menu (Turn Vanguard Off, Notification Settings, Help/Support) and diagnostic log bundle exporter.

---

## 2. File and Directory Structure

```
vgtray_src/
├── vgtray.sln                  # Visual Studio 2022 Solution
├── vgtray.vcxproj              # MSVC Project Configuration (Release|x64, Unicode, /MT)
├── vgtray.vcxproj.filters      # Visual Studio Filter Structure
├── vgtray.rc                   # Version Metadata (1.19.1-18) and Icon Resources
├── vgtray.h                    # Master Architecture, UI, Tray, and SCM Structures Header
├── main.c                      # WinMain, Hidden Message Window, Shell_NotifyIconW, and Menu
├── service_precheck.c          # SCM Service Status Query for vgc Service
├── toast_registry.c            # Toast Notifications and Registry Preference Storage
├── log_exporter.c              # Diagnostic Log Archiver and Explorer Launcher
└── panel_d3d11.c               # Direct3D 11 Modern Status Flyout Panel Renderer
```

---

## 3. Component Details

### 3.1 [`main.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgtray_src/main.c)
- **Single-Instance Mutex**: Creates and verifies the named mutex `Global\RiotVanguardTrayMutex` to ensure only one tray instance executes concurrently.
- **Hidden Window Class**: Registers the window class `VanguardTrayClass` to receive asynchronous notification messages from the Windows shell (`WM_USER + 1`, `TaskbarCreated`).
- **`Shell_NotifyIconW` Operations**: Manages the life cycle of the taskbar icon (`NIM_ADD`, `NIM_MODIFY`, `NIM_DELETE`).
- **Tray Context Menu**: Handles right-click and left-click notifications, presenting standard options:
  - *"Turn Vanguard Off"* (requests clean shutdown of service `vgc`).
  - *"Notification Settings"* (configures alert popups for blocked vulnerable drivers).
  - *"Export Logs..."* (triggers log archive packaging).
  - *"Exit Tray"*.

### 3.2 [`service_precheck.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgtray_src/service_precheck.c)
- **SCM (Service Control Manager) Client**: Connects via `OpenSCManagerW` and inspects the live status of the `vgc` service (`QueryServiceStatusProcess`).
- **Status Indicator**: Dynamically modifies tray icon tooltips to indicate whether the anti-cheat is operational (`SERVICE_RUNNING`), paused, or in an error state.

### 3.3 [`toast_registry.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgtray_src/toast_registry.c)
- **System Notification Dispatcher**: Triggers balloon and toast notifications informing the player when a vulnerable or uncertified driver is blocked by `vgk.sys`.
- **Registry Preferences**: Reads and persists user display preferences under `HKCU\Software\Riot Games\Riot Vanguard`.

### 3.4 [`log_exporter.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgtray_src/log_exporter.c)
- **Diagnostic Collection**: Gathers diagnostic log records and audit traces from `%PROGRAMFILES%\Riot Vanguard\Logs`.
- **Export Packaging**: Archives logs and crash dumps for customer support analysis, automatically opening the output directory in Windows Explorer.

### 3.5 [`panel_d3d11.c`](file:///C:/Users/joaop/Antigravity-Workspace/vgtray_src/panel_d3d11.c)
- **Direct3D 11 Modern Flyout**: Renders a hardware-accelerated status panel using DirectX 11 / DXGI integrated with Desktop Window Manager (DWM) composition.
- Displays live session state and performance indicators without interfering with active full-screen game rendering.

---

## 4. Prerequisites

- **Visual Studio 2022** with the **Desktop development with C++** workload.
- **Windows SDK 10.0 or 11.0**.
- Direct3D 11 and DXGI runtime libraries (included with Windows SDK).

```
