```c
/*
 * log_exporter.c
 * Vanguard Log Zip Exporter & vgtray-settings.json Serializer
 * Reconstructed from FUN_140083a40, FUN_140084560, and FUN_14009c7d0
 */

#include "vgtray.h"

/* ============================================================================
 * SETTINGS JSON SERIALIZER (FUN_14009c7d0)
 * Reads/writes %LOCALAPPDATA%\Riot Games\Riot Vanguard\vgtray-settings.json
 * Exact schema from FUN_14009c7d0:
 * {"theme":%d,"language":%d,"advanced_view":%d,"precheck_option":%d,
 *  "failure_reason":%d,"error_code":%lld,"vgtray_version":%d,
 *  "vanguard_version":"%s","precheck_opted_out":%d,
 *  "precheck_enrolled_but_unmet":%d,"precheck_completed_after_settings_changes":%d,
 *  "precheck_reverted_after_completion":%d,"precheck_initial_state_recorded":%d,
 *  "precheck_initially_unmet":%d,"precheck_completed_once":%d,
 *  "precheck_25h2_originally_missing":%d,"precheck_tpm_originally_missing":%d,
 *  "precheck_secure_boot_originally_missing":%d,"precheck_vbs_originally_missing":%d,
 *  "precheck_hvci_originally_missing":%d,"precheck_iommu_originally_missing":%d}
 * ============================================================================ */
static int VgTrayJsonReadInt(const char* szJson, const char* szKey, int iDefault)
{
    char szPattern[128] = { 0 };
    sprintf_s(szPattern, sizeof(szPattern), "\"%s\":", szKey);
    const char* pFound = strstr(szJson, szPattern);
    if (pFound == NULL) {
        return iDefault;
    }
    pFound += strlen(szPattern);
    while (*pFound == ' ' || *pFound == '\t') {
        pFound++;
    }
    return atoi(pFound);
}

BOOL VgTrayLoadSettingsJson(VGTRAY_SETTINGS* pSettings)
{
    if (pSettings == NULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    ZeroMemory(pSettings, sizeof(*pSettings));
    pSettings->theme = VgTrayIsSystemLightTheme() ? 1 : 0;
    pSettings->language = 0; /* English */
    pSettings->advanced_view = 0;
    pSettings->precheck_option = 0;
    pSettings->failure_reason = 0;
    pSettings->error_code = 0;
    pSettings->vgtray_version = VGTRAY_SCHEMA_VERSION;
    strcpy_s(pSettings->vanguard_version, sizeof(pSettings->vanguard_version), VGTRAY_VERSION_STRING);

    if (g_VgTray.wszSettingsFilePath[0] == L'\0') {
        return FALSE;
    }

    HANDLE hFile = CreateFileW(
        g_VgTray.wszSettingsFilePath,
        GENERIC_READ,
        FILE_SHARE_READ,
        NULL,
        OPEN_EXISTING,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        NULL);
    if (hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    char szBuf[2048] = { 0 };
    DWORD cbRead = 0;
    BOOL bOk = ReadFile(hFile, szBuf, sizeof(szBuf) - 1, &cbRead, NULL);
    CloseHandle(hFile);

    if (!bOk || cbRead == 0) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    szBuf[cbRead] = '\0';
    pSettings->theme             = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "theme", pSettings->theme);
    pSettings->language          = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "language", 0);
    pSettings->advanced_view     = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "advanced_view", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_option   = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_option", 0);
    pSettings->failure_reason    = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "failure_reason", 0);
    pSettings->vgtray_version    = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "vgtray_version", VGTRAY_SCHEMA_VERSION);
    pSettings->precheck_opted_out = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_opted_out", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_enrolled_but_unmet = VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_enrolled_but_unmet", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_completed_after_settings_changes =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_completed_after_settings_changes", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_reverted_after_completion =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_reverted_after_completion", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_initial_state_recorded =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_initial_state_recorded", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_initially_unmet =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_initially_unmet", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_completed_once =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_completed_once", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_25h2_originally_missing =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_25h2_originally_missing", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_tpm_originally_missing =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_tpm_originally_missing", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_secure_boot_originally_missing =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_secure_boot_originally_missing", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_vbs_originally_missing =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_vbs_originally_missing", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_hvci_originally_missing =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_hvci_originally_missing", 0);
    pSettings->precheck_iommu_originally_missing =
        VgTrayJsonReadInt(szBuf, "precheck_iommu_originally_missing", 0);

    return TRUE;
}

BOOL VgTraySaveSettingsJson(const VGTRAY_SETTINGS* pSettings)
{
    if (pSettings == NULL || g_VgTray.wszSettingsFilePath[0] == L'\0') {
        return FALSE;
    }

    char szJson[2048] = { 0 };
    int cbLen = sprintf_s(
        szJson,
        sizeof(szJson),
        "{\"theme\":%d,\"language\":%d,\"advanced_view\":%d,\"precheck_option\":%d,"
        "\"failure_reason\":%d,\"error_code\":%lld,\"vgtray_version\":%d,"
        "\"vanguard_version\":\"%s\",\"precheck_opted_out\":%d,"
        "\"precheck_enrolled_but_unmet\":%d,\"precheck_completed_after_settings_changes\":%d,"
        "\"precheck_reverted_after_completion\":%d,\"precheck_initial_state_recorded\":%d,"
        "\"precheck_initially_unmet\":%d,\"precheck_completed_once\":%d,"
        "\"precheck_25h2_originally_missing\":%d,\"precheck_tpm_originally_missing\":%d,"
        "\"precheck_secure_boot_originally_missing\":%d,\"precheck_vbs_originally_missing\":%d,"
        "\"precheck_hvci_originally_missing\":%d,\"precheck_iommu_originally_missing\":%d}",
        pSettings->theme,
        pSettings->language,
        pSettings->advanced_view,
        pSettings->precheck_option,
        pSettings->failure_reason,
        (long long)pSettings->error_code,
        pSettings->vgtray_version,
        pSettings->vanguard_version[0] ? pSettings->vanguard_version : VGTRAY_VERSION_STRING,
        pSettings->precheck_opted_out,
        pSettings->precheck_enrolled_but_unmet,
        pSettings->precheck_completed_after_settings_changes,
        pSettings->precheck_reverted_after_completion,
        pSettings->precheck_initial_state_recorded,
        pSettings->precheck_initially_unmet,
        pSettings->precheck_completed_once,
        pSettings->precheck_25h2_originally_missing,
        pSettings->precheck_tpm_originally_missing,
        pSettings->precheck_secure_boot_originally_missing,
        pSettings->precheck_vbs_originally_missing,
        pSettings->precheck_hvci_originally_missing,
        pSettings->precheck_iommu_originally_missing);

    if (cbLen <= 0) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    HANDLE hFile = CreateFileW(
        g_VgTray.wszSettingsFilePath,
        GENERIC_WRITE,
        0,
        NULL,
        CREATE_ALWAYS,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        NULL);
    if (hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    DWORD dwWritten = 0;
    BOOL bOk = WriteFile(hFile, szJson, (DWORD)cbLen, &dwWritten, NULL);
    CloseHandle(hFile);
    return (bOk && dwWritten == (DWORD)cbLen);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * SAVE RIOT VANGUARD LOGS ZIP ARCHIVER (FUN_140083a40)
 * 1. Generates default archive name "vanguard_logs_%04u%02u%02u_%02u%02u%02u.zip"
 * 2. Prompts user via GetSaveFileNameW (Title: "Save Riot Vanguard Logs",
 *    Filter: "Zip Files (*.zip)\0*.zip\0", Flags: 0x806)
 * 3. Creates staging dir "%TEMP%\vanguard_logs_<timestamp>"
 * 4. Copies *.log files from "<InstallDir>\Logs" via FindFirstFileW + CopyFileW
 * 5. Invokes:
 *      powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command
 *      "Compress-Archive -Path '<temp>\*.log' -DestinationPath '<dest>' -Force"
 *    with CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x08000000) and 60,000ms WaitForSingleObject
 * 6. Cleans up staging dir and highlights output file via:
 *      ShellExecuteW(NULL, L"open", L"explorer.exe", L"/select,\"<dest>\"", NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL)
 * ============================================================================ */
BOOL VgTrayExportLogsZipInteractive(HWND hOwnerWnd)
{
    SYSTEMTIME st;
    GetLocalTime(&st);

    WCHAR wszStamp[64] = { 0 };
    swprintf_s(
        wszStamp,
        _countof(wszStamp),
        L"%04u%02u%02u_%02u%02u%02u",
        st.wYear, st.wMonth, st.wDay,
        st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond);

    WCHAR wszDestZip[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    swprintf_s(wszDestZip, _countof(wszDestZip), L"vanguard_logs_%s.zip", wszStamp);

    OPENFILENAMEW ofn = { 0 };
    ofn.lStructSize = sizeof(ofn);
    ofn.hwndOwner = hOwnerWnd;
    ofn.lpstrFilter = L"Zip Files (*.zip)\0*.zip\0\0";
    ofn.lpstrFile = wszDestZip;
    ofn.nMaxFile = MAX_PATH;
    ofn.lpstrTitle = L"Save Riot Vanguard Logs";
    ofn.Flags = OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT | OFN_HIDEREADONLY | OFN_EXPLORER; /* 0x806 */
    ofn.lpstrDefExt = L"zip";

    if (!GetSaveFileNameW(&ofn)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    WCHAR wszTempRoot[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    DWORD cchTemp = GetTempPathW(MAX_PATH, wszTempRoot);
    if (cchTemp == 0 || cchTemp >= MAX_PATH) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    WCHAR wszStageDir[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    swprintf_s(wszStageDir, _countof(wszStageDir), L"%svanguard_logs_%s", wszTempRoot, wszStamp);
    if (!CreateDirectoryW(wszStageDir, NULL) && GetLastError() != ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    /* Copy Logs\*.log from Vanguard directory into staging folder */
    WCHAR wszLogsPattern[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    swprintf_s(wszLogsPattern, _countof(wszLogsPattern), L"%s\\Logs\\*.log", g_VgTray.wszInstallDir);

    DWORD cCopied = 0;
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW ffd = { 0 };
    HANDLE hFind = FindFirstFileW(wszLogsPattern, &ffd);
    if (hFind != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        do {
            if ((ffd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) == 0) {
                WCHAR wszSrcFile[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
                WCHAR wszDstFile[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
                swprintf_s(wszSrcFile, _countof(wszSrcFile), L"%s\\Logs\\%s", g_VgTray.wszInstallDir, ffd.cFileName);
                swprintf_s(wszDstFile, _countof(wszDstFile), L"%s\\%s", wszStageDir, ffd.cFileName);
                if (CopyFileW(wszSrcFile, wszDstFile, FALSE)) {
                    cCopied++;
                }
            }
        } while (FindNextFileW(hFind, &ffd));
        FindClose(hFind);
    }

    /* Also copy %LOCALAPPDATA%\Riot Games\Riot Vanguard\vgtray.log if present */
    if (g_VgTray.wszLogFilePath[0] != L'\0') {
        WCHAR wszTrayLogDst[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
        swprintf_s(wszTrayLogDst, _countof(wszTrayLogDst), L"%s\\vgtray.log", wszStageDir);
        if (CopyFileW(g_VgTray.wszLogFilePath, wszTrayLogDst, FALSE)) {
            cCopied++;
        }
    }

    BOOL bArchived = FALSE;
    if (cCopied > 0) {
        DeleteFileW(wszDestZip);

        WCHAR wszPsCmd[1024] = { 0 };
        swprintf_s(
            wszPsCmd,
            _countof(wszPsCmd),
            L"powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command \"Compress-Archive -Path '%s\\*.log' -DestinationPath '%s' -Force\"",
            wszStageDir,
            wszDestZip);

        STARTUPINFOW si = { 0 };
        PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = { 0 };
        si.cb = sizeof(si);
        si.dwFlags = STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW;

        if (CreateProcessW(
                NULL,
                wszPsCmd,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                FALSE,
                CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                &si,
                &pi)) {
            WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, 60000);
            DWORD dwExitCode = 1;
            GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &dwExitCode);
            CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
            CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);

            DWORD dwAttrs = GetFileAttributesW(wszDestZip);
            bArchived = (dwExitCode == 0 && dwAttrs != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES &&
                         (dwAttrs & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) == 0);
        }
    }

    /* Cleanup staged *.log files and remove temp folder (FUN_140083a40) */
    WCHAR wszStageCleanup[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    swprintf_s(wszStageCleanup, _countof(wszStageCleanup), L"%s\\*", wszStageDir);
    hFind = FindFirstFileW(wszStageCleanup, &ffd);
    if (hFind != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        do {
            if ((ffd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) == 0) {
                WCHAR wszTmpFile[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
                swprintf_s(wszTmpFile, _countof(wszTmpFile), L"%s\\%s", wszStageDir, ffd.cFileName);
                DeleteFileW(wszTmpFile);
            }
        } while (FindNextFileW(hFind, &ffd));
        FindClose(hFind);
    }
    RemoveDirectoryW(wszStageDir);

    if (bArchived) {
        WCHAR wszSelectArg[MAX_PATH + 32] = { 0 };
        swprintf_s(wszSelectArg, _countof(wszSelectArg), L"/select,\"%s\"", wszDestZip);
        ShellExecuteW(NULL, L"open", L"explorer.exe", wszSelectArg, NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
        VgTrayLogW(L"Saved Vanguard logs archive to %ls", wszDestZip);
    }

    return bArchived;
}
```

`Vanguard/vgtray_src/main.c`:

```c
/*
 * main.c
 * Entry Point, Single-Instance Guard, and System Tray Window for vgtray.exe
 * Reconstructed from FUN_140089200, FUN_140091060, FUN_140091470, FUN_140091850
 */

#include "vgtray.h"
#include <stdarg.h>

VGTRAY_CONTEXT g_VgTray = { 0 };
static UINT g_uTaskbarRestartMsg = 0;

/* ============================================================================
 * LOGGING SUBSYSTEM (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Riot Games\Riot Vanguard\vgtray.log)
 * Matches format "[%04u-%02u-%02u %02u:%02u:%02u] %ls\n"
 * ============================================================================ */
static void VgTrayInitPaths(void)
{
    WCHAR wszModulePath[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, wszModulePath, MAX_PATH);
    wcscpy_s(g_VgTray.wszInstallDir, MAX_PATH, wszModulePath);
    WCHAR* pLastSlash = wcsrchr(g_VgTray.wszInstallDir, L'\\');
    if (pLastSlash) {
        *pLastSlash = L'\0';
    }

    WCHAR wszLocalAppData[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    DWORD cch = GetEnvironmentVariableW(L"LOCALAPPDATA", wszLocalAppData, MAX_PATH);
    if (cch > 0 && cch < MAX_PATH) {
        swprintf_s(g_VgTray.wszLocalAppDataDir, MAX_PATH, L"%s\\Riot Games", wszLocalAppData);
        CreateDirectoryW(g_VgTray.wszLocalAppDataDir, NULL);
        swprintf_s(g_VgTray.wszLocalAppDataDir, MAX_PATH, L"%s\\Riot Games\\Riot Vanguard", wszLocalAppData);
        CreateDirectoryW(g_VgTray.wszLocalAppDataDir, NULL);

        swprintf_s(g_VgTray.wszLogFilePath, MAX_PATH, L"%s\\vgtray.log", g_VgTray.wszLocalAppDataDir);
        swprintf_s(g_VgTray.wszSettingsFilePath, MAX_PATH, L"%s\\vgtray-settings.json", g_VgTray.wszLocalAppDataDir);
    }
}

void VgTrayLogW(const wchar_t* fmt, ...)
{
    if (g_VgTray.wszLogFilePath[0] == L'\0') {
        return;
    }

    WCHAR wszBody[1024] = { 0 };
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, fmt);
    _vsnwprintf_s(wszBody, _countof(wszBody), _TRUNCATE, fmt, args);
    va_end(args);

    SYSTEMTIME st;
    GetLocalTime(&st);

    WCHAR wszLine[1200] = { 0 };
    int cchLine = swprintf_s(
        wszLine,
        _countof(wszLine),
        L"[%04u-%02u-%02u %02u:%02u:%02u] %ls\r\n",
        st.wYear, st.wMonth, st.wDay,
        st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond,
        wszBody);

    if (cchLine <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    char szUtf8[2400] = { 0 };
    int cbUtf8 = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wszLine, cchLine, szUtf8, sizeof(szUtf8), NULL, NULL);
    if (cbUtf8 > 0) {
        HANDLE hFile = CreateFileW(
            g_VgTray.wszLogFilePath,
            FILE_APPEND_DATA,
            FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
            NULL,
            OPEN_ALWAYS,
            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
            NULL);
        if (hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            DWORD dwWritten = 0;
            WriteFile(hFile, szUtf8, (DWORD)cbUtf8, &dwWritten, NULL);
            CloseHandle(hFile);
        }
    }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * OLD INSTANCE TERMINATION GUARD (FUN_140089200)
 * Walks CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0) and terminates any
 * previous vgtray.exe process before acquiring Global\vgtray_mutex.
 * ============================================================================ */
static void VgTrayTerminatePreviousInstances(void)
{
    DWORD dwSelfPid = GetCurrentProcessId();
    WCHAR wszSelfPath[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, wszSelfPath, MAX_PATH);

    HANDLE hSnap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (hSnap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return;
    }

    PROCESSENTRY32W pe = { 0 };
    pe.dwSize = sizeof(pe);

    if (Process32FirstW(hSnap, &pe)) {
        do {
            if (pe.th32ProcessID != dwSelfPid &&
                _wcsicmp(pe.szExeFile, L"vgtray.exe") == 0) {
                /* OpenProcess(SYNCHRONIZE | PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION | PROCESS_TERMINATE) = 0x101001 */
                HANDLE hProc = OpenProcess(0x101001, FALSE, pe.th32ProcessID);
                if (hProc != NULL) {
                    WCHAR wszOtherPath[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
                    DWORD cchOther = MAX_PATH;
                    if (QueryFullProcessImageNameW(hProc, 0, wszOtherPath, &cchOther)) {
                        if (_wcsicmp(wszSelfPath, wszOtherPath) == 0) {
                            TerminateProcess(hProc, 0);
                            WaitForSingleObject(hProc, 3000);
                        }
                    }
                    CloseHandle(hProc);
                }
            }
        } while (Process32NextW(hSnap, &pe));
    }

    CloseHandle(hSnap);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * EXIT EVENT WATCHER THREAD (FUN_140089b20)
 * Waits on Global\vgtray_exit_event and posts WM_CLOSE to the tray window.
 * ============================================================================ */
static DWORD WINAPI VgTrayExitEventThread(LPVOID lpParam)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(lpParam);
    HANDLE hEvents[2] = { g_VgTray.hExitEvent, g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent };
    DWORD dwWait = WaitForMultipleObjects(2, hEvents, FALSE, INFINITE);
    if (dwWait == WAIT_OBJECT_0 && g_VgTray.hTrayWnd != NULL) {
        PostMessageW(g_VgTray.hTrayWnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * SYSTEM LIGHT / DARK THEME QUERY (FUN_140089960)
 * Reads HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize
 * ============================================================================ */
BOOL VgTrayIsSystemLightTheme(void)
{
    HKEY hKey = NULL;
    DWORD dwLight = 0;
    DWORD cbData = sizeof(dwLight);
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, THEME_PERSONALIZE_KEY, 0, KEY_READ, &hKey) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        RegQueryValueExW(hKey, THEME_VAL_LIGHT_THEME, NULL, NULL, (LPBYTE)&dwLight, &cbData);
        RegCloseKey(hKey);
    }
    return (dwLight != 0);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * SHELL_NOTIFYICONW MANAGEMENT (FUN_140091060 / FUN_140091230 / FUN_140091360)
 * Uses official GUID {70D5F62D-0932-47D8-9E1A-BA4B95549E3E} and uFlags=0xA7.
 * ============================================================================ */
static BOOL VgTrayRegisterNotifyIcon(HWND hWnd)
{
    NOTIFYICONDATAW nid = { 0 };
    nid.cbSize = sizeof(NOTIFYICONDATAW);
    nid.hWnd = hWnd;
    nid.uID = 0;
    nid.uFlags = NIF_MESSAGE | NIF_ICON | NIF_TIP | NIF_GUID | NIF_SHOWTIP; /* 0xA7 */
    nid.uCallbackMessage = WM_VGTRAY_NOTIFYICON;                            /* 0x8001 */
    nid.hIcon = g_VgTray.hTrayIcon;
    nid.guidItem = VGTRAY_NOTIFYICON_GUID;
    wcscpy_s(nid.szTip, _countof(nid.szTip), L"Riot Vanguard");

    /* Remove stale icon first, then add and set version 4 (FUN_140091060) */
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &nid);
    if (!Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_ADD, &nid)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    nid.uVersion = NOTIFYICON_VERSION_4;
    return Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_SETVERSION, &nid);
}

static void VgTrayRemoveNotifyIcon(HWND hWnd)
{
    NOTIFYICONDATAW nid = { 0 };
    nid.cbSize = sizeof(NOTIFYICONDATAW);
    nid.hWnd = hWnd;
    nid.uFlags = NIF_GUID;
    nid.guidItem = VGTRAY_NOTIFYICON_GUID;
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &nid);
}

void VgTrayShowBalloonNotification(const wchar_t* wszTitle, const wchar_t* wszBody, DWORD dwInfoFlags)
{
    if (g_VgTray.hTrayWnd == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    NOTIFYICONDATAW nid = { 0 };
    nid.cbSize = sizeof(NOTIFYICONDATAW);
    nid.hWnd = g_VgTray.hTrayWnd;
    nid.uFlags = NIF_INFO | NIF_GUID | NIF_SHOWTIP;
    nid.guidItem = VGTRAY_NOTIFYICON_GUID;
    nid.dwInfoFlags = dwInfoFlags;
    wcsncpy_s(nid.szInfoTitle, _countof(nid.szInfoTitle), wszTitle ? wszTitle : L"Riot Vanguard", _TRUNCATE);
    wcsncpy_s(nid.szInfo, _countof(nid.szInfo), wszBody ? wszBody : L"", _TRUNCATE);
    Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, &nid);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * TRAY CONTEXT MENU & COMMAND HANDLER (FUN_1400912b0 / FUN_140091850)
 * ============================================================================ */
void VgTrayShowContextMenu(HWND hWnd, POINT pt)
{
    HMENU hMenuBar = LoadMenuW(g_VgTray.hInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDR_TRAY_MENU));
    HMENU hPopup = hMenuBar ? GetSubMenu(hMenuBar, 0) : NULL;
    BOOL bCreatedDynamic = FALSE;

    if (hPopup == NULL) {
        hPopup = CreatePopupMenu();
        bCreatedDynamic = TRUE;
        HMENU hMoreMenu = CreatePopupMenu();
        AppendMenuW(hMoreMenu, MF_STRING, IDM_TRAY_EXIT_VANGUARD, L"Exit Vanguard");
        AppendMenuW(hMoreMenu, MF_STRING, IDM_TRAY_UNINSTALL_VANGUARD, L"Uninstall Vanguard");

        AppendMenuW(hPopup, MF_STRING, IDM_TRAY_SHOW_PANEL, L"Show Panel");
        AppendMenuW(hPopup, MF_STRING | (g_VgTray.settings.advanced_view ? MF_CHECKED : MF_UNCHECKED),
                    IDM_TRAY_TOGGLE_ADVANCED, L"Advanced View");
        AppendMenuW(hPopup, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, NULL);
        AppendMenuW(hPopup, MF_STRING, IDM_TRAY_SAVE_LOGS, L"Save Logs...");
        AppendMenuW(hPopup, MF_POPUP, (UINT_PTR)hMoreMenu, L"More");
        AppendMenuW(hPopup, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, NULL);
        AppendMenuW(hPopup, MF_STRING, IDM_TRAY_EXIT_TRAY, L"Exit Tray");
    } else {
        CheckMenuItem(hPopup, IDM_TRAY_TOGGLE_ADVANCED,
                      MF_BYCOMMAND | (g_VgTray.settings.advanced_view ? MF_CHECKED : MF_UNCHECKED));
    }

    SetForegroundWindow(hWnd);
    TrackPopupMenu(hPopup, TPM_RIGHTBUTTON | TPM_BOTTOMALIGN, pt.x, pt.y, 0, hWnd, NULL);
    PostMessageW(hWnd, WM_NULL, 0, 0);

    if (bCreatedDynamic) {
        DestroyMenu(hPopup);
    } else if (hMenuBar) {
        DestroyMenu(hMenuBar);
    }
}

static BOOL VgTrayHandleCommand(HWND hWnd, WORD wCommandId)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(hWnd);

    switch (wCommandId) {
    case IDM_TRAY_EXIT_VANGUARD: /* 0x9C41 */
    {
        int iResp = MessageBoxW(
            NULL,
            L"This will turn off Vanguard. To play games that depend on Vanguard functionality, you will need to restart your computer.\n\nDo you want to continue?",
            L"Are you sure you want to continue?",
            MB_YESNO | MB_ICONWARNING | MB_DEFBUTTON2 | MB_SETFOREGROUND);
        if (iResp == IDYES) {
            VgTrayLogW(L"User confirmed Exit Vanguard (0x9C41); stopping vgc and vgk services.");
            VgTrayStopServiceByName(L"vgc");
            VgTrayStopServiceByName(L"vgk");
            if (g_VgTray.hTrayWnd != NULL) {
                PostMessageW(g_VgTray.hTrayWnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
            }
        }
        return TRUE;
    }

    case IDM_TRAY_UNINSTALL_VANGUARD: /* 0x9C42 */
    {
        /* Matches exact MessageBoxW flags 0x133 / confirmation in FUN_140091850 */
        int iResp = MessageBoxW(
            NULL,
            L"This will completely uninstall \"Riot Vanguard\" from your computer. Games that depend on its functionality will stop working.\n\nDo you want to continue?",
            L"Are you sure you want to continue?",
            0x133);
        if (iResp == IDYES) {
            WCHAR wszUninstaller[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
            swprintf_s(wszUninstaller, MAX_PATH, L"%s\\uninstall.exe", g_VgTray.wszInstallDir);
            if (GetFileAttributesW(wszUninstaller) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
                swprintf_s(wszUninstaller, MAX_PATH, L"%s\\installer.exe", g_VgTray.wszInstallDir);
            }

            WCHAR wszCmdLine[MAX_PATH + 32] = { 0 };
            swprintf_s(wszCmdLine, _countof(wszCmdLine), L"\"%s\" --quiet", wszUninstaller);

            STARTUPINFOW si = { 0 };
            PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = { 0 };
            si.cb = sizeof(si);

            VgTrayLogW(L"Launching uninstaller: %ls", wszCmdLine);
            if (CreateProcessW(NULL, wszCmdLine, NULL, NULL, FALSE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) {
                CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
                CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
            }
            PostQuitMessage(0);
        }
        return TRUE;
    }

    case IDM_TRAY_EXIT_TRAY: /* 0x9C43 */
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return TRUE;

    case IDM_TRAY_SAVE_LOGS: /* 0x9C44 */
        VgTrayExportLogsZipInteractive(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd ? g_VgTray.hPanelWnd : g_VgTray.hTrayWnd);
        return TRUE;

    case IDM_TRAY_TOGGLE_ADVANCED: /* 0x9C45 */
        g_VgTray.settings.advanced_view = !g_VgTray.settings.advanced_view;
        VgTraySaveSettingsJson(&g_VgTray.settings);
        VgTrayRefreshPanelLayout();
        return TRUE;

    case IDM_TRAY_SHOW_PANEL: /* 0x9C4A */
        VgTrayShowPanelWindow();
        return TRUE;

    default:
        return FALSE;
    }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * TRAY CALLBACK DISPATCHER (FUN_140091470)
 * Handles WM_VGTRAY_NOTIFYICON (0x8001):
 * - 0x007B (WM_CONTEXTMENU): Open right-click menu
 * - 0x0400 (NIN_SELECT): Toggle Vanguard Panel window (300ms debounce)
 * - 0x0404 (NIN_BALLOONTIMEOUT): Clear balloon state
 * - 0x0405 (NIN_BALLOONUSERCLICK): Show MessageBox & open Riot Support URL
 * ============================================================================ */
static LRESULT VgTrayHandleNotifyIconEvent(HWND hWnd, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    static DWORD s_dwLastClickTick = 0;
    WORD wEvent = LOWORD(lParam);

    if (wEvent == WM_CONTEXTMENU || wEvent == WM_RBUTTONUP) { /* 0x7B */
        POINT pt = { 0 };
        if (!GetCursorPos(&pt)) {
            pt.x = (SHORT)LOWORD(wParam);
            pt.y = (SHORT)HIWORD(wParam);
        }
        VgTrayShowContextMenu(hWnd, pt);
        return 1;
    } else if (wEvent == NIN_SELECT || wEvent == (NIN_SELECT | NINF_KEY) || wEvent == WM_LBUTTONUP) { /* 0x400 */
        DWORD dwNow = GetTickCount();
        if (dwNow - s_dwLastClickTick > 299) {
            s_dwLastClickTick = dwNow;
            if (g_VgTray.hPanelWnd && IsWindowVisible(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd)) {
                VgTrayHidePanelWindow();
            } else {
                VgTrayShowPanelWindow();
            }
        }
        return 1;
    } else if (wEvent == NIN_BALLOONTIMEOUT) { /* 0x404 */
        NOTIFYICONDATAW nid = { 0 };
        nid.cbSize = sizeof(NOTIFYICONDATAW);
        nid.hWnd = hWnd;
        nid.uFlags = NIF_GUID | NIF_SHOWTIP;
        nid.guidItem = VGTRAY_NOTIFYICON_GUID;
        Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, &nid);
        return 1;
    } else if (wEvent == NIN_BALLOONUSERCLICK) { /* 0x405 */
        VGTRAY_TOAST_ITEM toast = { 0 };
        BOOL bHasToast = FALSE;

        EnterCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);
        if (g_VgTray.bHasPendingToast) {
            toast = g_VgTray.lastToast;
            bHasToast = TRUE;
        }
        LeaveCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);

        if (bHasToast) {
            int iResp = MessageBoxW(NULL, toast.wszMessage, L"Riot Vanguard", MB_YESNO | MB_ICONWARNING);
            if (iResp == IDYES && toast.wszHelpUrl[0] != L'\0') {
                ShellExecuteW(NULL, L"open", toast.wszHelpUrl, NULL, NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
            }
        } else {
            ShellExecuteW(NULL, L"open", VANGUARD_SUPPORT_URL_REQ, NULL, NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
        }
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * VANGUARD TRAY WINDOW PROCEDURE (FUN_140091060)
 * ============================================================================ */
static LRESULT CALLBACK VgTrayWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    if (uMsg == g_uTaskbarRestartMsg && g_uTaskbarRestartMsg != 0) {
        VgTrayRegisterNotifyIcon(hWnd);
        return 0;
    }

    switch (uMsg) {
    case WM_CREATE:
        if (!VgTrayRegisterNotifyIcon(hWnd)) {
            ExitProcess(0);
        }
        WTSRegisterSessionNotification(hWnd, NOTIFY_FOR_THIS_SESSION);
        SetTimer(hWnd, 1, 500, NULL);
        return 0;

    case WM_TIMER:
        if (wParam == 1) {
            /* Periodic 500ms tray icon / toast check (FUN_140091360) */
            VGTRAY_TOAST_ITEM toast = { 0 };
            if (VgTrayPollKbToastNotification(&toast)) {
                VgTrayShowBalloonNotification(toast.wszTitle, toast.wszMessage, NIIF_WARNING);
            }
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        if (VgTrayHandleCommand(hWnd, LOWORD(wParam))) {
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_VGTRAY_NOTIFYICON:
        if (VgTrayHandleNotifyIconEvent(hWnd, wParam, lParam)) {
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_VGTRAY_SHOW_CONTEXT:
    {
        POINT pt = { 0 };
        GetCursorPos(&pt);
        VgTrayShowContextMenu(hWnd, pt);
        return 0;
    }

    case WM_DESTROY:
        KillTimer(hWnd, 1);
        WTSUnRegisterSessionNotification(hWnd);
        VgTrayRemoveNotifyIcon(hWnd);
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }

    return DefWindowProcW(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * ENTRY POINT (wWinMain — FUN_140089200)
 * ============================================================================ */
int WINAPI wWinMain(
    _In_ HINSTANCE hInstance,
    _In_opt_ HINSTANCE hPrevInstance,
    _In_ LPWSTR lpCmdLine,
    _In_ int nShowCmd)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(hPrevInstance);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(lpCmdLine);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(nShowCmd);

    /* 1. Per-Monitor DPI Awareness V2 (-4) */
    SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2);

    ZeroMemory(&g_VgTray, sizeof(g_VgTray));
    g_VgTray.hInstance = hInstance;
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csStateLock);
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);
    VgTrayInitPaths();

    VgTrayLogW(L"vgtray starting (%ls)", VGTRAY_VERSION_WSTR);

    /* 2. Terminate any older running vgtray.exe instance */
    VgTrayTerminatePreviousInstances();

    /* 3. Create Global\vgtray_mutex & Global\vgtray_exit_event (FUN_140089200) */
    g_VgTray.hMutex = CreateMutexW(NULL, TRUE, VGTRAY_MUTEX_NAME);
    if (g_VgTray.hMutex == NULL || GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) {
        if (g_VgTray.hMutex) {
            CloseHandle(g_VgTray.hMutex);
        }
        return 2;
    }

    g_VgTray.hExitEvent = CreateEventW(NULL, TRUE, FALSE, VGTRAY_EXIT_EVENT_NAME);
    g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent = CreateEventW(NULL, TRUE, FALSE, NULL);
    g_VgTray.hPanelReadyEvent = CreateEventW(NULL, TRUE, FALSE, NULL);

    /* 4. Load settings JSON & evaluate initial security pre-check state */
    VgTrayLoadSettingsJson(&g_VgTray.settings);
    VgTrayEvaluateSecurityPrecheck(&g_VgTray.precheck);
    VgTrayPollServiceSnapshot(L"vgc", &g_VgTray.svcVgc);
    VgTrayPollServiceSnapshot(L"vgk", &g_VgTray.svcVgk);
    VgTraySaveSettingsJson(&g_VgTray.settings);

    /* 5. Load tray icon matching system light/dark theme */
    g_VgTray.hTrayIcon = LoadIconW(NULL, IDI_SHIELD);
    g_uTaskbarRestartMsg = RegisterWindowMessageW(L"TaskbarCreated");

    /* 6. Register VanguardTrayWindowClass (FUN_140089200) */
    WNDCLASSEXW wc = { 0 };
    wc.cbSize = sizeof(WNDCLASSEXW);
    wc.lpfnWndProc = VgTrayWndProc;
    wc.hInstance = hInstance;
    wc.hIcon = g_VgTray.hTrayIcon;
    wc.lpszClassName = VGTRAY_WINDOW_CLASS;
    if (!RegisterClassExW(&wc)) {
        return 1;
    }

    g_VgTray.hTrayWnd = CreateWindowExW(
        0,
        VGTRAY_WINDOW_CLASS,
        L"Riot Vanguard",
        WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW,
        0, 0, 0, 0,
        NULL, NULL, hInstance, NULL);
    if (g_VgTray.hTrayWnd == NULL) {
        return 1;
    }

    /* 7. Spawn worker threads:
     *    - Exit event listener (FUN_140089b20)
     *    - Panel UI + D3D11 dashboard thread (FUN_1400b0ba0)
     *    - Service status monitor thread (FUN_1400b1ea0)
     *    - Registry toast watcher thread (FUN_14008e8f0)
     */
    g_VgTray.hExitWatcherThread = CreateThread(NULL, 0, VgTrayExitEventThread, NULL, 0, NULL);
    g_VgTray.hPanelThread = CreateThread(NULL, 0, VgTrayPanelThread, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (g_VgTray.hPanelReadyEvent) {
        WaitForSingleObject(g_VgTray.hPanelReadyEvent, 5000);
    }
    g_VgTray.hServiceMonitorThread = CreateThread(NULL, 0, VgTrayServiceMonitorThread, NULL, 0, NULL);
    g_VgTray.hToastWatcherThread = CreateThread(NULL, 0, VgTrayToastWatcherThread, NULL, 0, NULL);

    /* 8. Standard Win32 Message Loop */
    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0) > 0) {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }

    /* 9. Orderly LIFO Teardown */
    SetEvent(g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent);
    if (g_VgTray.hPanelWnd) {
        PostMessageW(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
    }

    HANDLE hThreads[4];
    DWORD cThreads = 0;
    if (g_VgTray.hToastWatcherThread)   hThreads[cThreads++] = g_VgTray.hToastWatcherThread;
    if (g_VgTray.hServiceMonitorThread) hThreads[cThreads++] = g_VgTray.hServiceMonitorThread;
    if (g_VgTray.hPanelThread)          hThreads[cThreads++] = g_VgTray.hPanelThread;
    if (g_VgTray.hExitWatcherThread)    hThreads[cThreads++] = g_VgTray.hExitWatcherThread;

    if (cThreads > 0) {
        WaitForMultipleObjects(cThreads, hThreads, TRUE, 3000);
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < cThreads; i++) {
            CloseHandle(hThreads[i]);
        }
    }

    if (g_VgTray.hPanelReadyEvent) CloseHandle(g_VgTray.hPanelReadyEvent);
    if (g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent) CloseHandle(g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent);
    if (g_VgTray.hExitEvent)       CloseHandle(g_VgTray.hExitEvent);
    if (g_VgTray.hMutex) {
        ReleaseMutex(g_VgTray.hMutex);
        CloseHandle(g_VgTray.hMutex);
    }

    DeleteCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);
    DeleteCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csStateLock);
    return 0;
}
```

```c
/*
 * panel_d3d11.c
 * VanguardPanelClass & VanguardTrayContextMenuHostClass D3D11 + Dashboard Window
 * Reconstructed from FUN_1400b0ba0, FUN_1400aee10, FUN_140095a10, FUN_1400ae8b0
 */

#define COBJMACROS
#include "vgtray.h"
#include <initguid.h>
#pragma warning(push)
#pragma warning(disable: 4201)
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <dxgi.h>
#pragma warning(pop)
#include <dwmapi.h>

/* D3D11 SwapChain Context (FUN_1400b0ba0) */
static ID3D11Device*           s_pD3DDevice    = NULL;
static ID3D11DeviceContext*    s_pD3DContext   = NULL;
static IDXGISwapChain*         s_pSwapChain    = NULL;
static ID3D11RenderTargetView* s_pMainRTV      = NULL;

/* Interactive Button IDs inside VanguardPanelClass */
#define IDC_BTN_REFRESH_STATUS  2001
#define IDC_BTN_SAVE_LOGS       2002
#define IDC_BTN_TOGGLE_ADVANCED 2003
#define IDC_BTN_LEARN_MORE      2004
#define IDC_BTN_EXIT_VANGUARD   2005

/* ============================================================================
 * D3D11 DEVICE & SWAPCHAIN INITIALIZATION (FUN_1400b0ba0)
 * Mirrors vgtray.exe:
 *   1. CreateDXGIFactory1(&IID_IDXGIFactory1)
 *   2. D3D11CreateDevice(..., D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE) with fallback to
 *      D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_WARP
 *   3. CreateSwapChain(DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, BufferCount=2, SWAP_EFFECT_DISCARD)
 * ============================================================================ */
static void VgPanelCleanupRenderTarget(void)
{
    if (s_pMainRTV != NULL) {
        ID3D11RenderTargetView_Release(s_pMainRTV);
        s_pMainRTV = NULL;
    }
}

static void VgPanelCreateRenderTarget(void)
{
    if (s_pSwapChain == NULL || s_pD3DDevice == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    ID3D11Texture2D* pBackBuffer = NULL;
    if (SUCCEEDED(IDXGISwapChain_GetBuffer(s_pSwapChain, 0, &IID_ID3D11Texture2D, (void**)&pBackBuffer)) &&
        pBackBuffer != NULL) {
        ID3D11Device_CreateRenderTargetView(s_pD3DDevice, (ID3D11Resource*)pBackBuffer, NULL, &s_pMainRTV);
        ID3D11Texture2D_Release(pBackBuffer);
    }
}

static BOOL VgPanelInitD3D11(HWND hWnd)
{
    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC sd = { 0 };
    sd.BufferCount = 2;
    sd.BufferDesc.Width = 0;
    sd.BufferDesc.Height = 0;
    sd.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    sd.BufferDesc.RefreshRate.Numerator = 60;
    sd.BufferDesc.RefreshRate.Denominator = 1;
    sd.Flags = DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_MODE_SWITCH;
    sd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    sd.OutputWindow = hWnd;
    sd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    sd.SampleDesc.Quality = 0;
    sd.Windowed = TRUE;
    sd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_DISCARD;

    D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL featureLevels[2] = {
        D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0,
        D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_10_0
    };
    D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL obtainedLevel = D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0;

    HRESULT hr = D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain(
        NULL,
        D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE,
        NULL,
        0,
        featureLevels,
        2,
        D3D11_SDK_VERSION,
        &sd,
        &s_pSwapChain,
        &s_pD3DDevice,
        &obtainedLevel,
        &s_pD3DContext);

    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        /* Fallback to WARP software rasterizer just like FUN_1400b0ba0 */
        hr = D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain(
            NULL,
            D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_WARP,
            NULL,
            0,
            featureLevels,
            2,
            D3D11_SDK_VERSION,
            &sd,
            &s_pSwapChain,
            &s_pD3DDevice,
            &obtainedLevel,
            &s_pD3DContext);
    }

    if (FAILED(hr)) {
        VgTrayLogW(L"D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain failed: 0x%08X", (unsigned)hr);
        return FALSE;
    }

    VgPanelCreateRenderTarget();
    return TRUE;
}

static void VgPanelShutdownD3D11(void)
{
    VgPanelCleanupRenderTarget();
    if (s_pSwapChain != NULL) {
        IDXGISwapChain_Release(s_pSwapChain);
        s_pSwapChain = NULL;
    }
    if (s_pD3DContext != NULL) {
        ID3D11DeviceContext_Release(s_pD3DContext);
        s_pD3DContext = NULL;
    }
    if (s_pD3DDevice != NULL) {
        ID3D11Device_Release(s_pD3DDevice);
        s_pD3DDevice = NULL;
    }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * PANEL STATUS RENDERING & GDI COMPOSITOR
 * Displays Service Status (vgc/vgk), Security Features (Win11 25H2, UEFI
 * Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, VBS, HVCI, IOMMU, Disk Partition Style), and actions.
 * ============================================================================ */
static const wchar_t* VgFormatServiceState(DWORD dwState)
{
    switch (dwState) {
    case SERVICE_RUNNING:          return L"RUNNING";
    case SERVICE_STOPPED:          return L"STOPPED";
    case SERVICE_START_PENDING:    return L"STARTING";
    case SERVICE_STOP_PENDING:     return L"STOPPING";
    default:                       return L"UNKNOWN";
    }
}

static const wchar_t* VgFormatStartType(DWORD dwStartType)
{
    switch (dwStartType) {
    case SERVICE_BOOT_START:       return L"BOOT START";
    case SERVICE_SYSTEM_START:     return L"SYSTEM START";
    case SERVICE_AUTO_START:       return L"AUTO START";
    case SERVICE_DEMAND_START:     return L"DEMAND START";
    case SERVICE_DISABLED:         return L"DISABLED";
    default:                       return L"UNKNOWN";
    }
}

static void VgPanelPaintRow(
    HDC hdc,
    int y,
    int width,
    const wchar_t* wszLabel,
    const wchar_t* wszValue,
    BOOL bReady)
{
    RECT rcRow = { 24, y, width - 24, y + 26 };
    HBRUSH hRowBrush = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(28, 31, 38));
    FillRect(hdc, &rcRow, hRowBrush);
    DeleteObject(hRowBrush);

    SetTextColor(hdc, RGB(215, 220, 230));
    RECT rcLeft = { 34, y + 4, width - 170, y + 24 };
    DrawTextW(hdc, wszLabel, -1, &rcLeft, DT_LEFT | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_VCENTER);

    SetTextColor(hdc, bReady ? RGB(46, 213, 115) : RGB(255, 71, 87));
    RECT rcRight = { width - 165, y + 4, width - 34, y + 24 };
    DrawTextW(hdc, wszValue, -1, &rcRight, DT_RIGHT | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_VCENTER);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * VANGUARD PANEL WINDOW PROCEDURE (FUN_1400aee10)
 * ============================================================================ */
static LRESULT CALLBACK VgPanelWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (uMsg) {
    case WM_CREATE:
    {
        CreateWindowExW(0, L"BUTTON", L"Refresh Status",
                        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_PUSHBUTTON,
                        24, 395, 110, 30, hWnd, (HMENU)IDC_BTN_REFRESH_STATUS, g_VgTray.hInstance, NULL);
        CreateWindowExW(0, L"BUTTON", L"Save Logs...",
                        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_PUSHBUTTON,
                        142, 395, 100, 30, hWnd, (HMENU)IDC_BTN_SAVE_LOGS, g_VgTray.hInstance, NULL);
        CreateWindowExW(0, L"BUTTON", L"Advanced View",
                        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_PUSHBUTTON,
                        250, 395, 110, 30, hWnd, (HMENU)IDC_BTN_TOGGLE_ADVANCED, g_VgTray.hInstance, NULL);
        CreateWindowExW(0, L"BUTTON", L"Learn More",
                        WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_PUSHBUTTON,
                        368, 395, 95, 30, hWnd, (HMENU)IDC_BTN_LEARN_MORE, g_VgTray.hInstance, NULL);
        return 0;
    }

    case WM_SIZE:
        if (s_pSwapChain != NULL && wParam != SIZE_MINIMIZED) {
            VgPanelCleanupRenderTarget();
            IDXGISwapChain_ResizeBuffers(s_pSwapChain, 0, LOWORD(lParam), HIWORD(lParam), DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN, 0);
            VgPanelCreateRenderTarget();
        }
        return 0;

    case WM_COMMAND:
        switch (LOWORD(wParam)) {
        case IDC_BTN_REFRESH_STATUS:
            VgTrayEvaluateSecurityPrecheck(&g_VgTray.precheck);
            VgTrayPollServiceSnapshot(L"vgc", &g_VgTray.svcVgc);
            VgTrayPollServiceSnapshot(L"vgk", &g_VgTray.svcVgk);
            InvalidateRect(hWnd, NULL, FALSE);
            return 0;

        case IDC_BTN_SAVE_LOGS:
            VgTrayExportLogsZipInteractive(hWnd);
            return 0;

        case IDC_BTN_TOGGLE_ADVANCED:
            if (g_VgTray.hTrayWnd) {
                SendMessageW(g_VgTray.hTrayWnd, WM_COMMAND, IDM_TRAY_TOGGLE_ADVANCED, 0);
            }
            return 0;

        case IDC_BTN_LEARN_MORE:
            ShellExecuteW(NULL, L"open", VANGUARD_SUPPORT_URL_REQ, NULL, NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
            return 0;
        }
        break;

    case WM_PAINT:
    {
        PAINTSTRUCT ps;
        HDC hdc = BeginPaint(hWnd, &ps);
        VgPanelRenderDashboard(hWnd, hdc);
        EndPaint(hWnd, &ps);
        return 0;
    }

    case WM_CLOSE:
        /* Hide panel on X click unless application is shutting down */
        if (WaitForSingleObject(g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent, 0) == WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
            ShowWindow(hWnd, SW_HIDE);
            return 0;
        }
        DestroyWindow(hWnd);
        return 0;

    case WM_DESTROY:
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }

    return DefWindowProcW(hWnd, uMsg, wParam, lParam);
}

        VgTrayRefreshPanelLayout();
        ShowWindow(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
        SetForegroundWindow(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd);

    }

    }
}

void VgTrayRefreshPanelLayout(void)
{
    if (g_VgTray.hPanelWnd == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    int width = 500;
    int height = g_VgTray.settings.advanced_view ? 485 : 365;

    RECT rcWork = { 0 };
    SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETWORKAREA, 0, &rcWork, 0);
    int x = rcWork.right - width - 16;
    int y = rcWork.bottom - height - 16;

    SetWindowPos(
        g_VgTray.hPanelWnd,
        HWND_TOP,
        x, y, width, height,
        SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_NOZORDER);

    InvalidateRect(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd, NULL, FALSE);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * PANEL UI THREAD (FUN_1400b0ba0)
 * Registers VanguardPanelClass & VanguardTrayContextMenuHostClass, initializes
 * Direct3D 11 device/swapchain, signals hPanelReadyEvent, and pumps messages.
 * ============================================================================ */
DWORD WINAPI VgTrayPanelThread(LPVOID lpParam)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(lpParam);

    WNDCLASSEXW wcPanel = { 0 };
    wcPanel.cbSize = sizeof(WNDCLASSEXW);
    wcPanel.style = CS_HREDRAW | CS_VREDRAW;
    wcPanel.lpfnWndProc = VgPanelWndProc;
    wcPanel.hInstance = g_VgTray.hInstance;
    wcPanel.hIcon = g_VgTray.hTrayIcon;
    wcPanel.hCursor = LoadCursorW(NULL, IDC_ARROW);
    wcPanel.lpszClassName = VGPANEL_WINDOW_CLASS;
    RegisterClassExW(&wcPanel);

    WNDCLASSEXW wcMenuHost = { 0 };
    wcMenuHost.cbSize = sizeof(WNDCLASSEXW);
    wcMenuHost.lpfnWndProc = VgMenuHostWndProc;
    wcMenuHost.hInstance = g_VgTray.hInstance;
    wcMenuHost.lpszClassName = VGMENU_HOST_WINDOW_CLASS;
    RegisterClassExW(&wcMenuHost);

    int width = 500;
    int height = g_VgTray.settings.advanced_view ? 485 : 365;
    RECT rcWork = { 0 };
    SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETWORKAREA, 0, &rcWork, 0);

    g_VgTray.hPanelWnd = CreateWindowExW(
        WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_TOPMOST,
        VGPANEL_WINDOW_CLASS,
        L"Riot Vanguard",
        WS_POPUP | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU,
        rcWork.right - width - 16,
        rcWork.bottom - height - 16,
        width,
        height,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        g_VgTray.hInstance,
        NULL);

    g_VgTray.hMenuHostWnd = CreateWindowExW(
        WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_TOPMOST,
        VGMENU_HOST_WINDOW_CLASS,
        L"",
        WS_POPUP,
        0, 0, 1, 1,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        g_VgTray.hInstance,
        NULL);

    if (g_VgTray.hPanelWnd != NULL) {
        VgPanelInitD3D11(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd);
    }

    if (g_VgTray.hPanelReadyEvent != NULL) {
        SetEvent(g_VgTray.hPanelReadyEvent);
    }

    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0) > 0) {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }

    VgPanelShutdownD3D11();
    return 0;
}
```

`Vanguard/vgtray_src/service_precheck.c`:

```c
/*
 * service_precheck.c
 * SCM Service Monitor (vgc/vgk) & Hardware Security Pre-Check Verifier
 * Reconstructed from FUN_140082ea0, FUN_14008ce00, FUN_1400b1970, FUN_1400b1cc0, FUN_1400b1ea0
 */

#include "vgtray.h"
#include <tbs.h>

typedef LONG NTSTATUS;
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* PFN_RtlGetVersion)(PRTL_OSVERSIONINFOW);
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* PFN_NtQuerySystemInformation)(ULONG, PVOID, ULONG, PULONG);

/* SystemBootEnvironmentInformation (90) & SystemCodeIntegrityInformation (103) */
#define SystemBootEnvironmentInformation 90
#define SystemCodeIntegrityInformation   103
#define SystemIsolatedUserModeInformation 165

typedef struct _SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION_LOCAL {
    ULONG Length;
    ULONG CodeIntegrityOptions;
} SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION_LOCAL;

/* ============================================================================
 * VGK SERVICE START TYPE QUERY (FUN_14008ce00)
 * Queries OpenSCManagerW(1) -> OpenServiceW("vgk", 1) -> QueryServiceConfigW
 * ============================================================================ */
BOOL VgTrayQueryVgkStartType(DWORD* pdwStartType)
{
    if (pdwStartType == NULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    BOOL bResult = FALSE;
    SC_HANDLE hScm = OpenSCManagerW(NULL, NULL, SC_MANAGER_CONNECT);
    if (hScm != NULL) {
        SC_HANDLE hSvc = OpenServiceW(hScm, L"vgk", SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG);
        if (hSvc != NULL) {
            DWORD cbNeeded = 0;
            if (!QueryServiceConfigW(hSvc, NULL, 0, &cbNeeded) &&
                GetLastError() == ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER &&
                cbNeeded > 0) {
                LPQUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW pCfg = (LPQUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW)malloc(cbNeeded);
                if (pCfg != NULL) {
                    if (QueryServiceConfigW(hSvc, pCfg, cbNeeded, &cbNeeded)) {
                        *pdwStartType = pCfg->dwStartType;
                        bResult = TRUE;
                    }
                    free(pCfg);
                }
            }
            CloseServiceHandle(hSvc);
        }
        CloseServiceHandle(hScm);
    }

    return bResult;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * SERVICE STATUS & CONFIG SNAPSHOT POLLER (FUN_1400b1cc0)
 * Queries QueryServiceStatusEx(SC_STATUS_PROCESS_INFO) + QueryServiceConfigW
 * for "vgc" and "vgk".
 * ============================================================================ */
void VgTrayPollServiceSnapshot(LPCWSTR wszServiceName, VGTRAY_SERVICE_SNAPSHOT* pSnapshot)
{
    if (wszServiceName == NULL || pSnapshot == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    SC_HANDLE hScm = OpenSCManagerW(NULL, NULL, SC_MANAGER_CONNECT);
    if (hScm == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    SC_HANDLE hSvc = OpenServiceW(hScm, wszServiceName, SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS | SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG);
    if (hSvc != NULL) {
        SERVICE_STATUS_PROCESS ssp = { 0 };
        DWORD cbNeeded = 0;
        if (QueryServiceStatusEx(
                hSvc,
                SC_STATUS_PROCESS_INFO,
                (LPBYTE)&ssp,
                sizeof(ssp),
                &cbNeeded)) {
            pSnapshot->dwCurrentState = ssp.dwCurrentState;
            pSnapshot->dwWin32ExitCode = ssp.dwWin32ExitCode;
            pSnapshot->dwServiceSpecificExitCode = ssp.dwServiceSpecificExitCode;
            pSnapshot->dwProcessId = ssp.dwProcessId;
        }

        cbNeeded = 0;
        if (!QueryServiceConfigW(hSvc, NULL, 0, &cbNeeded) &&
            GetLastError() == ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER &&
            cbNeeded > 0) {
            LPQUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW pCfg = (LPQUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW)malloc(cbNeeded);
            if (pCfg != NULL) {
                if (QueryServiceConfigW(hSvc, pCfg, cbNeeded, &cbNeeded)) {
                    pSnapshot->dwStartType = pCfg->dwStartType;
                }
                free(pCfg);
            }
        }
        CloseServiceHandle(hSvc);
    }

    CloseServiceHandle(hScm);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * STOP SERVICE HELPER (FUN_14008cd40)
 * Called when user confirms "Exit Vanguard" (0x9C41).
 * ============================================================================ */
BOOL VgTrayStopServiceByName(LPCWSTR wszServiceName)
{
    BOOL bOk = FALSE;
    SC_HANDLE hScm = OpenSCManagerW(NULL, NULL, SC_MANAGER_CONNECT);
    if (hScm != NULL) {
        SC_HANDLE hSvc = OpenServiceW(hScm, wszServiceName, SERVICE_STOP | SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS);
        if (hSvc != NULL) {
            SERVICE_STATUS ss = { 0 };
            if (ControlService(hSvc, SERVICE_CONTROL_STOP, &ss)) {
                bOk = TRUE;
            }
            CloseServiceHandle(hSvc);
        }
        CloseServiceHandle(hScm);
    }
    return bOk;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * VGC "--start-type" CONFIGURATOR (FUN_1400b1970)
 * Starts vgc with "--start-type" "1" (SYSTEM_START) or "3" (DEMAND_START)
 * and waits up to 50,000ms for vgk start-type to match, enforcing a 3,000ms
 * minimum UI transition duration.
 * ============================================================================ */
int VgTrayEnsureVgcServiceMode(BOOL bDemandStart)
{
    ULONGLONG ullStartTick = GetTickCount64();
    DWORD dwTargetStartType = bDemandStart ? SERVICE_DEMAND_START : SERVICE_SYSTEM_START;
    DWORD dwCurrentStartType = 0;
    int iResult = 1;

    if (VgTrayQueryVgkStartType(&dwCurrentStartType)) {
        if (dwCurrentStartType == dwTargetStartType) {
            iResult = 0;
        } else {
            SC_HANDLE hScm = OpenSCManagerW(NULL, NULL, SC_MANAGER_CONNECT);
            if (hScm != NULL) {
                SC_HANDLE hSvc = OpenServiceW(hScm, L"vgc", SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS | SERVICE_START);
                if (hSvc != NULL) {
                    SERVICE_STATUS ss = { 0 };
                    if (QueryServiceStatus(hSvc, &ss) && ss.dwCurrentState == SERVICE_RUNNING) {
                        CloseServiceHandle(hSvc);
                        CloseServiceHandle(hScm);
                        ULONGLONG ullElapsed = GetTickCount64() - ullStartTick;
                        if (ullElapsed < 3000) {
                            Sleep((DWORD)(3000 - ullElapsed));
                        }
                        return 2;
                    }

                    LPCWSTR apwszArgs[2] = {
                        L"--start-type",
                        bDemandStart ? L"3" : L"1"
                    };
                    if (StartServiceW(hSvc, 2, apwszArgs)) {
                        ULONGLONG ullWaitStart = GetTickCount64();
                        while (GetTickCount64() - ullWaitStart < 50000) {
                            if (VgTrayQueryVgkStartType(&dwCurrentStartType) &&
                                dwCurrentStartType == dwTargetStartType) {
                                iResult = 0;
                                break;
                            }
                            Sleep(100);
                        }
                    }
                    CloseServiceHandle(hSvc);
                }
                CloseServiceHandle(hScm);
            }
        }
    }

    ULONGLONG ullElapsed = GetTickCount64() - ullStartTick;
    if (ullElapsed < 3000) {
        Sleep((DWORD)(3000 - ullElapsed));
    }
    return iResult;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * DISK PARTITION STYLE CHECK (FUN_140082ea0)
 * 1. Resolves Windows directory drive (e.g. "\\.\C:") via GetWindowsDirectoryW
 * 2. Sends IOCTL_VOLUME_GET_VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS (0x2D1080) to get DiskNumber
 * 3. Opens "\\.\PhysicalDrive%lu" and sends IOCTL_DISK_GET_DRIVE_LAYOUT_EX
 *    (0x70050) with a 0x48C0-byte buffer to read PartitionStyle (MBR=0, GPT=1).
 * ============================================================================ */
BOOL VgTrayQuerySystemPartitionStyle(DWORD* pdwPartitionStyle)
{
    if (pdwPartitionStyle == NULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    *pdwPartitionStyle = PARTITION_STYLE_RAW; /* 2 */

    WCHAR wszWinDir[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    UINT cchWinDir = GetWindowsDirectoryW(wszWinDir, MAX_PATH);
    if (cchWinDir < 2 || wszWinDir[1] != L':') {
        return FALSE;
    }

    WCHAR wszVolumePath[16] = { 0 };
    swprintf_s(wszVolumePath, _countof(wszVolumePath), L"\\\\.\\%c:", wszWinDir[0]);

    HANDLE hVolume = CreateFileW(
        wszVolumePath,
        0,
        FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
        NULL,
        OPEN_EXISTING,
        0,
        NULL);
    if (hVolume == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS vde = { 0 };
    DWORD cbReturned = 0;
    BOOL bOk = FALSE;

    /* IOCTL_VOLUME_GET_VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS = 0x002D1080 (or 0x00560000) */
    if (DeviceIoControl(
            hVolume,
            0x002D1080,
            NULL,
            0,
            &vde,
            sizeof(vde),
            &cbReturned,
            NULL) ||
        DeviceIoControl(
            hVolume,
            IOCTL_VOLUME_GET_VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS,
            NULL,
            0,
            &vde,
            sizeof(vde),
            &cbReturned,
            NULL)) {
        WCHAR wszDrivePath[64] = { 0 };
        swprintf_s(
            wszDrivePath,
            _countof(wszDrivePath),
            L"\\\\.\\PhysicalDrive%lu",
            vde.Extents[0].DiskNumber);

        HANDLE hDisk = CreateFileW(
            wszDrivePath,
            0,
            FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
            NULL,
            OPEN_EXISTING,
            0,
            NULL);
        if (hDisk != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            /* Allocate exact 0x48C0 byte buffer from FUN_140082ea0 */
            const DWORD cbLayoutBuf = 0x48C0;
            BYTE* pLayoutBuf = (BYTE*)calloc(1, cbLayoutBuf);
            if (pLayoutBuf != NULL) {
                /* IOCTL_DISK_GET_DRIVE_LAYOUT_EX = 0x00070050 */
                if (DeviceIoControl(
                        hDisk,
                        IOCTL_DISK_GET_DRIVE_LAYOUT_EX,
                        NULL,
                        0,
                        pLayoutBuf,
                        cbLayoutBuf,
                        &cbReturned,
                        NULL)) {
                    *pdwPartitionStyle = *(DWORD*)pLayoutBuf;
                    bOk = TRUE;
                }
                free(pLayoutBuf);
            }
            CloseHandle(hDisk);
        }
    }

    CloseHandle(hVolume);
    return bOk;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * HARDWARE & OS SECURITY PRE-CHECK VERIFIER
 * Evaluates:
 *   1. Windows 11 25H2+ (RtlGetVersion + EditionID)
 *   2. Disk Partition Style (GPT vs MBR via FUN_140082ea0)
 *   3. UEFI Secure Boot (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\State)
 *   4. TPM 2.0 (Tbsi_GetDeviceInfo)
 *   5. VBS & HVCI (SystemCodeIntegrityInformation / DeviceGuard registry)
 *   6. IOMMU / Kernel DMA Protection
 * ============================================================================ */
void VgTrayEvaluateSecurityPrecheck(VGTRAY_PRECHECK_STATE* pState)
{
    if (pState == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    ZeroMemory(pState, sizeof(*pState));

    HMODULE hNtdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    if (hNtdll != NULL) {
        PFN_RtlGetVersion pfnRtlGetVersion =
            (PFN_RtlGetVersion)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "RtlGetVersion");
        if (pfnRtlGetVersion != NULL) {
            RTL_OSVERSIONINFOW osvi = { 0 };
            osvi.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof(osvi);
            if (pfnRtlGetVersion(&osvi) == 0) {
                pState->dwOsMajor = osvi.dwMajorVersion;
                pState->dwOsMinor = osvi.dwMinorVersion;
                pState->dwOsBuild = osvi.dwBuildNumber;
            }
        }
    }

    /* Windows EditionID */
    HKEY hKeyNt = NULL;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(
            HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE,
            L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion",
            0,
            KEY_READ,
            &hKeyNt) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        DWORD cbEdition = sizeof(pState->wszEditionId);
        RegQueryValueExW(hKeyNt, L"EditionID", NULL, NULL, (LPBYTE)pState->wszEditionId, &cbEdition);
        RegCloseKey(hKeyNt);
    }

    /* Windows 11 build >= 22000 (25H2 = 26200+) */
    pState->bWin11_25H2_Ready = (pState->dwOsMajor >= 10 && pState->dwOsBuild >= 22000);

    /* Partition style (MBR vs GPT) */
    VgTrayQuerySystemPartitionStyle(&pState->dwPartitionStyle);
    pState->bUefiMode = (pState->dwPartitionStyle == PARTITION_STYLE_GPT);

    /* UEFI Secure Boot */
    HKEY hKeySb = NULL;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(
            HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE,
            L"SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SecureBoot\\State",
            0,
            KEY_READ,
            &hKeySb) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        DWORD dwSbEnabled = 0;
        DWORD cbSb = sizeof(dwSbEnabled);
        if (RegQueryValueExW(hKeySb, L"UEFISecureBootEnabled", NULL, NULL, (LPBYTE)&dwSbEnabled, &cbSb) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            pState->bSecureBootEnabled = (dwSbEnabled == 1);
            pState->bUefiMode = TRUE;
        }
        RegCloseKey(hKeySb);
    }

    /* TPM 2.0 via TBS (Tbsi_GetDeviceInfo) */
    TPM_DEVICE_INFO tpmInfo = { 0 };
    if (Tbsi_GetDeviceInfo(sizeof(tpmInfo), &tpmInfo) == TBS_SUCCESS) {
        pState->bTpm20Ready = (tpmInfo.tpmVersion == TPM_VERSION_20);
    }

    /* VBS & HVCI via NtQuerySystemInformation(SystemCodeIntegrityInformation = 103) */
    if (hNtdll != NULL) {
        PFN_NtQuerySystemInformation pfnNtQuerySystemInformation =
            (PFN_NtQuerySystemInformation)GetProcAddress(hNtdll, "NtQuerySystemInformation");
        if (pfnNtQuerySystemInformation != NULL) {
            SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION_LOCAL sci = { 0 };
            sci.Length = sizeof(sci);
            ULONG cbRet = 0;
            if (pfnNtQuerySystemInformation(SystemCodeIntegrityInformation, &sci, sizeof(sci), &cbRet) == 0) {
                /* HVCI (CODEINTEGRITY_OPTION_HVCI_KMCI_ENABLED = 0x400) */
                if (sci.CodeIntegrityOptions & 0x400) {
                    pState->bHvciEnabled = TRUE;
                    pState->bVbsEnabled = TRUE;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /* DeviceGuard Registry fallback for VBS / HVCI / IOMMU */
    HKEY hKeyDg = NULL;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(
            HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE,
            L"SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\DeviceGuard",
            0,
            KEY_READ,
            &hKeyDg) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        DWORD dwVbs = 0;
        DWORD cbVbs = sizeof(dwVbs);
        if (RegQueryValueExW(hKeyDg, L"EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity", NULL, NULL, (LPBYTE)&dwVbs, &cbVbs) == ERROR_SUCCESS &&
            dwVbs != 0) {
            pState->bVbsEnabled = TRUE;
        }
        RegCloseKey(hKeyDg);
    }

    HKEY hKeyDma = NULL;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(
            HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE,
            L"SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\DmaSecurity",
            0,
            KEY_READ,
            &hKeyDma) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        pState->bIommuEnabled = TRUE;
        RegCloseKey(hKeyDma);
    } else {
        pState->bIommuEnabled = pState->bVbsEnabled;
    }

    pState->bAllRequirementsMet = (
        pState->bWin11_25H2_Ready &&
        pState->bSecureBootEnabled &&
        pState->bTpm20Ready &&
        pState->bVbsEnabled &&
        pState->bHvciEnabled);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * SERVICE MONITOR THREAD (FUN_1400b1ea0)
 * Polls vgc & vgk service status every 1000ms until stop event is signaled.
 * ============================================================================ */
DWORD WINAPI VgTrayServiceMonitorThread(LPVOID lpParam)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(lpParam);

    while (WaitForSingleObject(g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent, 1000) == WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
        VGTRAY_SERVICE_SNAPSHOT snapVgc = { 0 };
        VGTRAY_SERVICE_SNAPSHOT snapVgk = { 0 };
        VgTrayPollServiceSnapshot(L"vgc", &snapVgc);
        VgTrayPollServiceSnapshot(L"vgk", &snapVgk);

        EnterCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csStateLock);
        BOOL bChanged = (
            g_VgTray.svcVgc.dwCurrentState != snapVgc.dwCurrentState ||
            g_VgTray.svcVgc.dwStartType    != snapVgc.dwStartType    ||
            g_VgTray.svcVgk.dwCurrentState != snapVgk.dwCurrentState ||
            g_VgTray.svcVgk.dwStartType    != snapVgk.dwStartType);
        g_VgTray.svcVgc = snapVgc;
        g_VgTray.svcVgk = snapVgk;
        LeaveCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csStateLock);

        if (bChanged && g_VgTray.hPanelWnd != NULL) {
            InvalidateRect(g_VgTray.hPanelWnd, NULL, FALSE);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
```

`Vanguard/vgtray_src/toast_registry.c`:

```c
/*
 * toast_registry.c
 * Kernel Registry Toast Notification Watcher (HKLM\Software\vgk)
 * Reconstructed from FUN_14008a430, FUN_14008e8f0, and FUN_140091470
 */

#include "vgtray.h"

/* ============================================================================
 * FNV-1a 32-BIT HASH (FUN_14008a430)
 * Seed: 0x811C9DC5 | Prime: 0x01000193
 * Used to deduplicate KBToastNotification binary blobs written by vgk.sys.
 * ============================================================================ */
uint32_t VgTrayComputeFnv1a32(const uint8_t* pData, size_t cbSize)
{
    uint32_t uHash = VGTRAY_FNV1A_32_OFFSET;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < cbSize; i++) {
        uHash ^= (uint32_t)pData[i];
        uHash *= VGTRAY_FNV1A_32_PRIME;
    }
    return uHash;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * KBToastNotification BINARY PARSER (FUN_14008a430)
 * Binary format in HKLM\Software\vgk -> "KBToastNotification" (max 0xA07 bytes):
 *   Offset 0x00: BYTE   bNotificationType (0 = Blocked file, 1 = Incompatible software)
 *   Offset 0x01: BYTE   bReserved
 *   Offset 0x02: USHORT cchField[3]       (lengths in WCHARs of up to 3 strings)
 *   Offset 0x08: WCHAR  wszPayload[...]   (packed UTF-16LE strings)
 * ============================================================================ */
BOOL VgTrayPollKbToastNotification(VGTRAY_TOAST_ITEM* pOutToast)
{
    if (pOutToast == NULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    HKEY hKey = NULL;
    LSTATUS lStatus = RegOpenKeyExW(
        HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE,
        VGK_REGISTRY_KEY,
        0,
        KEY_QUERY_VALUE,
        &hKey);
    if (lStatus != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    uint8_t abBuffer[VGTRAY_MAX_TOAST_BLOB_SIZE + 1] = { 0 };
    DWORD cbData = VGTRAY_MAX_TOAST_BLOB_SIZE;
    DWORD dwType = 0;

    lStatus = RegQueryValueExW(
        hKey,
        VGK_VAL_TOAST_NOTIFICATION,
        NULL,
        &dwType,
        abBuffer,
        &cbData);

    /* Fallback check for BlockedImage / DetectedImage string values */
    WCHAR wszBlockedImage[MAX_PATH] = { 0 };
    DWORD cbBlocked = sizeof(wszBlockedImage);
    RegQueryValueExW(hKey, VGK_VAL_BLOCKED_IMAGE, NULL, NULL, (LPBYTE)wszBlockedImage, &cbBlocked);

    RegCloseKey(hKey);

    if (lStatus != ERROR_SUCCESS || cbData < 8 || cbData > VGTRAY_MAX_TOAST_BLOB_SIZE) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    BYTE bNotifType = abBuffer[0];
    if (bNotifType >= 2) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    /* Validate total packed UTF-16LE string length against cbData - 8 (FUN_14008a430) */
    const uint16_t* pu16Lengths = (const uint16_t*)(abBuffer + 2);
    uint32_t cchTotal = (uint32_t)pu16Lengths[0] + (uint32_t)pu16Lengths[1] + (uint32_t)pu16Lengths[2];
    if (cchTotal == 0 || (uint64_t)cchTotal * sizeof(WCHAR) > (uint64_t)(cbData - 8)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    uint32_t uHash = VgTrayComputeFnv1a32(abBuffer, cbData);

    EnterCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);
    if (uHash == g_VgTray.dwLastToastHash) {
        LeaveCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);
        return FALSE;
    }
    g_VgTray.dwLastToastHash = uHash;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);

    ZeroMemory(pOutToast, sizeof(*pOutToast));
    pOutToast->bNotificationType = bNotifType;
    pOutToast->dwFnvHash = uHash;

    const WCHAR* pCursor = (const WCHAR*)(abBuffer + 8);
    WCHAR wszFields[3][MAX_PATH] = { { 0 } };
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        uint16_t cch = pu16Lengths[i];
        if (cch > 0) {
            size_t cchCopy = (cch < (MAX_PATH - 1)) ? cch : (MAX_PATH - 1);
            wcsncpy_s(wszFields[i], MAX_PATH, pCursor, cchCopy);
            pCursor += cch;
        }
    }

    wcscpy_s(pOutToast->wszTitle, _countof(pOutToast->wszTitle), L"Riot Vanguard");
    wcsncpy_s(pOutToast->wszFilePath, _countof(pOutToast->wszFilePath),
              wszFields[0][0] ? wszFields[0] : wszBlockedImage, _TRUNCATE);
    wcscpy_s(pOutToast->wszHelpUrl, _countof(pOutToast->wszHelpUrl),
             wszFields[2][0] ? wszFields[2] : VANGUARD_SUPPORT_URL_REQ);

    if (bNotifType == 0) {
        swprintf_s(
            pOutToast->wszMessage,
            _countof(pOutToast->wszMessage),
            L"Vanguard has blocked the following file from loading on your system:\n%s\n\nClick here to learn more.",
            pOutToast->wszFilePath);
    } else {
        swprintf_s(
            pOutToast->wszMessage,
            _countof(pOutToast->wszMessage),
            L"Vanguard has detected incompatible software on your machine:\n%s\n\nClick here to learn more.",
            pOutToast->wszFilePath);
    }

    EnterCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);
    g_VgTray.lastToast = *pOutToast;
    g_VgTray.bHasPendingToast = TRUE;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_VgTray.csToastLock);

    VgTrayLogW(L"KBToastNotification received (type=%u, hash=0x%08X, file=%ls)",
               (unsigned)bNotifType, uHash, pOutToast->wszFilePath);
    return TRUE;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * REGISTRY WATCHER THREAD (FUN_14008e8f0)
 * Monitors HKLM\Software\vgk via RegNotifyChangeKeyValue and dispatches
 * balloon notifications immediately when vgk.sys updates KBToastNotification.
 * ============================================================================ */
DWORD WINAPI VgTrayToastWatcherThread(LPVOID lpParam)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(lpParam);

    HANDLE hRegEvent = CreateEventW(NULL, TRUE, FALSE, NULL);
    if (hRegEvent == NULL) {
        return 1;
    }

    while (WaitForSingleObject(g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent, 0) == WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
        HKEY hKey = NULL;
        if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, VGK_REGISTRY_KEY, 0, KEY_NOTIFY | KEY_QUERY_VALUE, &hKey) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            ResetEvent(hRegEvent);
            if (RegNotifyChangeKeyValue(hKey, FALSE, REG_NOTIFY_CHANGE_LAST_SET, hRegEvent, TRUE) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
                HANDLE hWait[2] = { g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent, hRegEvent };
                DWORD dwWait = WaitForMultipleObjects(2, hWait, FALSE, 5000);
                if (dwWait == WAIT_OBJECT_0 + 1) {
                    VGTRAY_TOAST_ITEM toast = { 0 };
                    if (VgTrayPollKbToastNotification(&toast)) {
                        VgTrayShowBalloonNotification(toast.wszTitle, toast.wszMessage, NIIF_WARNING);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                WaitForSingleObject(g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent, 2000);
            }
            RegCloseKey(hKey);
        } else {
            if (WaitForSingleObject(g_VgTray.hStopWorkerEvent, 2000) == WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    CloseHandle(hRegEvent);
    return 0;
}
```

```h
typedef struct _VGTRAY_TOAST_ITEM {
    BYTE  bNotificationType;  /* 0 = Blocked driver/file, 1 = Incompatible software */
    DWORD dwFnvHash;          /* FNV-1a 32-bit digest of raw registry value */
    WCHAR wszTitle[128];
    WCHAR wszMessage[512];
    WCHAR wszFilePath[MAX_PATH];
    WCHAR wszHelpUrl[256];
} VGTRAY_TOAST_ITEM;

/* Global Runtime Context */
typedef struct _VGTRAY_CONTEXT {
    HINSTANCE               hInstance;
    HWND                    hTrayWnd;
    HWND                    hPanelWnd;
    HWND                    hMenuHostWnd;
    HANDLE                  hMutex;
    HANDLE                  hExitEvent;
    HANDLE                  hStopWorkerEvent;
    HANDLE                  hPanelReadyEvent;
    HANDLE                  hExitWatcherThread;
    HANDLE                  hServiceMonitorThread;
    HANDLE                  hToastWatcherThread;
    HANDLE                  hPanelThread;
    HICON                   hTrayIcon;
    CRITICAL_SECTION        csStateLock;
    CRITICAL_SECTION        csToastLock;
    VGTRAY_SERVICE_SNAPSHOT svcVgc;
    VGTRAY_SERVICE_SNAPSHOT svcVgk;
    VGTRAY_PRECHECK_STATE   precheck;
    VGTRAY_SETTINGS         settings;
    VGTRAY_TOAST_ITEM       lastToast;
    BOOL                    bHasPendingToast;
    DWORD                   dwLastToastHash;
    WCHAR                   wszInstallDir[MAX_PATH];
    WCHAR                   wszLocalAppDataDir[MAX_PATH];
    WCHAR                   wszLogFilePath[MAX_PATH];
    WCHAR                   wszSettingsFilePath[MAX_PATH];
} VGTRAY_CONTEXT;
```
