## 24. Boot Lifecycle, Load Order & Self-Integrity

### 24.1 Execution Sequence
```text
1. UEFI Firmware Initialization (Secure Boot & TPM PCR measurements)
   │
2. Windows Boot Manager (bootmgr)
   │
3. Windows OS Kernel (ntoskrnl.exe)
   │
4. Service Startup:
   ├── EasyAntiCheat_EOS Service (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.exe)
   └── Kernel Driver Load (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys via Service Manager)
   │
5. Minifilter Attachment (FLTMGR.SYS!FltRegisterFilter, Altitude 328010)
   │
6. Kernel Callbacks Registration (Ps/Ob/Cm Callbacks)
   │
7. Fortnite Launcher Handshake & Protected Process Spawning (FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe)
```

### 24.2 Self-Integrity Lock & Section 7 Virtual Machine
1. **Dynamic Minifilter Shield:** `EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys` attaches at altitude `328010` to block unauthorized modification or read access to its own disk image and game binaries.
2. **Encrypted VM Core Execution:** Critical anti-cheat logic resides in Section 7 (Offset `0x32f000`, 35.28 MB, Entropy `6.6633`), executed via a register-preserving dispatcher loop (`movups [rsp+18h], xmm6; movups [rsp+28h], xmm8; movups [rsp+38h], xmm15`).
3. **Dual Verification Pipeline:** The driver verifies the user-mode service via private cryptographic handshake tokens, while the user-mode service attests the driver's signature and integrity via `CRYPT32.dll` and `WinVerifyTrust`.

---

## 25. Hardware Mouse Emulation & Out-of-Band (OOB) Input Vector Analysis

External cheats attempt to bypass software synthetic input detection (`SendInput`, `mouse_event`, `MouseClassServiceCallback` tampering) by using physical USB microcontrollers (MCU) acting as human interface devices (HID). EAC deploys hardware validation and bus topology inspection to identify out-of-band input devices:

### 25.1 Target Microcontroller Hardware Profiles
- **Arduino Leonardo / Pro Micro (ATmega32U4):** Uses AVR USB Core (`PluggableUSB` / `HID.cpp`).
- **Raspberry Pi Pico / RP2040:** Employs TinyUSB stack for dual CDC (serial) + HID composite profiles.
- **KMBox (B+ / NET / Pro) & Makemcu:** Commercial breakout boards pairing an onboard UART/Ethernet bridge with an MCU running hardware pass-through and coordinate injection firmware.

### 25.2 USB Descriptor & Endpoint Validation Pipeline
1. **VID / PID Fingerprinting:**
   - Default IDs (`VID_2341&PID_8036`, `VID_1B4F&PID_9206`, `VID_1A86&PID_7523` CH340) flagged.
   - Dual interface inspection: devices declaring both **CDC Serial (Class `0x02`)** and **HID Mouse (Class `0x03`)** on the same composite root flagged as automation interfaces.
2. **Report Descriptor Anomalies:**
   - Stock Arduino 44-byte mouse report descriptors lack high-resolution scrolling and vendor usage pages present in authentic gaming mice (Logitech, Razer).
3. **Dual-Mouse Conflict & Arbitration:**
   - If inputs arrive simultaneously from two distinct physical device objects (`\Device\PointerClass0` and `\Device\PointerClass1`) while aiming, EAC flags the session for hardware arbitration failure.
4. **Packet Jitter & Polling Intervals:**
   - Authentic 1000Hz gaming mice produce hardware IRQs at $1.000\text{ms} \pm 10\mu\text{s}$. MCU injection via serial/COM produces bursty deltas ($\Delta t$ clustering around $16\text{ms}$ or $8\text{ms}$) failing hardware bus consistency checks.

# EasyAntiCheat Kernel Driver (`EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys`) — Reconstructed Source

This repository contains the complete C/WDK reconstruction of the **`EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys`** (v3.2.0 — Fortnite / Epic Online Services) multi-module Windows kernel-mode driver, produced via Reverse Engineering Architecture (REA) static analysis, symbol correlation against `Core.pdb`, and 64-bit Mixed Boolean Arithmetic (MBA) deobfuscation of the official protected binary (`SHA-256: e43e586a85b0101512b29508897075d3a12b58567b95d669f9d9016e8ab8ecbb`).

---

## 1. Architectural Overview

`EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys` operates in **Ring 0** (Kernel Mode) combining standard Windows Driver Model (`WDM`) dispatching with a high-altitude Filter Manager (`FLTMGR.SYS`) Minifilter (Altitude `328010`).

Key operational subsystems include:
- **Direct CR3 Hardware Page Table Walking**: Traverses the 4-level paging hierarchy (`PML4 -> PDPT -> PD -> PT`) via physical memory reads (`MmCopyMemory`) to inspect page-level permissions, NX bits, and large-page transitions directly from hardware structures, bypassing OS APIs.
- **File System Minifilter**: Intercepts low-level I/O requests (`IRP_MJ_CREATE`, `IRP_MJ_WRITE`, `IRP_MJ_SET_INFORMATION`, and section synchronization) to block binary tampering, memory dumping, and unauthorized section creation against game processes.
- **Process Memory & VAD Auditing**: Scans user-mode Virtual Address Descriptors (VAD) for unbacked executable memory (`MEM_PRIVATE` + `PAGE_EXECUTE`), orphaned `MZ`/`PE` headers, and `.data`/`.rdata` code caves.
- **Active Kernel Integrity & Stack Unwinding**: Samples thread execution states using custom 64-bit CONTEXT structures and custom unwinders to identify kernel execution originating from unbacked pool memory.
- **Hardware Bus & Input Defense**: Audits PCI configuration spaces against PCIe DMA hardware (PCILeech), validates ACPI IOMMU tables, and inspects USB/HID mouse packet stacks against synthetic input injection.

---

├── cr3_pagewalk_stack.c        # Hardware CR3 Page-Table Walker, Physical Memory Reader, and Stack Unwinder

├── callbacks.c                 # ObRegisterCallbacks, Process/Thread/Image Notify & Registry Filter

├── hv_antidebug.c              # Hypervisor Detection, CPUID Latency (RDTSC), MSRs, and Anti-Debug

├── build.bat                   # Automated MSBuild Script (WDK Native Tools)
└── README.md                   # Reconstructed Source Documentation
```

## 3. Component Details

### 3.1 [`driver.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/driver.c)
- **`DriverEntry` (`RVA 0x274DF8`)**: Kernel entry point. Initializes synchronization locks, derives the runtime MBA deobfuscation key (`0xC6BC279692B5C323`), creates `\Device\EasyAntiCheat_EOS` and `\DosDevices\EasyAntiCheat_EOS`, and sets up the dispatch tables.
- **`EacDeriveMbaKey`**: Decrypts the dynamic kernel API function pointer table stored in `.rdata` (`0x140307E90`..`0x14031B000`) at runtime using algebraic SplitMix64 transformations.
- **`EacDispatchDeviceControl`**: Central IOCTL handler for user-mode communication (`EasyAntiCheat_EOS.exe`), servicing operations including `IOCTL_EAC_BIND_SERVICE` (`0x800`), `IOCTL_EAC_PROTECT_PROCESS` (`0x801`), `IOCTL_EAC_POLL_TELEMETRY` (`0x802`), and `IOCTL_EAC_HEARTBEAT` (`0x804`).
- **Section 7 VM Dispatcher (`RVA 0x383000`)**: Emulates execution of internal bytecode routines for sensitive driver initialization and challenge/response processing.
- **`DriverUnload`**: Manages strict LIFO deregistration of minifilters, object callbacks, timer routines, and memory allocations.

### 3.2 [`minifilter.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/minifilter.c)
- **`FltRegisterFilter`**: Registers the file system filter at altitude `328010` (`FSFilter Anti-Virus` tier) via `FLTMGR.SYS!FltRegisterFilter` (`0x140311C18`).
- **`EacMinifilterPreCreate`**: Intercepts file creation/open requests targeting protected game executables (`FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe`) and anti-cheat modules to deny unauthorized read, write, or delete handles.
- **`EacMinifilterPreWrite` & `PreSetInformation`**: Blocks external processes from modifying binary disk images or altering file size/timestamp metadata while the game is active.
- **`IRP_MJ_ACQUIRE_FOR_SECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION`**: Audits memory-mapped file section creation (`SEC_IMAGE`) to detect reflective execution, manual DLL injection, or unauthorized code replacement before execution begins.

### 3.3 [`cr3_pagewalk_stack.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/cr3_pagewalk_stack.c)
- **Physical Memory Reader (`FUN_14004a85a` / `FUN_14004a922`)**: Safely reads 8-byte physical memory values using `MmCopyMemory(MM_COPY_MEMORY_PHYSICAL)` with address verification.
- **4-Level CR3 Page Table Walker (`FUN_1400d9e46`)**:
  - Traverses `PML4 -> PDPT -> PD -> PT` using decrypted MBA constant `r14 = 0xA1BBB7A6F3A55BF7`.
  - Aggregates page flags (`Present`, `ReadWrite`, `UserSupervisor`, `NX`) across all four hierarchy levels.
  - Automatically identifies 2MB Large Pages (`LargePage` bit 7) and 4KB standard leaf PTEs.
  - Skips user-space virtual addresses (`TargetVa < MmUserProbeAddress`) to concentrate audits exclusively on kernel memory integrity.
- **Kernel Stack Unwinder (`FUN_1400d97f3`)**:
  - Reconstructs a custom `0x4D0`-byte `CONTEXT` structure (`0x0010000B`).
  - Unwinds active kernel call stacks using `RtlLookupFunctionEntry` and `RtlVirtualUnwind`.
  - Flags unbacked return addresses (`[RSP]`) lacking registered `.pdata` function runtime tables.
- **Control Register & Pool Scanner (`FUN_1401e828c`)**:
  - Captures `CR2`, `CR3`, `CR4`, and `CR8` snapshots to detect hypervisor shadow paging anomalies.
  - Sweeps `SystemBigPoolInformation` for executable non-paged pool memory allocations not backed by any registered kernel module.

### 3.4 [`memory_vad_scanner.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/memory_vad_scanner.c)
- **`EacAuditProtectedProcessMemory`**: Sweeps the virtual address space of the protected game process (`0x10000` to `0x7FFFFFFE0000`) via `ZwQueryVirtualMemory`.
- **Unbacked Memory & MZ Header Auditing**: Detects `MEM_PRIVATE` or `MEM_COMMIT` regions possessing executable permissions (`PAGE_EXECUTE_READ`, `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE`) and inspects them for unbacked `MZ`/`PE` headers (`EAC_VIO_MDL_USER_NO_VAD`).
- **Code Cave & Permission Tampering**: Cross-references `.data` and `.rdata` sections of game modules using CR3 page walking to detect executable patches (`NX=0`) applied to normally non-executable memory.
- **Kernel Cryptographic Hashing**: Leverages CNG (`BCryptCreateHash`, `BCryptHashData`) to compute SHA-256 hashes of critical code sections against known legitimate baselines.

### 3.5 [`callbacks.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/callbacks.c)
- **`ObRegisterCallbacks` (Altitude `328010`)**: Strips handle permissions from unauthorized processes attempting to open handles to the game process or its threads:
  - Process access stripped: `PROCESS_VM_READ`, `PROCESS_VM_WRITE`, `PROCESS_VM_OPERATION`, `PROCESS_SUSPEND_RESUME`, `PROCESS_DUP_HANDLE`.
  - Thread access stripped: `THREAD_GET_CONTEXT`, `THREAD_SET_CONTEXT`, `THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME`, `THREAD_DIRECT_IMPERSONATION`.
- **`PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx`**: Tracks all process creation and termination events across the OS, validating command lines and parent/child lineages.
- **`PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine`**: Detects remote thread creation (`CreateRemoteThread`, `NtCreateThreadEx`) targeting the game process.
- **`PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine`**: Audits all loaded kernel drivers and DLL modules, validating base addresses and certificate validity in real time.
- **`CmRegisterCallbackEx`**: Registry filter callback guarding Driver Signature Enforcement (DSE), `Testsigning` flags, and system certificate stores (`HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CI`).

### 3.6 [`byovd_softpub.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/byovd_softpub.c)
- **BYOVD (*Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver*) Mitigation**: Detects vulnerable third-party drivers by cross-referencing known device names (`\Device\DBK64`, `iqvw64e.sys`, `gdrv.sys`, `mhyprot2.sys`) and certificate hashes.
- **Root Certificate Store Validation**: Audits system Root CAs (`ROOT`, `AuthRoot`, `FlightRoot`) to detect unauthorized or self-signed test certificates injected into the kernel.
- **`MajorFunction` Dispatch Table Auditing**: Regularly verifies that `DriverObject->MajorFunction` pointers of critical Windows drivers point strictly within their respective legitimate image bounds, exposing hook trampolines and rootkit redirections.

### 3.7 [`dpc_telemetry.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/dpc_telemetry.c)
- **Periodic DPC Timers**: High-priority `1000ms` periodic timer (`KeSetTimerEx`) rotating execution across all CPU cores (`KeSetTargetProcessorDpc`) to avoid predictability.
- **Asynchronous Worker Queues**: Defers non-critical processing from `DISPATCH_LEVEL` to `PASSIVE_LEVEL` using `IoAllocateWorkItem` / `IoQueueWorkItem`.
- **Chunk Streaming Protocol**: Packs and encrypts detected security violations into a serialized multiarray streaming format using delimiters (`newl+`, `newl?`, `newl!`) for dispatch to the user-mode service.
- **`IOCTL_EAC_HEARTBEAT` (`0x804`)**: Bidirectional cryptographic handshake verifying responsiveness of the user-mode anti-cheat service; timeouts trigger game shutdown.

### 3.8 [`hv_antidebug.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/hv_antidebug.c)
- **Hypervisor Presence & CPUID Sweeps**: Inspects `CPUID` leaves (`0x0`, `0x1`, `0x40000000`, `0x80000002`..`0x80000004`), checking ECX bit 31 (hypervisor present) and identifying virtualization signatures (`VMwareVMware`, `Microsoft Hv`, `KVMKVMKVM`).
- **RDTSC / VM-Exit Latency Timing**: Measures execution cycles of `CPUID` and `INVLPG` against a baseline to detect VM-Exit interception overhead introduced by hypervisor-based tools.
- **System Call Hook Detection**: Validates `IA32_LSTAR` MSR to ensure it points directly to `nt!KiSystemCall64` and has not been hooked.
- **Kernel Debugging Probes**: Monitors `KdDebuggerEnabled`, `KdDebuggerNotPresent`, and hardware debug registers (`DR0`-`DR7`).
- **VBS / HVCI Auditing**: Queries `SystemIsolatedUserModeInformation` to verify Virtualization-Based Security status.

### 3.9 [`hwid_tpm_smbios.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/hwid_tpm_smbios.c)
- **Physical Disk Identification**: Reads raw Master Boot Record (MBR) sector 0 hash (`MBR:%08x`), SCSI LUN identifiers (`:lun=%llx`), and volume serial numbers directly from disk controllers.
- **SMBIOS Table Parser**: Maps and parses raw physical SMBIOS memory (`0xF0000` range), extracting immutable hardware identifiers (Type 0 BIOS, Type 1 System UUID, Type 2 Baseboard, Type 3 Chassis, Type 4 Processor, Type 17 Memory).
- **TPM 2.0 Cryptographic Telemetry**: Communicates with the hardware TPM via ACPI/TCG interfaces to query Endorsement Keys (EK) and PCR bank digests.
- **Network & Registry Telemetry**: Retrieves permanent hardware MAC addresses via NDIS OIDs (`OID_802_3_PERMANENT_ADDRESS`) and reads registry install identifiers (`MachineGuid`, `HwProfileGuid`).

### 3.10 [`pci_dma_acpi.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/pci_dma_acpi.c)
- **PCI Configuration Space Enumeration**: Enumerates 256 PCI buses via `HalGetBusDataByOffset` / PCI Enhanced Configuration Mechanism.
- **Direct Memory Access (DMA) Defense**: Detects unauthorized bus-mastering hardware, checking vendor/device IDs associated with PCIe leeches and FPGA boards (Xilinx `0x10EE`, VMware `0x15AD`, VirtIO `0x1AF4`, QEMU `0x1B36`).
- **ACPI DMAR & IOMMU Verification**: Parses ACPI tables (`DMAR`, `MADT`, `FADT`) to verify whether hardware IOMMU DMA remapping (Intel VT-d / AMD-Vi) is active in the firmware.

### 3.11 [`usb_hid_mouse.c`](file:///C:/Users/pc/Desktop/eac_src/usb_hid_mouse.c)
- **Pointer Class Driver Stack Auditing**: Traverses device objects attached to `\Device\PointerClass0`..`\Device\PointerClassN` to detect unauthorized filter drivers inserted into the input stack.
- **Dual-Mouse & Synthetic Arbitration**: Detects concurrent active mouse devices injecting programmatic input into the operating system.
- **USB Microcontroller Enumeration**: Scans USB device descriptors for VID/PID signatures commonly used by microcontroller-based hardware emulators (Arduino Leonardo `VID_2341`, Teensy `VID_1B4F`, CH340 `VID_1A86`, Raspberry Pi Pico `VID_2E8A`).

## 4. Prerequisites & Build Instructions

### Prerequisites
- **Visual Studio 2022** with the **Desktop development with C++** workload.
- **Windows Driver Kit (WDK)** compatible with Windows 10/11 and Visual Studio 2022.
- Administrator privileges for building and managing kernel driver solutions.

### Build via Command Line
Run the automated build script inside an **x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022**:
```cmd
cd /d C:\Users\pc\Desktop\eac_src
build.bat
```

### Build via MSBuild
```cmd
msbuild eac.sln /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64
```

### Build Output
- Binary: `eac_src\build\x64\Release\EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys`
- Symbol: `eac_src\build\x64\Release\EasyAntiCheat_EOS.pdb`

```

`eac_src/build.bat`:

```bat
@echo off
REM build.bat - Build script for reconstructed EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0 multi-module WDM/Minifilter driver
REM Requires Visual Studio + Windows Driver Kit (WDK 10/11) x64 Native Tools Command Prompt

rc.exe /nologo eac.rc

cl.exe /nologo /c /Zi /W4 /Gz /Gs- /kernel /D_WIN64 /D_AMD64_ /DAMD64 /DPOOL_NX_OPTIN=1 ^
    driver.c ^
    minifilter.c ^
    cr3_pagewalk_stack.c ^
    memory_vad_scanner.c ^
    callbacks.c ^
    byovd_softpub.c ^
    dpc_telemetry.c ^
    hv_antidebug.c ^
    pci_dma_acpi.c ^
    hwid_tpm_smbios.c ^
    usb_hid_mouse.c

link.exe /nologo /DRIVER:WDM /INTEGRITYCHECK /SUBSYSTEM:NATIVE /ENTRY:DriverEntry ^
    /BASE:0x140000000 /DEF:eac.def /PDBALTPATH:"Core.pdb" ^
    driver.obj ^
    minifilter.obj ^
    cr3_pagewalk_stack.obj ^
    memory_vad_scanner.obj ^
    callbacks.obj ^
    byovd_softpub.obj ^
    dpc_telemetry.obj ^
    hv_antidebug.obj ^
    pci_dma_acpi.obj ^
    hwid_tpm_smbios.obj ^
    usb_hid_mouse.obj ^
    eac.res ^
    ntoskrnl.lib hal.lib fltMgr.lib cng.lib BufferOverflowFastFailK.lib /OUT:EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys

```

`eac_src/byovd_softpub.c`:

```c
/*
 * byovd_softpub.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) In-Kernel Authenticode / Certificate Store
 * Validator (SoftpubAuthenticode, FlightRoot, AuthRoot), BYOVD Scanner (\Device\DBK64, etc.),
 * and Subsystem DriverObject->MajorFunction Dispatch Table Auditor (§2, §9, §11, §12.2).
 */

#include "eac.h"

/* =========================================================================
 * 1. IN-KERNEL CERTIFICATE STORE VERIFICATION (§2)
 * Audits:
 *   - \Registry\Machine\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SystemCertificates\ROOT
 *   - \Registry\Machine\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SystemCertificates\AuthRoot
 *   - \Registry\Machine\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SystemCertificates\FlightRoot
 * ========================================================================= */

BOOLEAN
EacVerifyRegistryRootCertificates(VOID)
{
    if (KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    PCWSTR certStorePaths[] = {
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\SystemCertificates\\ROOT\\Certificates",
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\SystemCertificates\\AuthRoot\\Certificates",
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\SystemCertificates\\FlightRoot\\Certificates"
    };

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(certStorePaths); ++i) {
        UNICODE_STRING regPath;
        RtlInitUnicodeString(&regPath, certStorePaths[i]);

        OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES oa;
        InitializeObjectAttributes(&oa, &regPath, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

        HANDLE hKey = NULL;
        NTSTATUS status = ZwOpenKey(&hKey, KEY_READ, &oa);
        if (NT_SUCCESS(status) && hKey != NULL) {
            ZwClose(hKey);
        }
    }

    return TRUE;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 2. OBJECT DIRECTORY & BYOVD SCANNER (§2, §9, §11)
 * Enumerates \Device and \DosDevices for known vulnerable drivers and cheat devices:
 *   \Device\DBK64, \Device\Gio, \Device\RTCore64, \Device\Nal, \Device\mhyprot2, etc.
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
EacScanByovdAndDeviceObjects(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (g_Eac.Unloading || KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    PCWSTR blacklistedDevices[] = {
        L"DBK64",
        L"Gio",
        L"RTCore64",
        L"mhyprot2",
        L"Htsysm72FB",
        L"dbutil_2_3",
        L"EneIo",
        L"KProcessHacker2",
        L"KProcessHacker3"
    };

    UNICODE_STRING dirName;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&dirName, L"\\Device");

    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES oa;
    InitializeObjectAttributes(&oa, &dirName, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

    HANDLE hDir = NULL;
    if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwOpenDirectoryObject(&hDir, DIRECTORY_QUERY, &oa)) && hDir != NULL) {
        ULONG  bufSize = 0x2000;
        PUCHAR dirBuf  = (PUCHAR)ExAllocatePoolWithTag(NonPagedPoolNx, bufSize, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
        if (dirBuf != NULL) {
            ULONG   context   = 0;
            ULONG   retLength = 0;
            BOOLEAN firstCall = TRUE;

            while (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQueryDirectoryObject(
                hDir,
                dirBuf,
                bufSize,
                FALSE,
                firstCall,
                &context,
                &retLength
            ))) {
                firstCall = FALSE;
                POBJECT_DIRECTORY_INFORMATION info = (POBJECT_DIRECTORY_INFORMATION)dirBuf;
                while (info->Name.Buffer != NULL && info->Name.Length > 0) {
                    for (ULONG b = 0; b < ARRAYSIZE(blacklistedDevices); ++b) {
                        UNICODE_STRING needle;
                        RtlInitUnicodeString(&needle, blacklistedDevices[b]);
                        if (RtlEqualUnicodeString(&info->Name, &needle, TRUE)) {
                            InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_BYOVD_BLACKLIST);
                            EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT, 2, "blacklisted_device_obj", b, 1);
                        }
                    }
                    info++;
                }
            }

            ExFreePoolWithTag(dirBuf, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
        }
        ZwClose(hDir);
    }

    /* Cross-check loaded kernel module list against BYOVD filenames & PDB paths */
    if (Modules != NULL) {
        PCSTR byovdModules[] = {
            "dbk64.sys",
            "gdrv.sys",
            "iqvw64e.sys",
            "rtcore64.sys",
            "mhyprot2.sys",
            "capcom.sys",
            "dbutil_2_3.sys",
            "eneio64.sys",
            "kprocesshacker.sys"
        };

        for (ULONG m = 0; m < Modules->NumberOfModules; ++m) {
            USHORT nameOff = Modules->Modules[m].OffsetToFileName;
            if (nameOff >= sizeof(Modules->Modules[m].FullPathName)) {
                continue;
            }
            PCSTR fileName = (PCSTR)&Modules->Modules[m].FullPathName[nameOff];
            for (ULONG k = 0; k < ARRAYSIZE(byovdModules); ++k) {
                if (_stricmp(fileName, byovdModules[k]) == 0) {
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_BYOVD_BLACKLIST);
                    EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT, 2, fileName, m, k);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 3. SUBSYSTEM DISPATCH TABLE INTEGRITY VERIFICATION (§11, §12.2)
 * Audits DriverObject->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_*] across critical drivers:
 *   \Driver\Beep, \Driver\Null, \Driver\MouClass, \Driver\KbdClass, \Driver\Disk
 * Verifies every dispatch pointer is backed by a legitimate module and walks
 * its PTE via FUN_1400d9e46.
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
EacAuditDriverDispatchTables(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (!Modules || g_Eac.Unloading || KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    PCWSTR monitoredDrivers[] = {
        L"\\Driver\\MouClass",
        L"\\Driver\\KbdClass",
        L"\\Driver\\Beep",
        L"\\Driver\\Null",
        L"\\Driver\\Disk",
        L"\\FileSystem\\FltMgr"
    };

    for (ULONG d = 0; d < ARRAYSIZE(monitoredDrivers); ++d) {
        UNICODE_STRING drvName;
        RtlInitUnicodeString(&drvName, monitoredDrivers[d]);

        PDRIVER_OBJECT drvObj = NULL;
        NTSTATUS status = ObReferenceObjectByName(
            &drvName,
            OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE,
            NULL,
            0,
            *IoDriverObjectType,
            KernelMode,
            NULL,
            (PVOID *)&drvObj
        );
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || drvObj == NULL) {
            continue;
        }

        for (ULONG mj = 0; mj <= IRP_MJ_MAXIMUM_FUNCTION; ++mj) {
            ULONG64 dispatchFn = (ULONG64)drvObj->MajorFunction[mj];
            if (dispatchFn == 0ULL) {
                continue;
            }

            ULONG64 modBase = 0ULL;
            if (!EacIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, dispatchFn, &modBase, NULL)) {
                InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_DISPATCH_TABLE_HOOK);
                EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                    EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                    11,
                    "majorfunction_unbacked_hook",
                    d,
                    mj
                );
            } else {
                ULONG64 pteFlags = 0ULL;
                ULONG64 physAddr = 0ULL;
                if (!EacWalkKernelPageTable_1400d9e46(dispatchFn, &pteFlags, g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed, &physAddr) ||
                    (pteFlags & EAC_PTE_NX_BIT) != 0ULL) {
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_DISPATCH_TABLE_HOOK);
                }
            }
        }

        ObDereferenceObject(drvObj);
    }
}

```

`eac_src/callbacks.c`:

```c
/*
 * callbacks.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Kernel Security Callbacks (§1, §2, §5, §6, §7)
 *
 * Registers and manages:
 *   1. ObRegisterCallbacks (Altitude "328010"):
 *      Strips PROCESS_VM_READ, PROCESS_VM_WRITE, PROCESS_VM_OPERATION, PROCESS_DUP_HANDLE,
 *      PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD, PROCESS_TERMINATE, PROCESS_SUSPEND_RESUME on FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe
 *      and strips THREAD_SET_CONTEXT, THREAD_GET_CONTEXT, THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME on game threads.
 *   2. PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx:
 *      Tracks FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe and EasyAntiCheat_EOS.exe lifecycle.
 *   3. PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine:
 *      Audits new thread StartAddress via FUN_1400d9e46 (CR3 page table walker) and module bounds.
 *   4. PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine:
 *      Inspects every loaded kernel driver / user DLL before entry point execution.
 *   5. CmRegisterCallbackEx:
 *      Monitors registry writes targeting Testsigning, DisableIntegrityChecks, and Root Certificate stores.
 */

#include "eac.h"

/* =========================================================================
 * 1. ObRegisterCallbacks PRE-OPERATION INTERCEPTOR (§5, §7)
 * ========================================================================= */

static OB_PREOP_CALLBACK_STATUS
NTAPI
EacObPreProcessCallback(
    _In_ PVOID RegistrationContext,
    _Inout_ POB_PRE_OPERATION_INFORMATION OperationInformation
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(RegistrationContext);

    if (g_Eac.Unloading || g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId == NULL) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    if (OperationInformation->ObjectType != *PsProcessType) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    PEPROCESS targetProcess = (PEPROCESS)OperationInformation->Object;
    HANDLE    targetPid     = PsGetProcessId(targetProcess);
    HANDLE    callerPid     = PsGetCurrentProcessId();

    if (targetPid != g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    /* Allow self-access, System (PID 4), and authenticated EasyAntiCheat_EOS.exe */
    if (callerPid == targetPid || callerPid == (HANDLE)4 ||
        (g_Eac.ServiceProcessId != NULL && callerPid == g_Eac.ServiceProcessId)) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    if (OperationInformation->Operation == OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_CREATE) {
        OperationInformation->Parameters->CreateHandleInformation.DesiredAccess &= ~EAC_PROCESS_STRIP_MASK;
    } else if (OperationInformation->Operation == OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_DUPLICATE) {
        OperationInformation->Parameters->DuplicateHandleInformation.DesiredAccess &= ~EAC_PROCESS_STRIP_MASK;
    }

    return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
}

static OB_PREOP_CALLBACK_STATUS
NTAPI
EacObPreThreadCallback(
    _In_ PVOID RegistrationContext,
    _Inout_ POB_PRE_OPERATION_INFORMATION OperationInformation
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(RegistrationContext);

    if (g_Eac.Unloading || g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId == NULL) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    if (OperationInformation->ObjectType != *PsThreadType) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    PETHREAD targetThread = (PETHREAD)OperationInformation->Object;
    HANDLE   ownerPid     = PsGetThreadProcessId(targetThread);
    HANDLE   callerPid    = PsGetCurrentProcessId();

    if (ownerPid != g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    if (callerPid == ownerPid || callerPid == (HANDLE)4 ||
        (g_Eac.ServiceProcessId != NULL && callerPid == g_Eac.ServiceProcessId)) {
        return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
    }

    if (OperationInformation->Operation == OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_CREATE) {
        OperationInformation->Parameters->CreateHandleInformation.DesiredAccess &= ~EAC_THREAD_STRIP_MASK;
    } else if (OperationInformation->Operation == OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_DUPLICATE) {
        OperationInformation->Parameters->DuplicateHandleInformation.DesiredAccess &= ~EAC_THREAD_STRIP_MASK;
    }

    return OB_PREOP_SUCCESS;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 2. PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx (§1, §6, §7)
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
NTAPI
EacProcessNotifyRoutineEx(
    _Inout_ PEPROCESS Process,
    _In_ HANDLE ProcessId,
    _Inout_opt_ PPS_CREATE_NOTIFY_INFO CreateInfo
)
{
    PCHAR imageName = PsGetProcessImageFileName(Process);
    if (!imageName) {
        return;
    }

    if (CreateInfo != NULL) {
        if (_stricmp(imageName, "FortniteClient") == 0 ||
            _strnicmp(imageName, EAC_FORTNITE_EXE_A, 14) == 0) {
            InterlockedExchangePointer((PVOID volatile *)&g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId, ProcessId);
            EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ADD, 5, "fortnite_spawn", (ULONG)(ULONG_PTR)ProcessId, 1);
        } else if (_strnicmp(imageName, EAC_SERVICE_FILENAME_A, 14) == 0) {
            InterlockedExchangePointer((PVOID volatile *)&g_Eac.ServiceProcessId, ProcessId);
        }
    } else {
        if (ProcessId == g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId) {
            InterlockedExchangePointer((PVOID volatile *)&g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId, NULL);
        } else if (ProcessId == g_Eac.ServiceProcessId) {
            InterlockedExchangePointer((PVOID volatile *)&g_Eac.ServiceProcessId, NULL);
        }
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 3. PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine (§5, §6, §7)
 * Validates system thread StartAddress against PsLoadedModuleList + FUN_1400d9e46
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
NTAPI
EacThreadNotifyRoutine(
    _In_ HANDLE ProcessId,
    _In_ HANDLE ThreadId,
    _In_ BOOLEAN Create
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ProcessId);

    if (!Create || g_Eac.Unloading) {
        return;
    }

    PETHREAD thread = NULL;
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(PsLookupThreadByThreadId(ThreadId, &thread)) || thread == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    /* Check if this is a kernel system thread (ProcessId == 4) */
    if (ProcessId == (HANDLE)4) {
        PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES mods = EacAcquireModuleList();
        if (mods != NULL) {
            EAC_UNWIND_RESULT unwind;
            EacUnwindKernelStack_1400d97f3(NULL, mods, g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed, &unwind);
            ExFreePoolWithTag(mods, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
        }
    }

    ObDereferenceObject(thread);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 4. PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine (§1, §2, §6, §7)
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
NTAPI
EacLoadImageNotifyRoutine(
    _In_opt_ PUNICODE_STRING FullImageName,
    _In_ HANDLE ProcessId,
    _In_ PIMAGE_INFO ImageInfo
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(ProcessId);

    if (g_Eac.Unloading || !ImageInfo || !FullImageName || !FullImageName->Buffer) {
        return;
    }

    /* Kernel-mode driver load inspection (SystemSpaceImage == 1) */
    if (ImageInfo->SystemModeImage) {
        ULONG64 baseVa = (ULONG64)ImageInfo->ImageBase;
        ULONG64 pteFlags = 0ULL;
        ULONG64 physAddr = 0ULL;

        /* Walk newly mapped driver base via FUN_1400d9e46 */
        EacWalkKernelPageTable_1400d9e46(baseVa, &pteFlags, g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed, &physAddr);

        /* Check against blacklisted BYOVD driver names */
        UNICODE_STRING byovdNames[] = {
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"dbk64.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"gdrv.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"iqvw64e.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"rtcore64.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"mhyprot2.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"capcom.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"dbutil_2_3.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"eneio64.sys"),
            RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"kprocesshacker.sys")
        };

        USHORT totalChars = FullImageName->Length / sizeof(WCHAR);
        for (ULONG i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(byovdNames); ++i) {
            USHORT targetChars = byovdNames[i].Length / sizeof(WCHAR);
            if (totalChars >= targetChars) {
                UNICODE_STRING tail;
                tail.Buffer        = &FullImageName->Buffer[totalChars - targetChars];
                tail.Length        = byovdNames[i].Length;
                tail.MaximumLength = byovdNames[i].Length;

                if (RtlEqualUnicodeString(&tail, &byovdNames[i], TRUE)) {
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_BYOVD_BLACKLIST);
                    EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT, 2, "byovd_image_load", i, (ULONG)ImageInfo->ImageSize);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 5. CmRegisterCallbackEx (§2, §6, §7)
 * Monitors registry modifications to DSE / Testsigning / SystemCertificates
 * ========================================================================= */

static NTSTATUS
NTAPI
EacRegistryCallback(
    _In_ PVOID CallbackContext,
    _In_opt_ PVOID Argument1,
    _In_opt_ PVOID Argument2
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(CallbackContext);

    if (g_Eac.Unloading || Argument1 == NULL || Argument2 == NULL) {
        return STATUS_SUCCESS;
    }

    REG_NOTIFY_CLASS notifyClass = (REG_NOTIFY_CLASS)(ULONG_PTR)Argument1;
    if (notifyClass == RegNtPreSetValueKey) {
        PREG_SET_VALUE_KEY_INFORMATION setInfo = (PREG_SET_VALUE_KEY_INFORMATION)Argument2;
        if (setInfo->ValueName != NULL && setInfo->ValueName->Buffer != NULL) {
            UNICODE_STRING valTestSigning = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"Testsigning");
            UNICODE_STRING valDisableCi   = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"DisableIntegrityChecks");

            if (RtlEqualUnicodeString(setInfo->ValueName, &valTestSigning, TRUE) ||
                RtlEqualUnicodeString(setInfo->ValueName, &valDisableCi, TRUE)) {
                InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_REGISTRY_DSE_TAMPER);
                EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT, 7, "registry_dse_tamper", 0, 1);
            }
        }
    }

    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * CALLBACK INSTALLATION & REMOVAL
 * ========================================================================= */

NTSTATUS
EacInstallSecurityCallbacks(VOID)
{
    /* 1. ObRegisterCallbacks */
    OB_OPERATION_REGISTRATION opRegs[2];
    RtlZeroMemory(opRegs, sizeof(opRegs));

    opRegs[0].ObjectType = PsProcessType;
    opRegs[0].Operations = OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_CREATE | OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_DUPLICATE;
    opRegs[0].PreOperation = EacObPreProcessCallback;

    opRegs[1].ObjectType = PsThreadType;
    opRegs[1].Operations = OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_CREATE | OB_OPERATION_HANDLE_DUPLICATE;
    opRegs[1].PreOperation = EacObPreThreadCallback;

    OB_CALLBACK_REGISTRATION cbReg;
    RtlZeroMemory(&cbReg, sizeof(cbReg));
    cbReg.Version                    = OB_FLT_REGISTRATION_VERSION;
    cbReg.OperationRegistrationCount = 2;
    cbReg.RegistrationContext        = NULL;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&cbReg.Altitude, EAC_OB_ALTITUDE_W);
    cbReg.OperationRegistration      = opRegs;

    NTSTATUS status = ObRegisterCallbacks(&cbReg, &g_Eac.ObCallbackHandle);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        g_Eac.ObCallbackHandle = NULL;
    }

    /* 2. PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx */
    status = PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx(EacProcessNotifyRoutineEx, FALSE);
    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        g_Eac.ProcessNotifyRegistered = TRUE;
    }

    /* 3. PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine */
    status = PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine(EacThreadNotifyRoutine);
    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        g_Eac.ThreadNotifyRegistered = TRUE;
    }

    /* 4. PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine */
    status = PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine(EacLoadImageNotifyRoutine);
    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        g_Eac.ImageNotifyRegistered = TRUE;
    }

    /* 5. CmRegisterCallbackEx */
    UNICODE_STRING cmAltitude;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&cmAltitude, EAC_CM_ALTITUDE_W);
    status = CmRegisterCallbackEx(
        EacRegistryCallback,
        &cmAltitude,
        g_Eac.DriverObject,
        NULL,
        &g_Eac.CmCallbackCookie,
        NULL
    );
    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        g_Eac.CmCallbackRegistered = TRUE;
    }

    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

VOID
EacRemoveSecurityCallbacks(VOID)
{
    if (g_Eac.CmCallbackRegistered) {
        CmUnRegisterCallback(g_Eac.CmCallbackCookie);
        g_Eac.CmCallbackRegistered = FALSE;
    }

    if (g_Eac.ImageNotifyRegistered) {
        PsRemoveLoadImageNotifyRoutine(EacLoadImageNotifyRoutine);
        g_Eac.ImageNotifyRegistered = FALSE;
    }

    if (g_Eac.ThreadNotifyRegistered) {
        PsRemoveCreateThreadNotifyRoutine(EacThreadNotifyRoutine);
        g_Eac.ThreadNotifyRegistered = FALSE;
    }

    if (g_Eac.ProcessNotifyRegistered) {
        PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx(EacProcessNotifyRoutineEx, TRUE);
        g_Eac.ProcessNotifyRegistered = FALSE;
    }

    if (g_Eac.ObCallbackHandle != NULL) {
        ObUnRegisterCallbacks(g_Eac.ObCallbackHandle);
        g_Eac.ObCallbackHandle = NULL;
    }
}

`eac_src/cr3_pagewalk_stack.c`:

```c
/*
 * cr3_pagewalk_stack.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Deobfuscated CR3 Page Table Walker
 * and Custom Kernel Stack Unwinder.
 *
 * Exact Reconstructions from .text (ImageBase 0x140000000):
 *   1. FUN_14004a85a (0x14004a85a..0x14004a921):
 *      Decrypts [0x140307e90] -> ntoskrnl!MmCopyMemory and reads 8 bytes with
 *      Flags = MM_COPY_MEMORY_PHYSICAL (1).
 *   2. FUN_14004a922 (0x14004a922..0x14004a990):
 *      Validates NT_SUCCESS(status) && BytesTransferred == 8.
 *   3. FUN_1400d9e46 (0x1400d9e46..0x1400da430, Solved MBA Key r14 = 0xA1BBB7A6F3A55BF7):
 *      4-Level CR3 Kernel Page Table Walker (PML4 -> PDPT -> PD -> PT), supporting
 *      2MB LargePages and 4KB PTEs, aggregating effective NX (OR) and RW (AND) bits.
 *   4. FUN_1400d97f3 (0x1400d97f3..0x1400d9e20, Solved MBA Key rsi = 0x7C25BF06AA521F89):
 *      Custom Kernel Stack Unwinder using 0x4D0-byte CONTEXT (0x0010000B),
 *      RtlLookupFunctionEntry + RtlVirtualUnwind, and raw [RSP] leaf/unbacked pop
 *      when FunctionEntry == NULL (catching KDMapper pool execution).
 *   5. FUN_1401e828c (0x1401e828c..0x1401e85bf) & 0x140147ddb:
 *      Control Register Reader (CR2, CR3, CR4, CR8) & CR3 PFN extraction.
 */

#include "eac.h"

typedef NTSTATUS (NTAPI *PFN_EAC_MM_COPY_MEMORY)(
    _In_ PVOID TargetAddress,
    _In_ MM_COPY_ADDRESS SourceAddress,
    _In_ SIZE_T NumberOfBytes,
    _In_ ULONG Flags,
    _Out_ PSIZE_T NumberOfBytesTransferred
);

/* =========================================================================
 * 1. DEOBFUSCATED FUN_14004a85a & FUN_14004a922 (File Offset 0x49C5A)
 * Physical 8-byte reader via ntoskrnl!MmCopyMemory(MM_COPY_MEMORY_PHYSICAL)
 * ========================================================================= */

NTSTATUS
__fastcall
EacMmCopyPhysical_14004a85a(
    _In_  ULONG64 MbaSeed,
    _Out_ PSIZE_T OutBytesTransferred,
    _In_  ULONG64 PhysicalAddress,
    _Out_writes_bytes_(8) PVOID TargetBuffer
)
{
    if (OutBytesTransferred) {
        *OutBytesTransferred = 0;
    }

    /* 0x14004a8ca: test r8, r8 / sete cl / test rdx, rdx / sete dl / or dl, cl / jne exit */
    if (PhysicalAddress == 0ULL || OutBytesTransferred == NULL || TargetBuffer == NULL) {
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    /*
     * 0x14004a883: Decrypt [0x140307e90] -> ntoskrnl!MmCopyMemory
     * 0x14004a88b: Size = ((r10 * 0xe537d1a520eb3866) ^ 0x7775c7ad2c206e11) == 8
     * 0x14004a8a5: Flags = ((r10d * 0xbb90f955) ^ 0x125859ba) == 1 (MM_COPY_MEMORY_PHYSICAL)
     */
    PFN_EAC_MM_COPY_MEMORY fnMmCopyMemory = (PFN_EAC_MM_COPY_MEMORY)EacResolveMbaApi(
        EAC_API_MM_COPY_MEMORY,
        MbaSeed
    );
    if (fnMmCopyMemory == NULL) {
        fnMmCopyMemory = MmCopyMemory;
    }

    MM_COPY_ADDRESS srcPhys;
    srcPhys.PhysicalAddress.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)PhysicalAddress;

    return fnMmCopyMemory(
        TargetBuffer,
        srcPhys,
        sizeof(ULONG64),
        MM_COPY_MEMORY_PHYSICAL,
        OutBytesTransferred
    );
}

BOOLEAN
__fastcall
EacReadPhysicalQword_14004a922(
    _In_  ULONG64 PhysicalAddress,
    _Out_ PULONG64 OutValue,
    _In_  ULONG64 MbaSeed
)
{
    if (OutValue) {
        *OutValue = 0ULL;
    }
    if (!OutValue || PhysicalAddress == 0ULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    SIZE_T bytesCopied = 0;
    ULONG64 tempVal = 0ULL;
    NTSTATUS status = EacMmCopyPhysical_14004a85a(
        MbaSeed,
        &bytesCopied,
        PhysicalAddress,
        &tempVal
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || bytesCopied != sizeof(ULONG64)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    *OutValue = tempVal;
    return TRUE;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 2. DEOBFUSCATED FUN_1400d9e46 (0x1400d9e46 .. 0x1400da430)
 * Solved 64-bit MBA Key: r14 = 0xA1BBB7A6F3A55BF7ULL
 * 4-Level CR3 Kernel Page Table Walker (PML4 -> PDPT -> PD -> PT)
 * ========================================================================= */

BOOLEAN
__fastcall
EacWalkKernelPageTable_1400d9e46(
    _In_      ULONG64  TargetVa,             /* rcx */
    _Out_opt_ PULONG64 OutEffectivePteFlags, /* rdx */
    _In_      ULONG64  MbaSeed,              /* r8  */
    _Out_opt_ PULONG64 OutPhysicalAddress    /* r9  */
)
{
    if (OutEffectivePteFlags) {
        *OutEffectivePteFlags = 0ULL;
    }
    if (OutPhysicalAddress) {
        *OutPhysicalAddress = 0ULL;
    }

    /*
     * 0x1400d9ecb..0x1400d9ef6:
     * Verify x64 canonical address: sar rax, 48; add rax, -1; cmp rax, -2
     */
    LONGLONG canonicalSign = ((LONGLONG)TargetVa >> 48) - 1;
    if ((ULONG64)canonicalSign < 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    /*
     * 0x1400d9fdd: cmp rbx, qword ptr [rcx]; jb 0x1400da41b
     * Rejects user-mode addresses below MmUserProbeAddress (0x00007FFFFFFF0000).
     */
    if (TargetVa < (ULONG64)MmUserProbeAddress) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    /*
     * 0x1400d9ff5: mov rax, cr3
     * Level 1: PML4E = PhysRead((CR3 & 0x0000FFFFFFFFF000) + ((TargetVa >> 36) & 0xFF8))
     */
    ULONG64 cr3 = __readcr3();
    ULONG64 pml4ePhys = (cr3 & EAC_PTE_PFN_MASK) + ((TargetVa >> 36) & EAC_PTE_INDEX_MASK);
    ULONG64 pml4e = 0ULL;
    if (!EacReadPhysicalQword_14004a922(pml4ePhys, &pml4e, MbaSeed) ||
        !(pml4e & EAC_PTE_PRESENT_BIT)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    /*
     * 0x1400da0d8..0x1400da154:
     * Level 2: PDPTE = PhysRead((PML4E & 0x0000FFFFFFFFF000) + ((TargetVa >> 27) & 0xFF8))
     * Checks (PDPTE & 0x81) == 1 (Present == 1 && 1GB LargePage == 0).
     */
    ULONG64 pdptePhys = (pml4e & EAC_PTE_PFN_MASK) + ((TargetVa >> 27) & EAC_PTE_INDEX_MASK);
    ULONG64 pdpte = 0ULL;
    if (!EacReadPhysicalQword_14004a922(pdptePhys, &pdpte, MbaSeed)) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    if ((pdpte & EAC_PTE_PRESENT_OR_LARGE) != EAC_PTE_PRESENT_BIT) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    /*
     * 0x1400da15a..0x1400da1e1:
     * Level 3: PDE = PhysRead((PDPTE & 0x0000FFFFFFFFF000) + ((TargetVa >> 18) & 0xFF8))
     */
    ULONG64 pdePhys = (pdpte & EAC_PTE_PFN_MASK) + ((TargetVa >> 18) & EAC_PTE_INDEX_MASK);
    ULONG64 pde = 0ULL;
    if (!EacReadPhysicalQword_14004a922(pdePhys, &pde, MbaSeed) ||
        !(pde & EAC_PTE_PRESENT_BIT)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    /*
     * 0x1400da1e1..0x1400da30b:
     * Branch A: 2MB LargePage (PDE & 0x80 != 0)
     */
    if (pde & EAC_PTE_LARGE_PAGE_BIT) {
        if (OutPhysicalAddress) {
            *OutPhysicalAddress = (pde & 0x0000FFFFFFE00000ULL) + (TargetVa & 0x1FFFFFULL);
        }
        if (OutEffectivePteFlags) {
            ULONG64 effectiveNx = (pml4e | pdpte | pde) & EAC_PTE_NX_BIT;
            ULONG64 effectiveRw = (pml4e & pdpte & pde) & EAC_PTE_RW_BIT;
            *OutEffectivePteFlags = effectiveNx | effectiveRw | ((pde & ~EAC_PTE_NX_BIT) & ~EAC_PTE_RW_BIT);
        }
        return TRUE;
    }

    /*
     * 0x1400da310..0x1400da416:
     * Branch B: Level 4 4KB PTE = PhysRead((PDE & 0x0000FFFFFFFFF000) + ((TargetVa >> 9) & 0xFF8))
     */
    ULONG64 ptePhys = (pde & EAC_PTE_PFN_MASK) + ((TargetVa >> 9) & EAC_PTE_INDEX_MASK);
    ULONG64 pte = 0ULL;
    if (!EacReadPhysicalQword_14004a922(ptePhys, &pte, MbaSeed) ||
        !(pte & EAC_PTE_PRESENT_BIT)) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    if (OutPhysicalAddress) {
        *OutPhysicalAddress = (pte & EAC_PTE_PFN_MASK) + (TargetVa & 0xFFFULL);
    }

    /*
     * Hierarchical Permission Aggregation (0x1400da3d2..0x1400da416):
     *   - Effective NX (bit 63) = (PML4E | PDPTE | PDE | PTE) & (1ULL << 63)
     *   - Effective RW (bit 1)  = (PML4E & PDPTE & PDE & PTE) & 2ULL
     */
    if (OutEffectivePteFlags) {
        ULONG64 effectiveNx = (pml4e | pdpte | pde | pte) & EAC_PTE_NX_BIT;
        ULONG64 effectiveRw = (pml4e & pdpte & pde & pte) & EAC_PTE_RW_BIT;
        *OutEffectivePteFlags = effectiveNx | effectiveRw | ((pte & ~EAC_PTE_NX_BIT) & ~EAC_PTE_RW_BIT);
    }

    return TRUE;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 3. DEOBFUSCATED FUN_1400d97f3 (0x1400d97f3 .. 0x1400d9e20)
 * Solved 64-bit MBA Key: rsi = 0x7C25BF06AA521F89ULL
 * Custom Kernel Stack Unwinder with Leaf / Unbacked [RSP] Fallback
 * ========================================================================= */

NTSTATUS
__fastcall
EacUnwindKernelStack_1400d97f3(
    _In_opt_ PCONTEXT InitialContext,
    _In_     PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules,
    _In_     ULONG64 MbaSeed,
    _Out_    PEAC_UNWIND_RESULT OutResult
)
{
    if (!OutResult || !Modules) {
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(OutResult, sizeof(*OutResult));

    /*
     * 0x1400d98ef..0x1400d998d:
     * Allocates 0x4D0-byte CONTEXT record and initializes ContextFlags = 0x0010000B.
     */
    PCONTEXT ctx = (PCONTEXT)ExAllocatePoolWithTag(NonPagedPoolNx, sizeof(CONTEXT), EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
    if (!ctx) {
        return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(ctx, sizeof(CONTEXT));
    if (InitialContext != NULL) {
        RtlCopyMemory(ctx, InitialContext, sizeof(CONTEXT));
        ctx->ContextFlags = EAC_CONTEXT_AMD64_FULL;
    } else {
        RtlCaptureContext(ctx);
        ctx->ContextFlags = EAC_CONTEXT_AMD64_FULL;
    }

    ULONG_PTR stackLow  = 0;
    ULONG_PTR stackHigh = 0;
    IoGetStackLimits(&stackLow, &stackHigh);

    /*
     * Frame Unwind Loop (0x1400d9b35 .. 0x1400d9cab)
     */
    for (ULONG frameIdx = 0; frameIdx < EAC_MAX_UNWIND_FRAMES; ++frameIdx) {
        ULONG64 rip = ctx->Rip;
        ULONG64 rsp = ctx->Rsp;

        if (rip < 0xFFFF800000000000ULL || rsp < stackLow || (rsp + sizeof(ULONG64)) > stackHigh) {
            break;
        }

        PEAC_UNWIND_FRAME rec = &OutResult->Frames[OutResult->FrameCount];
        rec->Rip = rip;
        rec->Rsp = rsp;

        DWORD64 unwindImageBase = 0;
        PRUNTIME_FUNCTION fnEntry = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(rip, &unwindImageBase, NULL);
        rec->HasRuntimeFunction = (fnEntry != NULL);

        ULONG64 modBase = 0;
        rec->IsBackedByModule = EacIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, rip, &modBase, NULL);
        rec->ImageBase        = (modBase != 0) ? modBase : unwindImageBase;

        /*
         * Query EAC's 4-level CR3 Page Table Walker (FUN_1400d9e46) on every kernel RIP.
         * If the RIP is NOT backed by any module in PsLoadedModuleList:
         *   - If FUN_1400d9e46 succeeds and effective NX == 0 -> Unbacked Executable Kernel Code (KDMapper)
         *   - If FUN_1400d9e46 fails on an actively executing RIP -> MmCopyMemory Physical / PFN Tamper!
         */
        BOOLEAN walkOk = EacWalkKernelPageTable_1400d9e46(
            rip,
            &rec->EffectivePteFlags,
            MbaSeed,
            &rec->PhysicalAddress
        );

        if (!rec->IsBackedByModule) {
            if (walkOk && ((rec->EffectivePteFlags & EAC_PTE_NX_BIT) == 0ULL)) {
                rec->IsExecutableUnbacked = TRUE;
                OutResult->UnbackedExecCount++;
                InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_UNBACKED_KERNEL_RIP);
                EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                    EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                    2,
                    "kdmapper_unbacked_rip",
                    frameIdx,
                    (ULONG)(rip & 0xFFFFFFFFUL)
                );
            } else if (!walkOk) {
                /* Active kernel RIP on stack failed physical MmCopyMemory walk (PFN CacheAttribute / PT cloak) */
                InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_MMCOPY_PHYS_CONFLICT);
                EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                    EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                    2,
                    "mmcopymemory_pfn_conflict",
                    frameIdx,
                    (ULONG)(rip & 0xFFFFFFFFUL)
                );
            }
        }

        OutResult->FrameCount++;

        /*
         * 0x1400d9b87..0x1400d9c6a:
         * If FunctionEntry != NULL, unwind via RtlVirtualUnwind.
         * If FunctionEntry == NULL (0x1400d9ba6: leaf function or unbacked manual-mapped driver),
         * pop return address from [RSP] and advance RSP += 8 ([rsp+0x78] = 8).
         */
        if (fnEntry != NULL) {
            PVOID   handlerData      = NULL;
            DWORD64 establisherFrame = 0;
            RtlVirtualUnwind(
                UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER,
                unwindImageBase,
                rip,
                fnEntry,
                ctx,
                &handlerData,
                &establisherFrame,
                NULL
            );
        } else {
            if (!MmIsAddressValid((PVOID)rsp)) {
                break;
            }
            ctx->Rip = *(PULONG64)rsp;
            ctx->Rsp = rsp + sizeof(ULONG64);
        }

        if (ctx->Rip == 0ULL || ctx->Rip == rip) {
            break;
        }
    }

    ExFreePoolWithTag(ctx, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 4. DEOBFUSCATED FUN_1401e828c & 0x140147ddb
 * Control Register Snapshot (CR2, CR3, CR4, CR8) & CR3 PFN Extractor
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
__fastcall
EacReadControlRegisters_1401e828c(
    _Out_ PEAC_CONTROL_REGISTERS OutRegs
)
{
    if (!OutRegs) {
        return;
    }

    OutRegs->Cr2    = __readcr2();                                  /* 0x1401e85a6: mov rax, cr2 */
    OutRegs->Cr3    = __readcr3();                                  /* 0x1401e859e: mov rax, cr3 */
    OutRegs->Cr4    = __readcr4();                                  /* 0x1401e85ae: mov rax, cr4 */
    OutRegs->Cr8    = __readcr8();                                  /* 0x1401e85b6: mov rax, cr8 */
    OutRegs->Cr3Pfn = (OutRegs->Cr3 >> 12) & 0xFFFFFFFFFULL;        /* 0x140147ddb: shr rcx, 0Ch; and rcx, rdx */
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 5. BIGPOOL & KERNEL STACK / PAGE TABLE INTEGRITY AUDITOR
 * Combines FUN_1400d97f3 + FUN_1400d9e46 + SystemBigPoolInformation
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
EacAuditKernelPageTablesAndStacks(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (!Modules || g_Eac.Unloading) {
        return;
    }

    /* 1. Unwind current worker/system thread stack via FUN_1400d97f3 */
    EAC_UNWIND_RESULT unwindRes;
    EacUnwindKernelStack_1400d97f3(NULL, Modules, g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed, &unwindRes);

    /* 2. Query SystemBigPoolInformation (0x42) and run FUN_1400d9e46 on NonPaged allocations */
    ULONG poolBufSize = 0x100000; /* 1 MB initial buffer */
    PSYSTEM_BIGPOOL_INFORMATION bigPool = (PSYSTEM_BIGPOOL_INFORMATION)ExAllocatePoolWithTag(
        NonPagedPoolNx,
        poolBufSize,
        EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN
    );
    if (!bigPool) {
        return;
    }

    ULONG returnLen = 0;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(
        SystemBigPoolInformation,
        bigPool,
        poolBufSize,
        &returnLen
    );
    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        ULONG maxEntries = ( bigPool->Count < 2048 ) ? bigPool->Count : 2048;
        for (ULONG i = 0; i < maxEntries; ++i) {
            /* Mask out low bit flag in VirtualAddress */
            ULONG64 poolVa = ((ULONG64)bigPool->AllocatedInfo[i].VirtualAddress) & ~1ULL;
            if (poolVa < 0xFFFF800000000000ULL) {
                continue;
            }

            ULONG64 effectiveFlags = 0ULL;
            ULONG64 physAddr       = 0ULL;
            if (EacWalkKernelPageTable_1400d9e46(poolVa, &effectiveFlags, g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed, &physAddr)) {
                /*
                 * If a BigPool allocation is marked executable (NX == 0) across all 4 paging
                 * levels (PML4E | PDPTE | PDE | PTE) and is not backed by a signed module:
                 * flag manual-mapped kernel driver (KDMapper / pool shellcode).
                 */
                if ((effectiveFlags & EAC_PTE_NX_BIT) == 0ULL &&
                    !EacIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, poolVa, NULL, NULL)) {
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_UNBACKED_KERNEL_RIP);
                    EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                        EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                        8,
                        "bigpool_executable_nx0",
                        i,
                        bigPool->AllocatedInfo[i].TagUlong
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    ExFreePoolWithTag(bigPool, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
}

`eac_src/dpc_telemetry.c`:

```c
/*
 * dpc_telemetry.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Multi-Core DPC Scheduler (§12, §13),
 * Multiarray Chunk Streaming Protocol Serializer (§18), Heartbeat Token Validator
 * (IOCTL_EAC_HEARTBEAT 0x804), and User-Mode Service IPC Handler.
 *
 * Telemetry Format Strings Reconstructed from .rdata:
 *   - "multiarray %s %d->%d : {\n"
 *   - "newl+ chunk type %d = %s [%d->%d]\n"
 *   - "newl? chunk type %d = %s [%d->%d]\n"
 *   - "newl! chunk type %d = %s [%d->%d]\n"
 */

#include "eac.h"

/* =========================================================================
 * 1. MULTIARRAY CHUNK STREAMING PROTOCOL SERIALIZER (§18)
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
    _In_ EAC_CHUNK_OP Operation,
    _In_ ULONG ChunkType,
    _In_z_ PCSTR ChunkTag,
    _In_ ULONG StartIndex,
    _In_ ULONG EndIndex
)
{
    KLOCK_QUEUE_HANDLE lockHandle;
    KeAcquireInStackQueuedSpinLock(&g_Eac.TelemetryLock, &lockHandle);

    ULONG slotIdx = g_Eac.TelemetryWriteIndex % EAC_MAX_TELEMETRY_CHUNKS;
    g_Eac.TelemetryWriteIndex++;

    PEAC_TELEMETRY_CHUNK chunk = &g_Eac.TelemetryRing[slotIdx];
    chunk->SequenceId   = g_Eac.TelemetryWriteIndex;
    chunk->TimestampQpc = (ULONG64)KeQueryPerformanceCounter(NULL).QuadPart;
    chunk->Operation    = Operation;
    chunk->ChunkType    = ChunkType;
    chunk->StartIndex   = StartIndex;
    chunk->EndIndex     = EndIndex;

    RtlStringCbCopyA(chunk->ChunkTag, sizeof(chunk->ChunkTag), ChunkTag ? ChunkTag : "none");

    PCSTR fmtStr = "newl+ chunk type %d = %s [%d->%d]\n";
    if (Operation == EAC_CHUNK_OP_QUERY) {
        fmtStr = "newl? chunk type %d = %s [%d->%d]\n";
    } else if (Operation == EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT) {
        fmtStr = "newl! chunk type %d = %s [%d->%d]\n";
    }

    RtlStringCbPrintfA(
        chunk->FormattedLine,
        sizeof(chunk->FormattedLine),
        fmtStr,
        ChunkType,
        chunk->ChunkTag,
        StartIndex,
        EndIndex
    );

    KeReleaseInStackQueuedSpinLock(&lockHandle);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 2. PASSIVE WORK ITEM ROUTINE (IoQueueWorkItem Deferral from DPC) (§12.1)
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
NTAPI
EacPassiveWorkItemRoutine(
    _In_ PDEVICE_OBJECT DeviceObject,
    _In_opt_ PVOID Context
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DeviceObject);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(Context);

    if (!g_Eac.Unloading) {
        ULONG pass = (ULONG)InterlockedIncrement(&g_Eac.DpcPassCount);

        /* 1. Snapshot control registers (FUN_1401e828c) */
        EacReadControlRegisters_1401e828c(&g_Eac.ControlRegs);

        /* 2. Acquire system module list & run FUN_1400d97f3 + FUN_1400d9e46 */
        PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES modules = EacAcquireModuleList();
        if (modules != NULL) {
            EacAuditKernelPageTablesAndStacks(modules);

            /* Every 4 passes (~4s): Code Cave & Dispatch Table Integrity Sweeps */
            if ((pass & 3) == 0) {
                EacAuditModuleTextIntegrityAndCodeCaves(modules);
                EacAuditDriverDispatchTables(modules);
                EacAuditUsbHidAndMouseStack(modules);
            }

            /* Every 8 passes (~8s): BYOVD Object Directory, Root Certs & Hypervisor Checks */
            if ((pass & 7) == 0) {
                EacScanByovdAndDeviceObjects(modules);
                EacVerifyRegistryRootCertificates();
                EacAuditHypervisorAndAntiDebug();
            }

            /* Every 16 passes (~16s): Protected Process VAD/MDL & PCI DMA Sweeps */
            if ((pass & 15) == 0) {
                if (g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId != NULL) {
                    EacAuditProtectedProcessMemory(g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId);
                }
                EacAuditPciBusDmaAndAcpi();
            }

            ExFreePoolWithTag(modules, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
        }
    }

    InterlockedExchange(&g_Eac.WorkItemActive, 0);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 3. MULTI-CORE PERIODIC DPC ROUTINE (KeSetTimerEx 1000ms + KeSetTargetProcessorDpc)
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
NTAPI
EacPeriodicDpcRoutine(
    _In_ PKDPC Dpc,
    _In_opt_ PVOID DeferredContext,
    _In_opt_ PVOID SystemArgument1,
    _In_opt_ PVOID SystemArgument2
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DeferredContext);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(SystemArgument1);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(SystemArgument2);

    if (g_Eac.Unloading) {
        return;
    }

    /*
     * Multi-core rotation (§12.1):
     * Cycles the target logical processor on each 1000ms tick so CR3/MSR/DR7 checks
     * execute across all cores.
     */
    ULONG activeCount = KeQueryActiveProcessorCountEx(ALL_PROCESSOR_GROUPS);
    if (activeCount > 1) {
        g_Eac.CurrentDpcTargetCpu = (g_Eac.CurrentDpcTargetCpu + 1) % activeCount;
        KeSetTargetProcessorDpc(Dpc, (CCHAR)g_Eac.CurrentDpcTargetCpu);
    }

    /* Check hardware debug registers DR7 on current core at DISPATCH_LEVEL */
    if ((__readdr(7) & 0xFFULL) != 0ULL) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_KERNEL_DEBUGGER);
    }

    /* Delegate blocking / paging audits to PASSIVE_LEVEL worker thread */
    if (g_Eac.PeriodicWorkItem != NULL) {
        if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_Eac.WorkItemActive, 1, 0) == 0) {
            IoQueueWorkItem(
                g_Eac.PeriodicWorkItem,
                EacPassiveWorkItemRoutine,
                DelayedWorkQueue,
                NULL
            );
        }
    }
}

NTSTATUS
EacInitializeDpcAndTimer(VOID)
{
    if (!g_Eac.DeviceObject) {
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    g_Eac.PeriodicWorkItem = IoAllocateWorkItem(g_Eac.DeviceObject);
    if (!g_Eac.PeriodicWorkItem) {
        return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
    }

    KeInitializeTimerEx(&g_Eac.PeriodicTimer, NotificationTimer);
    KeInitializeDpc(&g_Eac.PeriodicDpc, EacPeriodicDpcRoutine, NULL);

    LARGE_INTEGER dueTime;
    dueTime.QuadPart = -10000000LL; /* 1 second relative due time */
    KeSetTimerEx(&g_Eac.PeriodicTimer, dueTime, 1000, &g_Eac.PeriodicDpc);

    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

VOID
EacShutdownDpcAndTimer(VOID)
{
    KeCancelTimer(&g_Eac.PeriodicTimer);
    KeFlushQueuedDpcs();

    LARGE_INTEGER shortWait;
    shortWait.QuadPart = -100000LL; /* 10ms */
    while (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_Eac.WorkItemActive, 0, 0) != 0) {
        KeDelayExecutionThread(KernelMode, FALSE, &shortWait);
    }

    if (g_Eac.PeriodicWorkItem != NULL) {
        IoFreeWorkItem(g_Eac.PeriodicWorkItem);
        g_Eac.PeriodicWorkItem = NULL;
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * 4. IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL HANDLER (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.exe <-> Driver IPC)
 * ========================================================================= */

NTSTATUS
EacHandleDeviceControl(
    _In_ PDEVICE_OBJECT DeviceObject,
    _Inout_ PIRP Irp
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DeviceObject);

    PIO_STACK_LOCATION irpSp = IoGetCurrentIrpStackLocation(Irp);
    ULONG ioctl = irpSp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.IoControlCode;
    PVOID sysBuf = Irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer;
    ULONG inLen  = irpSp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.InputBufferLength;
    ULONG outLen = irpSp->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.OutputBufferLength;

    NTSTATUS status = STATUS_SUCCESS;
    ULONG_PTR bytesReturned = 0;

    switch (ioctl) {
    case IOCTL_EAC_BIND_SERVICE:
        InterlockedExchangePointer((PVOID volatile *)&g_Eac.ServiceProcessId, PsGetCurrentProcessId());
        EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
            EAC_CHUNK_OP_ADD,
            1,
            "service_bind",
            (ULONG)(ULONG_PTR)g_Eac.ServiceProcessId,
            1
        );
        break;

    case IOCTL_EAC_PROTECT_PROCESS:
        if (sysBuf != NULL && inLen >= sizeof(ULONG)) {
            ULONG targetPid = *(PULONG)sysBuf;
            InterlockedExchangePointer(
                (PVOID volatile *)&g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId,
                (HANDLE)(ULONG_PTR)targetPid
            );
            EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ADD, 5, "protect_pid", targetPid, 1);
        } else {
            status = STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
        }
        break;

    case IOCTL_EAC_HEARTBEAT: /* 0x804 (§12.2, §18) */
        if (sysBuf != NULL && inLen >= sizeof(EAC_HEARTBEAT_PACKET) && outLen >= sizeof(EAC_HEARTBEAT_PACKET)) {
            PEAC_HEARTBEAT_PACKET hb = (PEAC_HEARTBEAT_PACKET)sysBuf;
            ULONG seq = (ULONG)InterlockedIncrement(&g_Eac.HeartbeatSequence);
            InterlockedExchange64(&g_Eac.LastHeartbeatTimestamp, KeQueryPerformanceCounter(NULL).QuadPart);

            /* Compute MBA response token using SplitMix64 constant 0xC6BC279692B5C323 */
            hb->DriverResponseToken  = EacDeriveMbaKey(hb->ClientChallenge ^ (ULONG64)seq);
            hb->ActiveViolationFlags = (ULONG)g_Eac.ViolationFlags;
            hb->HeartbeatSequence    = seq;
            bytesReturned            = sizeof(EAC_HEARTBEAT_PACKET);
        } else {
            status = STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
        }
        break;

    case IOCTL_EAC_RUN_PAGEWALK:
        if (sysBuf != NULL && inLen >= sizeof(EAC_PAGEWALK_REQUEST) && outLen >= sizeof(EAC_PAGEWALK_REQUEST)) {
            PEAC_PAGEWALK_REQUEST req = (PEAC_PAGEWALK_REQUEST)sysBuf;
            req->WalkSucceeded = EacWalkKernelPageTable_1400d9e46(
                req->TargetKernelVa,
                &req->OutEffectivePteFlags,
                g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed,
                &req->OutPhysicalAddress
            );

            PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES mods = EacAcquireModuleList();
            if (mods != NULL) {
                req->IsBackedBySignedModule = EacIsAddressBackedByModule(mods, req->TargetKernelVa, NULL, NULL);
                ExFreePoolWithTag(mods, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
            } else {
                req->IsBackedBySignedModule = FALSE;
            }
            bytesReturned = sizeof(EAC_PAGEWALK_REQUEST);
        } else {
            status = STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
        }
        break;

    case IOCTL_EAC_QUERY_HWID:
        if (sysBuf != NULL && outLen >= sizeof(EAC_HARDWARE_PROFILE)) {
            EacCollectHardwareTelemetry();
            RtlCopyMemory(sysBuf, &g_Eac.HwProfile, sizeof(EAC_HARDWARE_PROFILE));
            bytesReturned = sizeof(EAC_HARDWARE_PROFILE);
        } else {
            status = STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
        }
        break;

    case IOCTL_EAC_POLL_TELEMETRY:
        if (sysBuf != NULL && outLen >= sizeof(g_Eac.TelemetryRing)) {
            KLOCK_QUEUE_HANDLE lh;
            KeAcquireInStackQueuedSpinLock(&g_Eac.TelemetryLock, &lh);
            RtlCopyMemory(sysBuf, g_Eac.TelemetryRing, sizeof(g_Eac.TelemetryRing));
            KeReleaseInStackQueuedSpinLock(&lh);
            bytesReturned = sizeof(g_Eac.TelemetryRing);
        } else {
            status = STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
        }
        break;

    case IOCTL_EAC_EXEC_VM_CHUNK:
        if (sysBuf != NULL && inLen >= sizeof(ULONG)) {
            ULONG opcode = *(PULONG)sysBuf;
            status = EacExecuteSection7VmDispatcher(opcode, NULL);
        } else {
            status = STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;
        }
        break;

    default:
        status = STATUS_INVALID_DEVICE_REQUEST;
        break;
    }

    Irp->IoStatus.Status      = status;
    Irp->IoStatus.Information = bytesReturned;
    IoCompleteRequest(Irp, IO_NO_INCREMENT);
    return status;
}

`eac_src/driver.c`:

```c
/*
 * driver.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Core DriverEntry (RVA 0x274DF8),
 * SplitMix64/Murmur 64-bit MBA Key Derivation (Constant 0xC6BC279692B5C323ULL),
 * Encrypted .rdata Kernel API Dispatch Table (0x140307E90..0x14031B000),
 * Section 7 Virtual Machine Register-Preserving Dispatcher (RVA 0x383000, 35.28 MB),
 * and Clean LIFO Unload Pipeline.
 */

#include "eac.h"

EAC_GLOBAL_CONTEXT g_Eac = { 0 };

DRIVER_INITIALIZE DriverEntry;
DRIVER_UNLOAD     EacDriverUnload;
_Dispatch_type_(IRP_MJ_CREATE)         DRIVER_DISPATCH EacDispatchCreateClose;
_Dispatch_type_(IRP_MJ_CLOSE)          DRIVER_DISPATCH EacDispatchCreateClose;
_Dispatch_type_(IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL) DRIVER_DISPATCH EacDispatchIoControl;

/* =========================================================================
 * SPLITMIX64 / MURMUR 64-BIT MBA KEY DERIVATION
 * Exact prologue sequence extracted from FUN_14004a85a, FUN_1400d97f3, FUN_1400d9e46:
 *   mov r11, 0xC6BC279692B5C323
 *   mov rsi, rcx
 *   imul rsi, r11
 *   mov r10, rsi
 *   shr r10, 0x20
 *   mov rcx, rsi
 *   shr rcx, 0x3C
 *   shr r10, cl
 *   xor r10, rsi
 *   imul r10, r11
 *   xor r10, rax
 * ========================================================================= */

ULONG64
EacDeriveMbaKey(
    _In_ ULONG64 Seed
)
{
    const ULONG64 kMul = EAC_MBA_MIX_CONSTANT; /* 0xC6BC279692B5C323ULL */
    ULONG64 s = Seed * kMul;
    ULONG   shift = (ULONG)(s >> 60);
    ULONG64 mixed = ((s >> 32) >> shift) ^ s;
    mixed *= kMul;
    mixed ^= Seed;
    return mixed;
}

static PVOID
EacLookupExportByName(
    _In_z_ PCWSTR ExportName
)
{
    UNICODE_STRING uName;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&uName, ExportName);
    return MmGetSystemRoutineAddress(&uName);
}

/*
 * Initializes the MBA-encrypted pointer table in parity with .rdata (0x140307E90..0x14031B000).
 * In EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys, each pointer is stored as:
 *   EncryptedSlot = RealFunctionAddress + (DerivedKey * SlotMultiplier)
 * and recovered at call time via:
 *   RealFunctionAddress = EncryptedSlot - (DerivedKey * SlotMultiplier)
 */
VOID
EacInitializeMbaApiTable(VOID)
{
    g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed = 0x8F4A2C91E3751B6DULL;
    ULONG64 key = EacDeriveMbaKey(g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed);

    struct {
        EAC_API_SLOT Slot;
        PCWSTR       Name;
    } bindings[] = {
        { EAC_API_MM_COPY_MEMORY,               L"MmCopyMemory"                      },
        { EAC_API_RTL_LOOKUP_FUNCTION_ENTRY,    L"RtlLookupFunctionEntry"            },
        { EAC_API_RTL_VIRTUAL_UNWIND,           L"RtlVirtualUnwind"                  },
        { EAC_API_OB_REGISTER_CALLBACKS,        L"ObRegisterCallbacks"               },
        { EAC_API_OB_UNREGISTER_CALLBACKS,      L"ObUnRegisterCallbacks"             },
        { EAC_API_PS_SET_CREATE_PROCESS_NOTIFY_EX, L"PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx" },
        { EAC_API_PS_SET_CREATE_THREAD_NOTIFY,  L"PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine"    },
        { EAC_API_PS_REMOVE_CREATE_THREAD_NOTIFY, L"PsRemoveCreateThreadNotifyRoutine" },
        { EAC_API_PS_SET_LOAD_IMAGE_NOTIFY,     L"PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine"       },
        { EAC_API_PS_REMOVE_LOAD_IMAGE_NOTIFY,  L"PsRemoveLoadImageNotifyRoutine"    },
        { EAC_API_CM_REGISTER_CALLBACK_EX,      L"CmRegisterCallbackEx"              },
        { EAC_API_CM_UNREGISTER_CALLBACK,       L"CmUnRegisterCallback"              },
        { EAC_API_MM_COPY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY,       L"MmCopyVirtualMemory"               }
    };

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(bindings); ++i) {
        PVOID fnPtr = EacLookupExportByName(bindings[i].Name);
        if (fnPtr != NULL) {
            ULONG64 slotMul = EAC_MBA_SUB_MMCOPYMEMORY + ((ULONG64)bindings[i].Slot * 0x100000001B3ULL);
            g_Eac.EncryptedApiTable[bindings[i].Slot] = (ULONG64)fnPtr + (key * slotMul);
        } else {
            g_Eac.EncryptedApiTable[bindings[i].Slot] = 0ULL;
        }
    }
}

PVOID
EacResolveMbaApi(
    _In_ EAC_API_SLOT Slot,
    _In_ ULONG64 Seed
)
{
    if (Slot >= EAC_API_SLOT_COUNT) {
        return NULL;
    }

    ULONG64 enc = g_Eac.EncryptedApiTable[Slot];
    if (enc == 0ULL) {
        return NULL;
    }

    ULONG64 key = EacDeriveMbaKey(Seed);
    ULONG64 slotMul = EAC_MBA_SUB_MMCOPYMEMORY + ((ULONG64)Slot * 0x100000001B3ULL);
    return (PVOID)(enc - (key * slotMul));
}

/* =========================================================================
 * SYSTEM MODULE LIST ENUMERATION & BOUNDARY VERIFICATION
 * ========================================================================= */

PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES
EacAcquireModuleList(VOID)
{
    ULONG bytesNeeded = 0;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemModuleInformation, NULL, 0, &bytesNeeded);
    if (status != STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH || bytesNeeded == 0) {
        return NULL;
    }

    bytesNeeded += 0x2000;
    PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES modules = (PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES)ExAllocatePoolWithTag(
        NonPagedPoolNx,
        bytesNeeded,
        EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN
    );
    if (!modules) {
        return NULL;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(modules, bytesNeeded);
    status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemModuleInformation, modules, bytesNeeded, &bytesNeeded);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(modules, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
        return NULL;
    }

    return modules;
}

BOOLEAN
EacIsAddressBackedByModule(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules,
    _In_ ULONG64 Address,
    _Out_opt_ PULONG64 OutImageBase,
    _Out_opt_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULE_INFORMATION *OutModEntry
)
{
    if (OutImageBase) {
        *OutImageBase = 0;
    }
    if (OutModEntry) {
        *OutModEntry = NULL;
    }
    if (!Modules || Address < 0xFFFF800000000000ULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    for (ULONG i = 0; i < Modules->NumberOfModules; ++i) {
        ULONG64 base = (ULONG64)Modules->Modules[i].ImageBase;
        ULONG64 end  = base + (ULONG64)Modules->Modules[i].ImageSize;
        if (Address >= base && Address < end) {
            if (OutImageBase) {
                *OutImageBase = base;
            }
            if (OutModEntry) {
                *OutModEntry = &Modules->Modules[i];
            }
            return TRUE;
        }
    }

    return FALSE;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * SECTION 7 (RVA 0x383000, 35.28 MB) OBFUSCATED VM DISPATCHER LOOP
 * Preserves XMM6..XMM15 and executes virtualized integrity opcodes (§8, §24.2)
 * ========================================================================= */

#pragma code_seg(push, ".eacvm")

NTSTATUS
EacExecuteSection7VmDispatcher(
    _In_ ULONG VmOpcode,
    _Inout_opt_ PULONG64 VmRegs
)
{
    M128A savedXmm[4];
    RtlZeroMemory(savedXmm, sizeof(savedXmm));

    /*
     * Section 7 VM handler dispatch table:
     *   Opcode 0x01: Snapshot CR2/CR3/CR4/CR8 and verify CR3 PFN
     *   Opcode 0x02: Run 4-level CR3 kernel page table walk + stack unwind
     *   Opcode 0x03: Run hypervisor / MSR / timing audit
     *   Opcode 0x04: Refresh hardware fingerprint & emit multiarray chunk
     */
    switch (VmOpcode) {
    case 0x01:
        EacReadControlRegisters_1401e828c(&g_Eac.ControlRegs);
        if (VmRegs) {
            VmRegs[0] = g_Eac.ControlRegs.Cr3;
            VmRegs[1] = g_Eac.ControlRegs.Cr4;
        }
        break;

    case 0x02: {
        PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES mods = EacAcquireModuleList();
        if (mods != NULL) {
            EacAuditKernelPageTablesAndStacks(mods);
            ExFreePoolWithTag(mods, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
        }
        break;
    }

    case 0x03:
        EacAuditHypervisorAndAntiDebug();
        break;

    case 0x04:
        EacCollectHardwareTelemetry();
        break;

    default:
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

#pragma code_seg(pop)

/* =========================================================================
 * IRP DISPATCH ROUTINES (\Device\EasyAntiCheat_EOS)
 * ========================================================================= */

_Use_decl_annotations_
NTSTATUS
EacDispatchCreateClose(
    PDEVICE_OBJECT DeviceObject,
    PIRP Irp
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DeviceObject);

    Irp->IoStatus.Status      = STATUS_SUCCESS;
    Irp->IoStatus.Information = 0;
    IoCompleteRequest(Irp, IO_NO_INCREMENT);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

_Use_decl_annotations_
NTSTATUS
EacDispatchIoControl(
    PDEVICE_OBJECT DeviceObject,
    PIRP Irp
)
{
    return EacHandleDeviceControl(DeviceObject, Irp);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * LIFO DRIVER UNLOAD (CLEAN RESTORE OF ALL HOOKS, FILTERS & CALLBACKS)
 * ========================================================================= */

_Use_decl_annotations_
VOID
EacDriverUnload(
    PDRIVER_OBJECT DriverObject
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DriverObject);

    InterlockedExchange8((volatile CHAR *)&g_Eac.Unloading, TRUE);

    /* 1. Stop periodic 1000ms timer, flush DPCs & free work item */
    EacShutdownDpcAndTimer();

    /* 2. Remove Ob, Ps, and Cm callbacks */
    EacRemoveSecurityCallbacks();

    /* 3. Unregister FLTMGR minifilter (Altitude 328010) */
    EacTeardownMinifilter();

    /* 4. Delete symbolic link and device object */
    UNICODE_STRING symLink;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&symLink, EAC_DOS_DEVICE_NAME_W);
    IoDeleteSymbolicLink(&symLink);

    if (g_Eac.DeviceObject != NULL) {
        IoDeleteDevice(g_Eac.DeviceObject);
        g_Eac.DeviceObject = NULL;
    }

    /* 5. Zero sensitive MBA keys and API tables */
    RtlSecureZeroMemory(g_Eac.EncryptedApiTable, sizeof(g_Eac.EncryptedApiTable));
}

/* =========================================================================
 * DRIVER ENTRY (Reconstructed from RVA 0x274DF8)
 * Prologue: 48 89 5c 24 08 57 48 83 ec 20 48 8b da 48 8b f9
 * ========================================================================= */

_Use_decl_annotations_
NTSTATUS
DriverEntry(
    PDRIVER_OBJECT DriverObject,
    PUNICODE_STRING RegistryPath
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(RegistryPath);

    RtlZeroMemory(&g_Eac, sizeof(g_Eac));
    g_Eac.DriverObject = DriverObject;
    KeInitializeSpinLock(&g_Eac.TelemetryLock);

    /* 1. Initialize SplitMix64/Murmur MBA API Dispatch Table (.rdata 0x140307E90) */
    EacInitializeMbaApiTable();

    /* 2. Create \Device\EasyAntiCheat_EOS and \DosDevices\EasyAntiCheat_EOS */
    UNICODE_STRING devName;
    UNICODE_STRING symLink;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&devName, EAC_DEVICE_NAME_W);
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&symLink, EAC_DOS_DEVICE_NAME_W);

    NTSTATUS status = IoCreateDevice(
        DriverObject,
        0,
        &devName,
        FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN,
        FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN,
        FALSE,
        &g_Eac.DeviceObject
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        return status;
    }

    status = IoCreateSymbolicLink(&symLink, &devName);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        IoDeleteDevice(g_Eac.DeviceObject);
        g_Eac.DeviceObject = NULL;
        return status;
    }

    DriverObject->DriverUnload                         = EacDriverUnload;
    DriverObject->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CREATE]         = EacDispatchCreateClose;
    DriverObject->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CLOSE]          = EacDispatchCreateClose;
    DriverObject->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL] = EacDispatchIoControl;

    /* 3. Register FLTMGR.SYS Minifilter at Altitude 328010 (Static Import Anchor) */
    status = EacInitializeMinifilter(DriverObject);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        /* Continue operating even if volume attachment is deferred */
    }

    /* 4. Snapshot Control Registers (FUN_1401e828c) & Collect Boot HWID Profile */
    EacReadControlRegisters_1401e828c(&g_Eac.ControlRegs);
    EacCollectHardwareTelemetry();
    EacAuditHypervisorAndAntiDebug();
    EacAuditPciBusDmaAndAcpi();

    /* 5. Install ObRegisterCallbacks, Ps* Notify Routines & CmRegisterCallbackEx */
    EacInstallSecurityCallbacks();

    /* 6. Start 1000ms Multi-Core DPC & WorkItem Integrity Pipeline */
    EacInitializeDpcAndTimer();

    EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ADD, 1, "driver_init", 0, 1);
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}
