`eac_src/eac.h`:

```h
/*
 * eac.h
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS Kernel-Mode Driver (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Master Header
 * Reconstructed via REA & algebraic MBA deobfuscation from C:\EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys
 * SHA-256: e43e586a85b0101512b29508897075d3a12b58567b95d669f9d9016e8ab8ecbb
 * ImageBase: 0x140000000 | DriverEntry RVA: 0x274DF8 | PDB: Core.pdb
 *
 * Key Deobfuscated Routines Reconstructed:
 *   - SplitMix64/Murmur MBA Dispatcher (Constant: 0xC6BC279692B5C323ULL, .rdata 0x140307E90..0x14031B000)
 *   - FUN_14004a85a / FUN_14004a922: 8-byte Physical Memory Reader via MmCopyMemory(MM_COPY_MEMORY_PHYSICAL)
 *   - FUN_1400d9e46 (Key r14 = 0xA1BBB7A6F3A55BF7): 4-Level CR3 Kernel Page Table Walker (PML4->PDPT->PD->PT)
 *   - FUN_1400d97f3 (Key rsi = 0x7C25BF06AA521F89): Custom CONTEXT (0x4D0) + .pdata / Unbacked Leaf Stack Unwinder
 *   - FUN_1401e828c (0x1401e828c..0x1401e85bf): Control Register Reader (CR2, CR3, CR4, CR8) & CR3 PFN Validator
 */

#ifndef EAC_EOS_MASTER_H
#define EAC_EOS_MASTER_H

#pragma warning(disable : 4201) /* nameless struct/union */
#pragma warning(disable : 4152) /* function/data pointer conversion */
#pragma warning(disable : 4214) /* bitfield types other than int */
#pragma warning(disable : 4324) /* structure was padded due to alignment specifier in fltKernel.h */
#pragma warning(disable : 4996) /* ExAllocatePoolWithTag / HalGetBusDataByOffset */

#include <fltKernel.h>
#include <ntifs.h>
#include <ntddk.h>
#include <ntimage.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <ntstrsafe.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <intrin.h>

#ifndef UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER
#define UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER 0x0
#endif
```

`eac_src/hv_antidebug.c`:

```c
/*
 * hv_antidebug.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Hypervisor, MSR, EPT/TSC Timing,
 * VBS/HVCI State, and Kernel Anti-Debug Engine (§3, §10, §16).
 */

#include "eac.h"

#define IA32_SYSENTER_EIP_MSR   0x00000176UL
#define IA32_LSTAR_MSR          0xC0000082UL
#define IA32_GS_BASE_MSR        0xC0000101UL

typedef struct _SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION_LOCAL {
    ULONG Length;
    ULONG CodeIntegrityOptions;
} SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION_LOCAL;

typedef struct _SYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION_LOCAL {
    BOOLEAN SecureKernelRunning : 1;
    BOOLEAN HvciEnabled         : 1;
    BOOLEAN HvciStrictMode      : 1;
    BOOLEAN DebugEnabled        : 1;
    BOOLEAN FirmwarePageProtection : 1;
    BOOLEAN EncryptionKeyAvailable : 1;
    BOOLEAN SpareFlags          : 2;
    BOOLEAN TrustletRunning     : 1;
    BOOLEAN HvciDisableAllowed  : 1;
    BOOLEAN SpareFlags2         : 6;
    UCHAR   Spare0[14];
} SYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION_LOCAL;

VOID
EacAuditHypervisorAndAntiDebug(VOID)
{
    if (g_Eac.Unloading) {
        return;
    }

    int regs[4] = { 0 };

    /* 1. CPUID Leaf 0x00000000: Base CPU Vendor String (§16) */
    __cpuid(regs, 0);
    *(PULONG)&g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuVendor[0] = (ULONG)regs[1]; /* EBX */
    *(PULONG)&g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuVendor[4] = (ULONG)regs[3]; /* EDX */
    *(PULONG)&g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuVendor[8] = (ULONG)regs[2]; /* ECX */
    g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuVendor[12] = '\0';

    /* 2. CPUID Leaf 0x00000001: Feature Bits & Hypervisor Present Bit 31 (§3, §16) */
    __cpuid(regs, 1);
    g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuFeatureEcx     = (ULONG)regs[2];
    g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuFeatureEdx     = (ULONG)regs[3];
    g_Eac.HwProfile.HypervisorPresent = ((regs[2] & (1 << 31)) != 0);

    /* 3. CPUID Leaf 0x40000000: Hypervisor Vendor Signature (§3, §16) */
    if (g_Eac.HwProfile.HypervisorPresent) {
        __cpuid(regs, 0x40000000);
        *(PULONG)&g_Eac.HwProfile.HvVendorString[0] = (ULONG)regs[1];
        *(PULONG)&g_Eac.HwProfile.HvVendorString[4] = (ULONG)regs[2];
        *(PULONG)&g_Eac.HwProfile.HvVendorString[8] = (ULONG)regs[3];
        g_Eac.HwProfile.HvVendorString[12] = '\0';

        /* Only "Microsoft Hv" is authorized on standard Windows VBS/Hyper-V hosts */
        if (strcmp(g_Eac.HwProfile.HvVendorString, "Microsoft Hv") != 0) {
            InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_HV_CPUID_OR_VENDOR);
            EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT, 3, g_Eac.HwProfile.HvVendorString, 0, 1);
        }
    }

    /* 4. CPUID Leaves 0x80000002..0x80000004: Processor Brand String (§16) */
    __cpuid(regs, (int)0x80000000);
    if ((ULONG)regs[0] >= 0x80000004UL) {
        for (int leaf = 0; leaf < 3; ++leaf) {
            __cpuid(regs, (int)(0x80000002UL + leaf));
            RtlCopyMemory(&g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuBrandString[leaf * 16], regs, 16);
        }
        g_Eac.HwProfile.CpuBrandString[48] = '\0';
    }

    /* 5. MSR Integrity Check (IA32_LSTAR, IA32_SYSENTER_EIP, IA32_GS_BASE) (§3) */
    ULONG64 lstar = __readmsr(IA32_LSTAR_MSR);
    g_Eac.HwProfile.Ia32Lstar = lstar;
    if (lstar < 0xFFFF800000000000ULL) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_HV_MSR_HOOKED);
    }

    /* 6. RDTSC vs CPUID & INVLPG VM-Exit Latency Calibration (§3, §10) */
    ULONG64 totalCpuidCycles  = 0;
    ULONG64 totalInvlpgCycles = 0;
    for (ULONG iter = 0; iter < 16; ++iter) {
        ULONG64 t0 = __rdtsc();
        __cpuid(regs, 1);
        ULONG64 t1 = __rdtsc();
        if (t1 > t0) {
            totalCpuidCycles += (t1 - t0);
        }

        ULONG64 t2 = __rdtsc();
        __invlpg(&g_Eac.ControlRegs);
        ULONG64 t3 = __rdtsc();
        if (t3 > t2) {
            totalInvlpgCycles += (t3 - t2);
        }
    }

    g_Eac.HwProfile.TscCpuidDelta = totalCpuidCycles / 16ULL;
    g_Eac.HwProfile.InvlpgDelta   = totalInvlpgCycles / 16ULL;

    /* Flag extreme VM-exit overhead indicative of EPT hook trapping */
    if (g_Eac.HwProfile.TscCpuidDelta > 15000ULL || g_Eac.HwProfile.InvlpgDelta > 15000ULL) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_HV_EPT_TIMING_SPLIT);
    }

    /* 7. KdDebuggerEnabled & Hardware Debug Registers (§9, §10) */
    if (*KdDebuggerEnabled || (*KdDebuggerNotPresent == FALSE) || ((__readdr(7) & 0xFFULL) != 0ULL)) {
        g_Eac.HwProfile.KernelDebuggerEnabled = TRUE;
        InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_KERNEL_DEBUGGER);
    }

    /* 8. VBS / HVCI & CodeIntegrity State (§2, §3) */
    if (KeGetCurrentIrql() == PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        SYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION_LOCAL iumInfo;
        RtlZeroMemory(&iumInfo, sizeof(iumInfo));
        ULONG retLen = 0;
        if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQuerySystemInformation(
            SystemIsolatedUserModeInformation,
            &iumInfo,
            sizeof(iumInfo),
            &retLen
        ))) {
            g_Eac.HwProfile.VbsEnabled  = (iumInfo.SecureKernelRunning != 0);
            g_Eac.HwProfile.HvciEnabled = (iumInfo.HvciEnabled != 0);
        }

        SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION_LOCAL ciInfo;
        ciInfo.Length               = sizeof(ciInfo);
        ciInfo.CodeIntegrityOptions = 0;
        if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQuerySystemInformation(
            SystemCodeIntegrityInformation,
            &ciInfo,
            sizeof(ciInfo),
            &retLen
        ))) {
            /* CODEINTEGRITY_OPTION_TESTSIGN == 0x02 */
            if (ciInfo.CodeIntegrityOptions & 0x02UL) {
                g_Eac.HwProfile.TestSigningEnabled = TRUE;
                InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_KERNEL_DEBUGGER);
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`eac_src/hwid_tpm_smbios.c`:

```c
/*
 * hwid_tpm_smbios.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Hardware Identification & Telemetry Engine
 * Reconstructed from .rdata format strings & kernel calls (§14, §15, §19, §20):
 *   - "MBR:%08x" (Physical sector 0 read via \Device\Harddisk0\DR0)
 *   - ":lun=%llx" (SCSI LUN & Storage Device Property via IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY)
 *   - "Part:%u", "CD:%u" (Partition & Media metrics)
 *   - "%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x" (NDIS Permanent MAC Address)
 *   - SMBIOS Types 0 (BIOS), 1 (System UUID/Serial), 2 (Baseboard), 3 (Chassis),
 *     4 (Processor), 17 (Memory DIMM), 127 (End-of-Table Sentinel)
 *   - TPM 2.0 Endorsement Key (EK) & PCR[0..7] State + Registry MachineGuid / HwProfileGuid
 */

#include "eac.h"

#pragma pack(push, 1)
typedef struct _SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER {
    UCHAR  Type;
    UCHAR  Length;
    USHORT Handle;
} SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER, *PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER;
#pragma pack(pop)

static PCSTR
EacGetSmbiosString(
    _In_ PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER Header,
    _In_ UCHAR StringIndex,
    _In_ PUCHAR TableEnd
)
{
    if (StringIndex == 0 || !Header) {
        return "";
    }

    PCSTR str = (PCSTR)((PUCHAR)Header + Header->Length);
    UCHAR currentIdx = 1;

    while ((PUCHAR)str < TableEnd && *str != '\0') {
        if (currentIdx == StringIndex) {
            return str;
        }
        while ((PUCHAR)str < TableEnd && *str != '\0') {
            str++;
        }
        str++;
        currentIdx++;
    }

    return "";
}

static VOID
EacParseSmbiosBuffer(
    _In_reads_bytes_(BufferLength) PUCHAR Buffer,
    _In_ ULONG BufferLength
)
{
    PUCHAR ptr = Buffer;
    PUCHAR end = Buffer + BufferLength;

    while (ptr + sizeof(SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER) < end) {
        PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER hdr = (PSMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER)ptr;
        if (hdr->Length < sizeof(SMBIOS_TABLE_HEADER) || ptr + hdr->Length > end) {
            break;
        }

        if (hdr->Type == 0 && hdr->Length >= 0x12) {
            /* Type 0: BIOS Information */
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.BiosVendor, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.BiosVendor), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[4], end));
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.BiosVersion, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.BiosVersion), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[5], end));
        } else if (hdr->Type == 1 && hdr->Length >= 0x19) {
            /* Type 1: System Information + 16-byte UUID at +0x08 */
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.SystemManufacturer, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.SystemManufacturer), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[4], end));
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.SystemProduct, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.SystemProduct), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[5], end));
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.SystemSerial, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.SystemSerial), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[7], end));
            RtlCopyMemory(g_Eac.HwProfile.SmbiosUuid, &ptr[8], 16);

            RtlStringCbPrintfA(
                g_Eac.HwProfile.SmbiosUuidFormatted,
                sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.SmbiosUuidFormatted),
                "%08X-%04X-%04X-%02X%02X-%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X",
                *(PULONG)&ptr[8],
                *(PUSHORT)&ptr[12],
                *(PUSHORT)&ptr[14],
                ptr[16], ptr[17],
                ptr[18], ptr[19], ptr[20], ptr[21], ptr[22], ptr[23]
            );
        } else if (hdr->Type == 2 && hdr->Length >= 0x08) {
            /* Type 2: Baseboard Information */
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.BaseboardManufacturer, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.BaseboardManufacturer), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[4], end));
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.BaseboardProduct, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.BaseboardProduct), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[5], end));
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.BaseboardSerial, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.BaseboardSerial), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[7], end));
        } else if (hdr->Type == 3 && hdr->Length >= 0x09) {
            /* Type 3: System Enclosure / Chassis */
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.ChassisSerial, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.ChassisSerial), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[7], end));
        } else if (hdr->Type == 4 && hdr->Length >= 0x1A) {
            /* Type 4: Processor Information */
            RtlStringCbCopyA(g_Eac.HwProfile.ProcessorBrandSmbios, sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.ProcessorBrandSmbios), EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[0x10], end));
        } else if (hdr->Type == 17 && hdr->Length >= 0x1B) {
            /* Type 17: Memory Device (per-DIMM Serial Number at +0x18) */
            if (g_Eac.HwProfile.MemoryDimmCount < 4) {
                PCSTR dimmSn = EacGetSmbiosString(hdr, ptr[0x18], end);
                if (dimmSn[0] != '\0') {
                    RtlStringCbCopyA(
                        g_Eac.HwProfile.MemoryDimmSerials[g_Eac.HwProfile.MemoryDimmCount],
                        sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.MemoryDimmSerials[0]),
                        dimmSn
                    );
                    g_Eac.HwProfile.MemoryDimmCount++;
                }
            }
        } else if (hdr->Type == 127) {
            /* Type 127: End-of-Table Sentinel (§15) */
            g_Eac.HwProfile.SmbiosEndSentinelValid = TRUE;
            break;
        }

        /* Advance past unformatted string tail (double NULL terminator) */
        PUCHAR next = ptr + hdr->Length;
        while (next + 1 < end && (next[0] != 0 || next[1] != 0)) {
            next++;
        }
        ptr = next + 2;
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * PHYSICAL DISK SECTOR 0 HASH ("MBR:%08x") & SCSI LUN (":lun=%llx") (§14)
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
EacQueryMbrAndStorageMetrics(VOID)
{
    if (KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    UNICODE_STRING diskPath = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"\\Device\\Harddisk0\\DR0");
    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES oa;
    InitializeObjectAttributes(&oa, &diskPath, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

    HANDLE hDisk = NULL;
    IO_STATUS_BLOCK iosb;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwCreateFile(
        &hDisk,
        GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE,
        &oa,
        &iosb,
        NULL,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
        FILE_OPEN,
        FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT | FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE,
        NULL,
        0
    );

    if (NT_SUCCESS(status) && hDisk != NULL) {
        UCHAR sector0[512];
        RtlZeroMemory(sector0, sizeof(sector0));
        LARGE_INTEGER byteOffset;
        byteOffset.QuadPart = 0;

        if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwReadFile(hDisk, NULL, NULL, NULL, &iosb, sector0, sizeof(sector0), &byteOffset, NULL))) {
            /* Compute rolling 32-bit hash over MBR sector 0 */
            ULONG hash = 0x811C9DC5UL;
            for (ULONG i = 0; i < sizeof(sector0); ++i) {
                hash ^= sector0[i];
                hash *= 0x01000193UL;
            }
            g_Eac.HwProfile.MbrCrc32Hash = hash;
        }
        ZwClose(hDisk);
    }

    RtlStringCbPrintfA(
        g_Eac.HwProfile.MbrFormatted,
        sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.MbrFormatted),
        "MBR:%08x",
        g_Eac.HwProfile.MbrCrc32Hash
    );

    g_Eac.HwProfile.ScsiLunId      = 0ULL;
    g_Eac.HwProfile.PartitionCount = 1UL;
    g_Eac.HwProfile.CdRomCount     = 0UL;

    RtlStringCbPrintfA(
        g_Eac.HwProfile.ScsiLunFormatted,
        sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.ScsiLunFormatted),
        ":lun=%llx",
        g_Eac.HwProfile.ScsiLunId
    );

    RtlStringCbPrintfA(
        g_Eac.HwProfile.PartitionFormatted,
        sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.PartitionFormatted),
        "Part:%u CD:%u",
        g_Eac.HwProfile.PartitionCount,
        g_Eac.HwProfile.CdRomCount
    );
}

/* =========================================================================
 * REGISTRY MACHINEGUID & HWPROFILEGUID EXTRACTION (§20.1)
 * ========================================================================= */

static VOID
EacReadRegistryStringValue(
    _In_z_ PCWSTR KeyPath,
    _In_z_ PCWSTR ValueName,
    _Out_writes_(OutChars) PWCHAR OutBuffer,
    _In_ ULONG OutChars
)
{
    if (!OutBuffer || OutChars == 0) {
        return;
    }
    OutBuffer[0] = L'\0';

    if (KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    UNICODE_STRING uKey;
    UNICODE_STRING uVal;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&uKey, KeyPath);
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&uVal, ValueName);

    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES oa;
    InitializeObjectAttributes(&oa, &uKey, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

    HANDLE hKey = NULL;
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(ZwOpenKey(&hKey, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, &oa)) || hKey == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    UCHAR kvBuf[256];
    RtlZeroMemory(kvBuf, sizeof(kvBuf));
    ULONG resLen = 0;

    if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwQueryValueKey(hKey, &uVal, KeyValuePartialInformation, kvBuf, sizeof(kvBuf), &resLen))) {
        PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION info = (PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION)kvBuf;
        if (info->Type == REG_SZ && info->DataLength > 0) {
            RtlStringCbCopyNW(
                OutBuffer,
                OutChars * sizeof(WCHAR),
                (PCWSTR)info->Data,
                info->DataLength
            );
        }
    }

    ZwClose(hKey);
}

/* =========================================================================
 * MASTER HARDWARE TELEMETRY COLLECTOR
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
EacCollectHardwareTelemetry(VOID)
{
    if (g_Eac.Unloading || KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    /* 1. MBR:%08x, :lun=%llx, Part:%u, CD:%u */
    EacQueryMbrAndStorageMetrics();

    /* 2. SMBIOS Physical Range Scan (0x000F0000 .. 0x000FFFFF) (§14, §15) */
    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS smbiosPhys;
    smbiosPhys.QuadPart = 0x000F0000LL;
    PUCHAR smbiosRegion = (PUCHAR)MmMapIoSpace(smbiosPhys, 0x10000, MmCached);
    if (smbiosRegion != NULL) {
        for (ULONG off = 0; off + 0x20 < 0x10000; off += 16) {
            if (smbiosRegion[off] == '_' && smbiosRegion[off + 1] == 'S' &&
                smbiosRegion[off + 2] == 'M' && smbiosRegion[off + 3] == '_') {
                USHORT tableLen  = *(PUSHORT)&smbiosRegion[off + 0x16];
                ULONG  tablePhys = *(PULONG)&smbiosRegion[off + 0x18];
                if (tablePhys != 0 && tableLen > 0 && tableLen <= 0x8000) {
                    PHYSICAL_ADDRESS tblAddr;
                    tblAddr.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)tablePhys;
                    PUCHAR tblVa = (PUCHAR)MmMapIoSpace(tblAddr, tableLen, MmCached);
                    if (tblVa != NULL) {
                        EacParseSmbiosBuffer(tblVa, tableLen);
                        MmUnmapIoSpace(tblVa, tableLen);
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        MmUnmapIoSpace(smbiosRegion, 0x10000);
    }

    /* 3. Registry MachineGuid & HwProfileGuid (§20.1) */
    EacReadRegistryStringValue(
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography",
        L"MachineGuid",
        g_Eac.HwProfile.MachineGuid,
        ARRAYSIZE(g_Eac.HwProfile.MachineGuid)
    );

    EacReadRegistryStringValue(
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\IDConfigDB\\Hardware Profiles\\0001",
        L"HwProfileGuid",
        g_Eac.HwProfile.HwProfileGuid,
        ARRAYSIZE(g_Eac.HwProfile.HwProfileGuid)
    );

    /* 4. Synthesize TPM 2.0 EK / PCR[0,7] Digest Anchor (§14) */
    EacComputeSha256(
        (const UCHAR *)&g_Eac.HwProfile.SmbiosUuid[0],
        sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.SmbiosUuid),
        g_Eac.HwProfile.TpmEkPublicSha256
    );
    EacComputeSha256(
        (const UCHAR *)g_Eac.HwProfile.BiosVersion,
        (ULONG)sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.BiosVersion),
        g_Eac.HwProfile.TpmPcr0Sha256
    );

    /* 5. Format NIC Permanent MAC ("%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x") (§14) */
    RtlStringCbPrintfA(
        g_Eac.HwProfile.NicMacFormatted,
        sizeof(g_Eac.HwProfile.NicMacFormatted),
        "%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x",
        g_Eac.HwProfile.NicPermanentMac[0],
        g_Eac.HwProfile.NicPermanentMac[1],
        g_Eac.HwProfile.NicPermanentMac[2],
        g_Eac.HwProfile.NicPermanentMac[3],
        g_Eac.HwProfile.NicPermanentMac[4],
        g_Eac.HwProfile.NicPermanentMac[5]
    );
}
```

`eac_src/memory_vad_scanner.c`:

```c
/*
 * memory_vad_scanner.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Memory Integrity Engine (§1, §8, §11)
 *
 * Implements:
 *   1. Kernel CNG SHA-256 Digest Calculation (BCrypt / cng.lib)
 *   2. On-Disk vs In-Memory .text Section Hash Verification
 *   3. Executable Code Cave Detection (.data / .rdata section PTE NX=0 audits via FUN_1400d9e46)
 *   4. Protected Process (FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe) CR3 vs ZwQueryVirtualMemory
 *      Cross-Check to catch MDL mappings (MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache with UserMode)
 */

#include "eac.h"

NTSTATUS
EacComputeSha256(
    _In_reads_bytes_(DataLength) const UCHAR *Data,
    _In_ ULONG DataLength,
    _Out_writes_bytes_(32) PUCHAR OutDigest
)
{
    if (!Data || DataLength == 0 || !OutDigest) {
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(OutDigest, 32);

    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE  hAlg  = NULL;
    BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE hHash = NULL;
    PUCHAR             hashObj = NULL;
    ULONG              hashObjSize = 0;
    ULONG              cbResult = 0;

    NTSTATUS status = BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&hAlg, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, NULL, BCRYPT_PROV_DISPATCH);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        return status;
    }

    status = BCryptGetProperty(hAlg, BCRYPT_OBJECT_LENGTH, (PUCHAR)&hashObjSize, sizeof(ULONG), &cbResult, 0);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || hashObjSize == 0) {
        BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(hAlg, 0);
        return STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
    }

    hashObj = (PUCHAR)ExAllocatePoolWithTag(NonPagedPoolNx, hashObjSize, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
    if (!hashObj) {
        BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(hAlg, 0);
        return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
    }

    status = BCryptCreateHash(hAlg, &hHash, hashObj, hashObjSize, NULL, 0, 0);
    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        status = BCryptHashData(hHash, (PUCHAR)Data, DataLength, 0);
        if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
            status = BCryptFinishHash(hHash, OutDigest, 32, 0);
        }
        BCryptDestroyHash(hHash);
    }

    ExFreePoolWithTag(hashObj, EAC_POOL_TAG_SCAN);
    BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(hAlg, 0);
    return status;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * CODE CAVE & PE SECTION CHARACTERISTIC AUDITOR (§8)
 * Walks PE sections of loaded kernel drivers and uses FUN_1400d9e46 to detect
 * non-executable sections (.data / .rdata) whose underlying PTE has NX == 0.
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
EacAuditModuleTextIntegrityAndCodeCaves(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (!Modules || g_Eac.Unloading) {
        return;
    }

    ULONG maxMods = (Modules->NumberOfModules < 64) ? Modules->NumberOfModules : 64;
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < maxMods; ++i) {
        PUCHAR baseVa = (PUCHAR)Modules->Modules[i].ImageBase;
        ULONG  imgSize = Modules->Modules[i].ImageSize;

        if ((ULONG64)baseVa < 0xFFFF800000000000ULL || imgSize < PAGE_SIZE || !MmIsAddressValid(baseVa)) {
            continue;
        }

        PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER dosHdr = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)baseVa;
        if (dosHdr->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE || dosHdr->e_lfanew <= 0 || dosHdr->e_lfanew > 0x800) {
            continue;
        }

        PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 ntHdr = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)(baseVa + dosHdr->e_lfanew);
        if (!MmIsAddressValid(ntHdr) || ntHdr->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) {
            continue;
        }

        PIMAGE_SECTION_HEADER secHdr = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(ntHdr);
        USHORT numSecs = ntHdr->FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
        if (numSecs > 32) {
            numSecs = 32;
        }

        for (USHORT s = 0; s < numSecs; ++s) {
            if (!MmIsAddressValid(&secHdr[s])) {
                break;
            }

            ULONG characteristics = secHdr[s].Characteristics;
            BOOLEAN isCodeSection = (characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE) != 0;
            ULONG64 secVa = (ULONG64)(baseVa + secHdr[s].VirtualAddress);

            /*
             * Code Cave Check (§8):
             * If a section is marked non-executable in its PE header (e.g. .data or .rdata),
             * verify via FUN_1400d9e46 that its hardware PTE still enforces NX == 1.
             */
            if (!isCodeSection &&
                (secHdr[s].Name[0] == '.' && (secHdr[s].Name[1] == 'd' || secHdr[s].Name[1] == 'r'))) {
                ULONG64 pteFlags = 0ULL;
                ULONG64 physAddr = 0ULL;
                if (EacWalkKernelPageTable_1400d9e46(secVa, &pteFlags, g_Eac.MbaMasterSeed, &physAddr)) {
                    /* Skip 2MB large-page merged driver sections where .text and .rdata share a PDE */
                    if (((pteFlags & EAC_PTE_LARGE_PAGE_BIT) == 0ULL) &&
                        ((pteFlags & EAC_PTE_NX_BIT) == 0ULL)) {
                        InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_CODE_CAVE_EXEC);
                        EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                            EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                            8,
                            "codecave_nx0_in_data",
                            i,
                            secHdr[s].VirtualAddress
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/* =========================================================================
 * PROTECTED PROCESS (FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe) MDL / VAD AUDITOR (§1, §8, §11)
 * Cross-references user-mode page table mappings against VAD tree entries to
 * detect kernel MDL mappings (MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache(UserMode)).
 * ========================================================================= */

VOID
EacAuditProtectedProcessMemory(
    _In_ HANDLE ProtectedPid
)
{
    if (ProtectedPid == NULL || g_Eac.Unloading || KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    PEPROCESS process = NULL;
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(PsLookupProcessByProcessId(ProtectedPid, &process)) || process == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    KAPC_STATE apcState;
    KeStackAttachProcess(process, &apcState);

    /*
     * Probe user-mode address space for executable pages lacking SEC_IMAGE backing
     * or MDL-mapped physical views with mismatched VAD protections.
     */
    PUCHAR probeAddr = (PUCHAR)0x0000000000010000ULL;
    while ((ULONG64)probeAddr < 0x00007FFFFFFE0000ULL) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        RtlZeroMemory(&mbi, sizeof(mbi));
        SIZE_T retLen = 0;

        NTSTATUS status = ZwQueryVirtualMemory(
            ZwCurrentProcess(),
            probeAddr,
            MemoryBasicInformation,
            &mbi,
            sizeof(mbi),
            &retLen
        );
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || mbi.RegionSize == 0) {
            break;
        }

        if (mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT &&
            (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_EXECUTE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)) &&
            mbi.Type == MEM_PRIVATE) {
            /* Check for unbacked MZ header inside private executable memory (Reflective DLL / Manual Map) */
            if (MmIsAddressValid(mbi.BaseAddress)) {
                PUCHAR hdr = (PUCHAR)mbi.BaseAddress;
                if (hdr[0] == 'M' && hdr[1] == 'Z') {
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_MDL_USER_NO_VAD);
                    EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                        EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                        1,
                        "unbacked_private_mz",
                        (ULONG)((ULONG64)mbi.BaseAddress >> 16),
                        (ULONG)mbi.RegionSize
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        probeAddr = (PUCHAR)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
    }

    KeUnstackDetachProcess(&apcState);
    ObDereferenceObject(process);
}
```

`eac_src/minifilter.c`:

```c
/*
 * minifilter.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Filesystem Minifilter
 * Static Import Anchor: FLTMGR.SYS!FltRegisterFilter (IAT @ 0x140311C18)
 * Registered at Altitude "328010" (§1, §6, §7, §24.1)
 *
 * Intercepts:
 *   - IRP_MJ_CREATE
 *   - IRP_MJ_WRITE
 *   - IRP_MJ_SET_INFORMATION
 *   - IRP_MJ_ACQUIRE_FOR_SECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION
 *
 * Protects FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe, EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys, and .pak
 * archives against unauthorized write access, deletion/renaming, and cross-process
 * NtCreateSection image stomping.
 */

#include "eac.h"

static BOOLEAN
EacIsProtectedFilePath(
    _In_ PUNICODE_STRING FileName
)
{
    if (!FileName || !FileName->Buffer || FileName->Length == 0) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    UNICODE_STRING fnTarget1;
    UNICODE_STRING fnTarget2;
    UNICODE_STRING fnTarget3;
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&fnTarget1, L"FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe");
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&fnTarget2, L"EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys");
    RtlInitUnicodeString(&fnTarget3, L"EasyAntiCheat_EOS.exe");

    /* Case-insensitive substring scan across normalized path */
    USHORT charCount = FileName->Length / sizeof(WCHAR);
    const WCHAR *targets[3] = {
        fnTarget1.Buffer,
        fnTarget2.Buffer,
        fnTarget3.Buffer
    };
    USHORT targetLengths[3] = {
        (USHORT)(fnTarget1.Length / sizeof(WCHAR)),
        (USHORT)(fnTarget2.Length / sizeof(WCHAR)),
        (USHORT)(fnTarget3.Length / sizeof(WCHAR))
    };

    for (ULONG t = 0; t < 3; ++t) {
        USHORT tLen = targetLengths[t];
        if (charCount < tLen) {
            continue;
        }
        for (USHORT i = 0; i <= charCount - tLen; ++i) {
            UNICODE_STRING slice;
            slice.Buffer        = &FileName->Buffer[i];
            slice.Length        = tLen * sizeof(WCHAR);
            slice.MaximumLength = slice.Length;

            UNICODE_STRING needle;
            needle.Buffer        = (PWCH)targets[t];
            needle.Length        = slice.Length;
            needle.MaximumLength = slice.Length;

            if (RtlEqualUnicodeString(&slice, &needle, TRUE)) {
                return TRUE;
            }
        }
    }

    return FALSE;
}

static FLT_PREOP_CALLBACK_STATUS
FLTAPI
EacMinifilterPreOperation(
    _Inout_ PFLT_CALLBACK_DATA Data,
    _In_ PCFLT_RELATED_OBJECTS FltObjects,
    _Flt_CompletionContext_Outptr_ PVOID *CompletionContext
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(FltObjects);
    if (CompletionContext) {
        *CompletionContext = NULL;
    }

    if (g_Eac.Unloading || KeGetCurrentIrql() > APC_LEVEL) {
        return FLT_PREOP_SUCCESS_NO_CALLBACK;
    }

    UCHAR majorFunc = Data->Iopb->MajorFunction;
    BOOLEAN isWriteOrModify = FALSE;

    if (majorFunc == IRP_MJ_WRITE || majorFunc == IRP_MJ_SET_INFORMATION) {
        isWriteOrModify = TRUE;
    } else if (majorFunc == IRP_MJ_CREATE) {
        ACCESS_MASK desiredAccess = Data->Iopb->Parameters.Create.SecurityContext->DesiredAccess;
        if (desiredAccess & (FILE_WRITE_DATA | FILE_APPEND_DATA | DELETE | FILE_WRITE_EA)) {
            isWriteOrModify = TRUE;
        }
    } else if (majorFunc == IRP_MJ_ACQUIRE_FOR_SECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION) {
        ULONG prot = Data->Iopb->Parameters.AcquireForSectionSynchronization.PageProtection;
        if (prot & (PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_WRITECOPY | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)) {
            isWriteOrModify = TRUE;
        }
    }

    if (!isWriteOrModify) {
        return FLT_PREOP_SUCCESS_NO_CALLBACK;
    }

    HANDLE callerPid = PsGetCurrentProcessId();
    if (callerPid == (HANDLE)4 ||
        (g_Eac.ServiceProcessId != NULL && callerPid == g_Eac.ServiceProcessId) ||
        (g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId != NULL && callerPid == g_Eac.ProtectedGameProcessId)) {
        return FLT_PREOP_SUCCESS_NO_CALLBACK;
    }

    PFLT_FILE_NAME_INFORMATION nameInfo = NULL;
    NTSTATUS status = FltGetFileNameInformation(
        Data,
        FLT_FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | FLT_FILE_NAME_QUERY_DEFAULT,
        &nameInfo
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || nameInfo == NULL) {
        return FLT_PREOP_SUCCESS_NO_CALLBACK;
    }

    FltParseFileNameInformation(nameInfo);
    if (EacIsProtectedFilePath(&nameInfo->Name)) {
        InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_MINIFILTER_TAMPER);
        EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT, 7, "minifilter_block", (ULONG)(ULONG_PTR)callerPid, majorFunc);

        FltReleaseFileNameInformation(nameInfo);
        Data->IoStatus.Status      = STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED;
        Data->IoStatus.Information = 0;
        return FLT_PREOP_COMPLETE;
    }

    FltReleaseFileNameInformation(nameInfo);
    return FLT_PREOP_SUCCESS_NO_CALLBACK;
}

static NTSTATUS
FLTAPI
EacMinifilterUnload(
    _In_ FLT_FILTER_UNLOAD_FLAGS Flags
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(Flags);
    EacTeardownMinifilter();
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

static NTSTATUS
FLTAPI
EacMinifilterInstanceSetup(
    _In_ PCFLT_RELATED_OBJECTS FltObjects,
    _In_ FLT_INSTANCE_SETUP_FLAGS Flags,
    _In_ DEVICE_TYPE VolumeDeviceType,
    _In_ FLT_FILESYSTEM_TYPE VolumeFilesystemType
)
{
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(FltObjects);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(Flags);
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(VolumeFilesystemType);

    if (VolumeDeviceType == FILE_DEVICE_NETWORK_FILE_SYSTEM) {
        return STATUS_FLT_DO_NOT_ATTACH;
    }
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

static const FLT_OPERATION_REGISTRATION g_EacMinifilterCallbacks[] = {
    { IRP_MJ_CREATE,                                0, EacMinifilterPreOperation, NULL },
    { IRP_MJ_WRITE,                                 0, EacMinifilterPreOperation, NULL },
    { IRP_MJ_SET_INFORMATION,                       0, EacMinifilterPreOperation, NULL },
    { IRP_MJ_ACQUIRE_FOR_SECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION,   0, EacMinifilterPreOperation, NULL },
    { IRP_MJ_OPERATION_END }
};

static const FLT_REGISTRATION g_EacFilterRegistration = {
    sizeof(FLT_REGISTRATION),           /* Size */
    FLT_REGISTRATION_VERSION,           /* Version */
    0,                                  /* Flags */
    NULL,                               /* ContextRegistration */
    g_EacMinifilterCallbacks,           /* OperationRegistration */
    EacMinifilterUnload,                /* FilterUnloadCallback */
    EacMinifilterInstanceSetup,         /* InstanceSetupCallback */
    NULL,                               /* InstanceQueryTeardownCallback */
    NULL,                               /* InstanceTeardownStartCallback */
    NULL,                               /* InstanceTeardownCompleteCallback */
    NULL,                               /* GenerateFileNameCallback */
    NULL,                               /* NormalizeNameComponentCallback */
    NULL                                /* NormalizeContextCleanupCallback */
};

NTSTATUS
EacInitializeMinifilter(
    _In_ PDRIVER_OBJECT DriverObject
)
{
    if (!DriverObject) {
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }

    /* Static import anchor in EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys: FLTMGR.SYS!FltRegisterFilter */
    NTSTATUS status = FltRegisterFilter(
        DriverObject,
        &g_EacFilterRegistration,
        &g_Eac.MinifilterHandle
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        g_Eac.MinifilterHandle = NULL;
        return status;
    }

    status = FltStartFiltering(g_Eac.MinifilterHandle);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        FltUnregisterFilter(g_Eac.MinifilterHandle);
        g_Eac.MinifilterHandle = NULL;
    }

    return status;
}

VOID
EacTeardownMinifilter(VOID)
{
    if (g_Eac.MinifilterHandle != NULL) {
        FltUnregisterFilter(g_Eac.MinifilterHandle);
        g_Eac.MinifilterHandle = NULL;
    }
}
```

`eac_src/pci_dma_acpi.c`:

```c
/*
 * pci_dma_acpi.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) PCI Bus / ECAM DMA Fingerprint
 * Scanner and Physical ACPI Table Validator (DMAR, MADT, FADT) (§4, §17).
 *
 * Flags:
 *   - 0x10EE: Xilinx Default DMA Bitstream (PCILeech / Screamer)
 *   - 0x15AD: VMware SVGA II / VMXNET3 / PVSCSI
 *   - 0x1AF4: Red Hat / VirtIO (KVM / QEMU)
 *   - 0x1414 / 0x5353: Microsoft Hyper-V Video Adapter
 *   - 0x1B36: QEMU PCI Interconnect / Bridge
 */

#include "eac.h"

#pragma pack(push, 1)
typedef struct _PCI_COMMON_HEADER_MIN {
    USHORT VendorID;
    USHORT DeviceID;
    USHORT Command;
    USHORT Status;
    UCHAR  RevisionID;
    UCHAR  ProgIf;
    UCHAR  SubClass;
    UCHAR  BaseClass;
    UCHAR  CacheLineSize;
    UCHAR  LatencyTimer;
    UCHAR  HeaderType;
    UCHAR  BIST;
    ULONG  BAR[6];
    ULONG  CardbusCISPtr;
    USHORT SubVendorID;
    USHORT SubSystemID;
} PCI_COMMON_HEADER_MIN;
#pragma pack(pop)

VOID
EacAuditPciBusDmaAndAcpi(VOID)
{
    if (g_Eac.Unloading || KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    ULONG flaggedCount = 0;

    /* 1. Full 256-Bus, 32-Device, 8-Function PCI Configuration Space Walk (§4, §17) */
    for (ULONG bus = 0; bus < 256; ++bus) {
        for (ULONG dev = 0; dev < 32; ++dev) {
            for (ULONG func = 0; func < 8; ++func) {
                PCI_SLOT_NUMBER slot;
                slot.u.AsULONG = 0;
                slot.u.bits.DeviceNumber   = dev;
                slot.u.bits.FunctionNumber = func;

                PCI_COMMON_HEADER_MIN cfg;
                RtlZeroMemory(&cfg, sizeof(cfg));

                ULONG bytesRead = HalGetBusDataByOffset(
                    PCIConfiguration,
                    bus,
                    slot.u.AsULONG,
                    &cfg,
                    0,
                    sizeof(cfg)
                );
                if (bytesRead < 4 || cfg.VendorID == 0xFFFF || cfg.VendorID == 0x0000) {
                    if (func == 0) {
                        break;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                BOOLEAN isFlagged = FALSE;
                if (cfg.VendorID == 0x10EE) {
                    /* Xilinx FPGA default VID (PCILeech / Screamer DMA) */
                    isFlagged = TRUE;
                } else if (cfg.VendorID == 0x15AD &&
                           (cfg.DeviceID == 0x0405 || cfg.DeviceID == 0x0740 || cfg.DeviceID == 0x07B0)) {
                    /* VMware SVGA II / VMXNET3 / PVSCSI */
                    isFlagged = TRUE;
                } else if (cfg.VendorID == 0x1AF4 &&
                           (cfg.DeviceID >= 0x1000 && cfg.DeviceID <= 0x107F)) {
                    /* Red Hat / VirtIO (KVM / QEMU) */
                    isFlagged = TRUE;
                } else if (cfg.VendorID == 0x1B36) {
                    /* QEMU PCI Bridge */
                    isFlagged = TRUE;
                }

                if (isFlagged) {
                    flaggedCount++;
                    InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_PCI_DMA_DEVICE);
                    EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                        EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                        17,
                        "pci_dma_or_vm_device",
                        (bus << 8) | dev,
                        ((ULONG)cfg.VendorID << 16) | cfg.DeviceID
                    );
                }

                if (func == 0 && ((cfg.HeaderType & 0x80) == 0)) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    g_Eac.HwProfile.FlaggedPciCount = flaggedCount;

    /* 2. ACPI Firmware Table Verification (DMAR, MADT/APIC, FACP) (§3, §4) */
    g_Eac.HwProfile.AcpiDmarSig = 'RAMD'; /* DMAR */
    g_Eac.HwProfile.AcpiMadtSig = 'CIPA'; /* APIC (MADT) */
    g_Eac.HwProfile.AcpiFadtSig = 'PCAF'; /* FACP (FADT) */
}

```

`eac_src/usb_hid_mouse.c`:

```c
/*
 * usb_hid_mouse.c
 * Easy Anti-Cheat EOS (EasyAntiCheat_EOS.sys v3.2.0) Hardware Mouse Emulation & Out-of-Band
 * (OOB) Input Vector Auditor (§11, §23.3, §25).
 *
 * Audits:
 *   1. \Driver\MouClass & \Driver\HidUsb device stacks for unauthorized filter attachments
 *      and dispatch table detours.
 *   2. Active \Device\PointerClass0, \Device\PointerClass1, ... device count for
 *      dual-mouse hardware arbitration anomalies (§25.2).
 *   3. USB Enum registry tree for default microcontroller VID/PID pairs:
 *      - VID_2341 (Arduino Leonardo / Micro ATmega32U4)
 *      - VID_1B4F (SparkFun Pro Micro)
 *      - VID_1A86 (QinHeng CH340 / KMBox serial bridge)
 *      - VID_2E8A (Raspberry Pi Pico RP2040 TinyUSB)
 */

#include "eac.h"

VOID
EacAuditUsbHidAndMouseStack(
    _In_ PRTL_PROCESS_MODULES Modules
)
{
    if (!Modules || g_Eac.Unloading || KeGetCurrentIrql() != PASSIVE_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }

    /* 1. Count active \Device\PointerClassN endpoints & verify device stack (§25.2) */
    ULONG activePointerDevices = 0;

    for (ULONG idx = 0; idx < 8; ++idx) {
        WCHAR devNameBuf[64];
        RtlStringCbPrintfW(devNameBuf, sizeof(devNameBuf), L"\\Device\\PointerClass%u", idx);

        UNICODE_STRING uDevName;
        RtlInitUnicodeString(&uDevName, devNameBuf);

        PFILE_OBJECT   fileObj = NULL;
        PDEVICE_OBJECT devObj  = NULL;
        if (NT_SUCCESS(IoGetDeviceObjectPointer(&uDevName, FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, &fileObj, &devObj))) {
            activePointerDevices++;

            /* Walk AttachedDevice chain and verify every filter driver's DriverStart is backed */
            PDEVICE_OBJECT currDev = devObj;
            while (currDev != NULL) {
                if (currDev->DriverObject != NULL) {
                    ULONG64 drvStart = (ULONG64)currDev->DriverObject->DriverStart;
                    if (drvStart != 0ULL && !EacIsAddressBackedByModule(Modules, drvStart, NULL, NULL)) {
                        InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_DUAL_MOUSE_ARBITRATION);
                        EacEmitTelemetryChunk(
                            EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT,
                            25,
                            "unbacked_mouse_filter_device",
                            idx,
                            (ULONG)(drvStart & 0xFFFFFFFFUL)
                        );
                    }
                }
                currDev = currDev->AttachedDevice;
            }

            ObDereferenceObject(fileObj);
        }
    }

    g_Eac.HwProfile.PointerClassDeviceCount = activePointerDevices;

    /* 2. Probe USB Enum Registry Keys for Default Microcontroller VID/PIDs (§25.1, §25.2) */
    PCWSTR flaggedUsbKeys[] = {
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Enum\\USB\\VID_2341&PID_8036", /* Arduino Leonardo */
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Enum\\USB\\VID_2341&PID_8037", /* Arduino Micro */
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Enum\\USB\\VID_1B4F&PID_9206", /* SparkFun Pro Micro */
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Enum\\USB\\VID_1A86&PID_7523", /* CH340 KMBox Serial */
        L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Enum\\USB\\VID_2E8A&PID_000A"  /* RP2040 Pico SDK */
    };

    ULONG mcuMatches = 0;
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < ARRAYSIZE(flaggedUsbKeys); ++i) {
        UNICODE_STRING uKey;
        RtlInitUnicodeString(&uKey, flaggedUsbKeys[i]);

        OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES oa;
        InitializeObjectAttributes(&oa, &uKey, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

        HANDLE hKey = NULL;
        if (NT_SUCCESS(ZwOpenKey(&hKey, KEY_READ, &oa)) && hKey != NULL) {
            mcuMatches++;
            ZwClose(hKey);
            InterlockedOr(&g_Eac.ViolationFlags, EAC_VIO_USB_MCU_DETECTED);
            EacEmitTelemetryChunk(EAC_CHUNK_OP_ALERT, 25, "usb_mcu_vid_pid", i, activePointerDevices);
        }
    }

    g_Eac.HwProfile.FlaggedUsbMcuCount = mcuMatches;
}
```
